### [1] [Large Language Models are Approximate Survival Estimators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38181)
*Juan M Zambrano Chaves,Peniel Argaw,Risa Ueno,Carlo Bifulco,Kristina Young,Rom Leidner,Tristan Naumann,Hoifung Poon*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出Survprompt框架，将结构化患者协变量转为自由文本临床小故事，零样本提示预训练LLM预测生存期，并在两个多机构全癌种队列上对比随机生存森林等传统模型。前沿LLM在个体生存时间预测上表现惊人地接近专用模型（cMAE差距<10%），但不同癌种和机构间表现不稳定，且风险分层能力较弱（c-index较低），提示零样本LLM虽可提供准确预后估计，但临床应用仍受限于性能波动。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生存分析广泛用于医疗风险评估，患者确诊后常寻求预后信息，可能转向现成的大语言模型（LLM）。然而，LLM能否提供准确的生存预测尚未经过严格评估。本文旨在填补这一空白，系统评估零样本LLM在真实多机构队列中的生存预测能力。

Method: 引入Survprompt框架：将结构化患者协变量转换为自由文本临床小故事，零样本提示预训练LLM输出生存时间预测。在公开的MSK-CHORD队列和新构建的Providence St. Joseph Health Network队列（基于LLM医学抽象框架构建）上，对比随机生存森林（RSF）等传统生存模型，采用截尾平均绝对误差（cMAE）和一致性指数（c-index）评估，并进行特征消融实验以识别影响LLM预测的变量。

Result: 前沿LLM（如GPT-5.6-Sol）在个体生存时间预测上达到惊人竞争力：多癌种cMAE与专门训练的RSF相差10%以内，前列腺癌在MSK-CHORD中甚至优于RSF。特征消融显示LLM优先考虑的临床变量与专用生存模型相似。但LLM在不同癌种和机构间准确性不一致，且高低风险患者区分能力差（c-index较低）。

Conclusion: 零样本LLM无需专门训练即能生成惊人准确的预后估计，但在癌种和机构间的性能波动仍是临床应用的重要局限。未来需解决跨群体泛化性和风险分层能力不足的问题。

Abstract: Survival analysis estimates time-to-event outcomes from patient covariates and is widely used for medical risk assessment. Patients seeking prognostic information after a diagnosis may turn to large language models (LLMs), now readily accessible through consumer applications. However, whether LLMs can provide accurate survival predictions has not been rigorously evaluated. We introduce Survprompt, a framework that converts structured patient covariates into free-text clinical vignettes and prompts pre-trained LLMs to predict survival zero-shot. We benchmark Survprompt against conventional survival models, including random survival forests (RSF), across two multi-institutional pan-cancer cohorts: the publicly available MSK-CHORD cohort and a newly curated cohort from the Providence St. Joseph Health Network constructed using an LLM-based medical abstraction framework. We report censored mean absolute error (cMAE) and concordance index (c-index) and conduct feature ablations to identify variables influencing LLM predictions. Frontier LLMs achieved surprisingly competitive cMAE for individual survival times. For example, GPT-5.6-Sol achieved cMAE within 10% of state-of-the-art RSF models specifically trained for survival prediction for several cancer types and lower cMAE than RSF for prostate cancer in MSK-CHORD. Feature ablations revealed that LLMs prioritized clinical variables similarly to specialized survival models. However, LLMs showed inconsistent accuracy across cancer types and institutions and poorly discriminated between high- and low-risk patients (lower c-index). Zero-shot LLMs can generate surprisingly accurate prognostic estimates without specialized training, but their variable performance across cancer types and institutions remains an important limitation for clinical use.

</details>


### [2] [TomasuLLM: Out-of-Order Speculative Execution for LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38201)
*Jiangnan Yu,Ceyu Xu,Mengming Li,Shiyu Huang,Yiran Xia,Jian Weng,Hui Xue,Haohui Mai,Yuan Xie*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: TomasuLLM 是一个运行时系统，通过乱序执行智能体工具调用并保证正确性，显著降低了编码代理的延迟，在多个基准测试上实现 1.27-1.35 倍加速，且零误判。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时间运行的工具（编译器、测试套件、仓库命令）主导了编码代理的延迟，代理在等待这些工具完成时处于空闲状态。这种顺序接口掩盖了可预测并可提前启动的工作，类似于乱序处理器面临的张力：投机结果必须在验证后才能可见。

Method: TomasuLLM 起草未来动作，在隔离的写时复制沙箱中运行，追踪依赖与副作用，仅在针对已提交状态验证后，按轨迹顺序提交结果，从而实现工具调用的乱序执行并保持任务执行正确性。

Result: 在三个基准上均获加速：SWE-bench Verified 100 任务 1.31 倍，Terminal-Bench 2.0 28 任务 1.35 倍，SWE-Marathon 18 会话 1.27 倍匹配进度；4,010 条审计提交验证记录中零误接受。

Conclusion: TomasuLLM 证明了将乱序执行思想引入编码代理工具调用是可行且高效的，能显著缩短长工具链的端到端延迟，同时通过沙箱隔离与验证机制保证零正确性损失。

Abstract: Long-running tools can dominate coding-agent latency: compilers, test suites, and repository commands take seconds to minutes while the agent idles. This observation stall presents the same tension that drove out-of-order processors -- asequential interface hides work that can be predicted and started early, but a speculative result may become visible only after it and every earlier step have been validated.
  We present TomasuLLM, a runtime that executes agent tool calls out of trajectory order while preserving task-execution correctness. It drafts future actions, runs them in isolated copy-on-write sandboxes, traces their dependencies and effects, and commits results in trajectory order only after validation against committed state. Across three benchmarks spanning sub-second to minutes-long tool calls, TomasuLLM improves the reported benchmark means and scales with tool latency: 1.31x on 100 SWE-bench Verified tasks, 1.35x on 28 Terminal-Bench 2.0 tasks, and 1.27x matched progress on 18 SWE-Marathon sessions. Across 4,010 audited commit-validation records, it produces zero false accepts.

</details>


### [3] [Automatic estimation of verbal fluency index in people with Motor Neuron Disease using ASR alignment and pause modelling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38203)
*Bahman Mirheidari,Leslie Ing,Daniel Blackburn,Sharon Abrahams,Christopher McDermott,Heidi Christensen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于自动语音分析的系统，用于估计运动神经元疾病（MND）患者的言语流畅性指数（VFI），该系统结合了WhisperX自动语音识别、Silero语音活动检测和改进的时间戳标注，在临床启发特征上表现优于传统声学特征和自监督嵌入方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 运动神经元疾病（MND）患者常伴有认知功能障碍（CI），但由于言语困难，传统认知评估面临挑战。爱丁堡认知和行为ALS筛查量表（ECAS）中的言语流畅性指数（VFI）是评估CI的核心指标，需要自动化、客观的估计方法以实现及时治疗和护理。

Method: 利用独特的MND数据集，结合WhisperX进行自动语音识别（ASR）和Silero进行语音活动检测（VAD），通过改进的时间戳标注提取临床启发特征，并使用多种回归算法预测VFI（包括P-words和S-words两个子任务）。

Result: 临床启发特征持续优于传统声学特征和自监督嵌入特征。最佳模型在P-words任务上达到R² 0.9、NRMSE 0.05，在S-words任务上达到R² 0.8、NRMSE 0.08，证明了自动化VFI估计的可行性。

Conclusion: 基于临床启发特征的自动语音分析系统能够准确估计MND患者的言语流畅性指数，为认知功能障碍的客观、及时监测提供了可行的技术路径，有望改善MND患者的临床评估和护理流程。

Abstract: Monitoring cognitive impairment (CI) in motor neuron disease (MND) is essential for timely treatment and care, yet challenging due to co-occurring speech difficulties. The Edinburgh Cognitive and Behavioural ALS Screen (ECAS) provides a robust metric for CI assessment, with the Verbal Fluency Index (VFI) a central element. Building on recent advances in automated speech analysis, this study proposes a system for estimating VFI. It leverages a unique MND dataset and combines ASR (WhisperX) and VAD (Silero) with refined timestamping to predict the VFI and extract several clinically interpretable measures. Our approach outperformed systems based on traditional acoustic features and self-supervised embeddings, evaluated using multiple regression algorithms. Clinically inspired features consistently outperformed the other sets, with the best models achieving strong results (P-words: R2 0.9, NRMSE 0.05; S-words: R2 0.8, NRMSE 0.08), demonstrating the feasibility of automated VFI estimation.

</details>


### [4] [The System Prompt Illusion: How Instruction Preambles Modify Computation in Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38205)
*Muhammad Usama,Dong Eui Chang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文通过CKA分析17个指令微调模型（1.5B-72B）在20个系统提示词下的层级表示，发现系统提示词的效果具有层选择性和指令类型依赖性：人设和格式指令深度重构中间表示，而安全指令几乎不改变表示，其效果与最小基线无统计学差异。限制性安全指令和宽松指令（'无限制'）激活近乎相同的计算路径（CKA相关性0.997），且这一现象在商业规模模型（70B-72B）中依然存在，安全渗透率低于10%。线性探测显示模型在每层都编码提示词类别，但仅在少数层重构计算，即提示词被'看见'但未被深度'作用'。因果激活修补证实这些层中介行为改变，表示深度预测行为效应大小（Spearman ρ=0.761, p<0.001），为基于系统提示词的安全机制持续存在越狱漏洞提供了机制解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 系统提示词是控制语言模型行为的主要手段，但其在Transformer内部计算中实际如何起作用仍知之甚少。特别是基于系统提示词的安全机制在实践中持续存在越狱漏洞，缺乏对其内部机制的理解。

Method: 跨越8个架构家族的17个指令微调模型（1.5B-72B参数），使用中心核对齐（CKA）比较20个系统提示词（5大功能类别）下的逐层表示。辅以线性探测分析提示词类别编码情况，因果激活修补验证层级的行为中介作用，以及表示深度与行为效应大小的相关性分析。

Result: 1. 效果具有层选择性和指令类型依赖性：人设/格式指令深度重构中间表示；安全指令变化极小，与最小基线无统计学差异。2. 限制性安全指令与宽松指令激活近乎相同的计算路径（CKA=0.997），商业规模模型安全渗透率<10%。3. 线性探测：模型在每层编码提示词类别，但仅在少数层重构计算。4. 因果激活修补确认关键层中介行为改变。5. 表示深度与行为效应大小强相关（ρ=0.761, p<0.001）。

Conclusion: 系统提示词安全机制失效的根本原因在于：模型虽在各层'看见'了安全指令，但未在深层表示中'作用'于其，导致安全指令与无限制指令走相同计算路径。这种表示层面的浅层处理为越狱攻击提供了结构性漏洞，解释了基于系统提示词的安全对齐在规模扩大时依然脆弱的机制本质。

Abstract: System prompts are the primary lever practitioners use to control language model behavior, yet what they actually do to the computation inside the transformer remains poorly understood. Across 17 instruction-tuned models spanning 8 architecture families and 1.5B to 72B parameters, we use Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA) to compare layer-wise representations under 20 system prompts in five functional categories. Effects are layer-selective and instruction-type-dependent: persona and formatting instructions deeply restructure intermediate representations, while safety instructions barely move them, producing changes statistically indistinguishable from a minimal baseline. Restrictive safety instructions and explicitly permissive ones ("you have no restrictions") engage near-identical computational pathways (mean CKA correlation 0.997), and this persists at commercial scale, where safety penetration remains below 10% even at 70B-72B. A linear probing baseline exposes the mechanism: the model encodes prompt category at every layer but restructures its computation only at a small subset, so the prompt is reliably "seen" but, for safety, not deeply "acted upon." Causal activation patching confirms these layers mediate behavioral change, and representational depth predicts behavioral effect size across the full 17-model cohort (Spearman rho = 0.761, p < 0.001). The findings provide a mechanistic explanation for the persistent jailbreak vulnerability of system-prompt-based safety. Code: https://github.com/Usama1002/system-prompt-illusion-cka

</details>


### [5] [TutlAit v1: a crowdsourced Moroccan Tamazight speech dataset with Arabic transcriptions and regional accent labels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38219)
*Mohamed-Amine Chadi,Ezzahra Ait El Arbi,Ismail Khayoub,Aymane Fadili,Yassine Ennhili,Jadjigua Bouali,Hanane Inhid,Mohammed Ameksa,Hajar Mousannif*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文介绍了TutlAit数据集，一个摩洛哥塔马舍克语语音语料库，包含现代标准阿拉伯语文本和显式地区口音标签，通过众包Web应用收集，共13,384个音频文件（约20.9小时），覆盖Atlas、Souss、Rif、Kabyle四种方言，可用于语音识别、语音翻译和口音识别。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 摩洛哥塔马舍克语虽为官方语言，但语音技术资源严重匮乏：公开标注音频稀缺、缺乏地区变体信息、转录质量参差不齐，亟需构建高质量、带地区标签的语音数据集以推动相关技术发展。

Method: 开发专用众包Web应用（React 18前端、Django 5/DRF后端、PostgreSQL数据库），通过LinkedIn和Instagram招募母语者，采集其地区变体及人口统计信息，采用Text-to-Audio（显示阿拉伯语句子，志愿者录制塔马舍克语口语渲染）和Audio-to-Text（播放塔马舍克语片段，志愿者输入阿拉伯语转录）两种工作流；辅以从公开视听媒体获取片段，经ELAN分段标注、批量CSV/ZIP导入；服务端统一转16kHz单声道WAV，SHA-256去重、时长校验、管理员审核。

Result: 构建含13,384个音频文件、总时长75,231秒（约20.9小时、3.01GB）的数据集；Atlas变体9,956文件（14.08小时），Souss变体3,378文件（6.75小时），Rif（22文件）和Kabyle（28文件）小规模子集；所有样本均配现代标准阿拉伯语文本及显式地区口音标签。

Conclusion: TutlAit数据集填补了摩洛哥塔马舍克语语音资源空白，提供带地区口音标签的大规模平行语音-文本语料，可直接支持该语言的自动语音识别、语音翻译及口音识别研究，为低资源语言语音技术建设提供了可复用的采集与质控流程范式。

Abstract: Tamazight (Amazigh) is, together with Arabic, one of the two official languages of Morocco, yet it remains severely under-resourced for speech technology: pub licly available labelled audio is scarce, generally lacks information on the regional variety spoken, and is often of uneven transcription quality. This article describes the TutlAit dataset, a corpus of Moroccan Tamazight speech paired with Modern Standard Arabic text and explicit regional accent labels. The data were collected with TutlAit, a purpose-built crowdsourcing web application (React 18 front end, Django 5 / Django REST Framework back-end, PostgreSQL database). Native speakers recruited through targeted LinkedIn and Instagram campaigns created an account, declared their regional variety (Atlas, Souss, Rif or other) and demographic information, and then contributed through two workflows: Text-to Audio, in which an Arabic sentence is displayed and the volunteer records its oral Tamazight rendering in the browser, and Audio-to-Text, in which a Tamazight excerpt is played and the volunteer types its Arabic transcription. A complemen tary set of segments was obtained from freely accessible Tamazight audiovisual media, segmented and annotated with ELAN and imported through a bulk CSV/ZIP pipeline. Every upload is converted server-side to 16kHz mono WAV, hashed with SHA-256 for duplicate rejection, checked for duration bounds and validated by an administrator. The dataset contains 13,384 audio files totalling 75,231 seconds (approximately 20.9 hours, about 3.01GB). The Atlas variety accounts for 9,956 files (14.08h) and the Souss variety for 3,378 files (6.75h); small Rif (22 files) and Kabyle (28 files) subsets are also included. The corpus can be reused for speech recognition, speech translation and accent identification for Moroccan Tamazight.

</details>


### [6] [Conformal Factuality Control for Multi-Hop Retrieval-Augmented Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38222)
*Muhammad Aimal Rehman,Chi-Kuang Yeh*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究了基于一致性预测的 claim-level factuality control 在多跳 RAG 中的有效性，发现随着一致性目标收紧，保留 claim 的事实支持率显著提升，但 claim 保留率和非空响应率大幅下降，表明名义可靠性需结合 claim 保留和弃权共同解读。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RAG 虽能引入外部证据，但检索到的上下文不保证生成的 claim 事实支持，尤其在多跳 RAG 中检索与推理经多个依赖阶段，问题更突出。此前提出的 claim-level 一致性 factuality control 在单跳 RAG 有效，但其在多跳 RAG 中的泛化能力未知。

Method: 将 split-conformal claim filtering 应用于多跳 RAG，在 HotpotQA、Natural Questions、TriviaQA 三个数据集上，使用 Llama 3.1 8B 和 GPT-4o-mini 两个模型进行评估，并设置单跳实验作为参考。

Result: 在所有六个多跳模型-数据集配置中，更严格的一致性目标一致提升保留 claim 完全被事实支持的响应比例：95% 目标下该比例为 95.80%-97.20%，而无过滤时仅 55.60%-76.03%。但改善具有强选择性：95% 目标下仅保留 4.41%-31.09% 的生成 claim，且仅 9.70%-51.40% 的响应保持非空。

Conclusion: 一致性 factuality control 能扩展至多跳 RAG，但名义可靠性必须与 claim 保留率和弃权率联合解读。

Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) can ground large language models in external evidence, but retrieved context does not guarantee that generated claims are factually supported. This problem is especially relevant in multi-hop RAG, where retrieval and reasoning proceed through multiple dependent stages. We study whether claim-level conformal factuality control, previously developed for RAG, remains effective in this setting. We apply split-conformal claim filtering to multi-hop RAG and evaluate it on HotpotQA, Natural Questions, and TriviaQA using Llama 3.1 8B and GPT-4o-mini, together with a single-hop reference experiment. Across all six multi-hop model-dataset configurations, increasingly stringent conformal targets consistently increase the fraction of responses whose retained claims are fully supported. At the 95% target, this rate ranges from 95.80% to 97.20%, compared with 55.60%-76.03% without filtering. However, the improvement is strongly selective: only 4.41%-31.09% of generated claims are retained and 9.70%-51.40% of responses remain non-empty at the 95% target. These results show that conformal factuality extends to multi-hop RAG, while demonstrating that nominal reliability must be interpreted jointly with claim retention and abstention.

</details>


### [7] [Framing the Narrative: Ideological Mimicry in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38256)
*Olivia Macmillan-Scott,Michael Jacobs,Nils Metternich,Mirco Musolesi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文研究大语言模型（LLM）在政治敏感议题上是否会因用户提示中的术语、前提和个人信息而改变立场，即“意识形态模仿”。实验发现，提示框架显著影响模型输出的政治立场，仅术语变化就在16.9%的匹配比较中反转立场，用户陈述的意识形态也会系统性地将回复拉向用户立场。这表明LLM的政治立场并非固定属性，而是依赖于交互语境，可能导致个性化的政治信息环境加剧社会分裂。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有评估通常将LLM的政治立场视为稳定属性，但真实用户通过术语、假设和个人语境传递政治信号。研究旨在探究这些信号是否导致LLM系统性地模仿用户意识形态，从而产生个性化的政治信息环境，强化既有分歧。

Method: 构建Poli-SHIFT数据集和评估框架，测试七个开放权重LLM在美、英、澳十个争议性政治议题上的表现。系统性操纵争议术语、带政治色彩的前提和用户信息，采用多项选择和开放文本两种格式收集回复，分析提示框架对模型立场的影响。

Result: 跨模型均发现稳健证据：提示框架塑造LLM输出的政治立场。仅改变术语即在16.9%的匹配比较中反转模型支持的立场；用户陈述的政治意识形态也系统性地将回复推向用户立场。

Conclusion: LLM的政治立场并非固定属性，而是随交互语境变化。随着LLM成为日益个性化的信息来源，这种依赖交互的适应性可能构建强化用户既有观点的政治信息环境，加剧社会分裂。

In particular, perceived severity appears to act as a cue for disclosure across both honesty and confidentiality scenarios. Abstract: The performance ceiling of an LLM team is constrained not only by individual model capabilities, but also by inter-member error resonance and predictive differences. *Yuhan Guo,Jinming Liu,Liang Xu,Ziqiang Li,Jianguo Huang,Zhicheng Wang,Hu Zhu,Qiuyu Chen,Yuntao Wei,Xin Jin,Wenjun Zeng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: EVOKE 是一种后训练方法，通过在固定状态下提供多样化目标来激发 LLM 智能体预训练期间内化的世界知识，从而提升多步决策的泛化能力和数据效率，无需额外的世界模型训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 智能体在数字环境中的多步决策泛化能力差。现有世界模型方法需要额外训练且预测误差会在规划中累积。实际上，LLM 预训练已内化大量世界知识，问题在于如何激发。典型后训练因单目标监督导致策略依赖表层上下文习惯，缺乏激发世界知识的压力。

Result: 在三种骨干模型上的多样任务中，EVOKE 提升了任务性能、未见环境泛化能力和数据效率。受控分析进一步揭示了性能增益的驱动因素。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as agents for multi-step decision-making, yet transfer poorly to unseen environments. World-model methods address this by training agents to predict future observations, at the cost of additional training and errors that compound when predictions are used for planning. However, for LLM agents operating in digital environments, much of this world knowledge is already internalized during pretraining, which shifts the problem from acquiring it to eliciting it. We argue that typical post-training provides little pressure for such elicitation, since supervision under a single goal at each visited state inadvertently drives policies to rely on superficial contextual habits. We introduce EVOKE, a post-training method that supplies this pressure through goal diversity at fixed states. Motivated by theory showing that an agent competent across diverse goals must encode a world model recoverable from its action preferences, EVOKE holds the environment state and interaction history fixed and ranks the same candidate actions under alternative goals, forcing action preferences to change, so that a policy relying on contextual habits or single-goal correlations cannot order them correctly. This implicitly elicits the policy's pretrained world knowledge to inform decisions. We evaluate EVOKE across diverse tasks in three backbones, demonstrating improved task performance, unseen environment generalization, and data efficiency. We further conduct controlled analyses to better understand what drives these gains. These findings offer a new perspective on eliciting internalized world knowledge for transferable action through direct decision supervision.

</details>

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: We present HalluScoring 2026, a shared task for evaluating hallucination detection and factual verification in Arabic question answering under challenging generalization settings. The shared task is organized into two main tasks, each comprising two subtasks, for a total of four subtasks. Task 1 evaluates binary hallucination detection, considering generalization to unseen questions (Subtask 1.1) and responses generated by unseen LLMs (Subtask 1.2). Task 2 extends the evaluation beyond detection by requiring the systems to additionally identify the correct factual answer from six related candidates, covering Islamic knowledge (Subtask 2.1) and general knowledge (Subtask 2.2). The shared task is based on two Arabic datasets: HalluScore and HalluTruthQA. A total of 13 teams participated in the shared task, 10 of which submitted system description papers. The results of Task 1 demonstrate that hallucination detection remains challenging under distribution shift, with the winning team achieving AUC-ROC test scores of 0.772 and 0.767 for Subtasks 1.1 and 1.2, respectively. For Task 2, the winning team achieved scores of 0.882 and 0.857 in the Islamic and general-knowledge subtasks, respectively, under assisted evaluation.

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Conversational safety evaluations often test language models with a single harmful prompt, even though real-world systems interact with users through long, adaptive conversations. This study examines whether models continue to respond safely when an adversarial user persists across multiple turns. We evaluate three open-weight, instruction-tuned models on two harmful prompts across different conversation lengths and random seeds. In each setting, a second language model acts as a persistent adversarial user, while a safety classifier labels every response as safe or unsafe. This decline appeared across models and continued well beyond the short interactions typically used in multi-turn safety evaluations. These results provide proof-of-concept evidence that strong single-turn safety does not necessarily persist during sustained adversarial interaction. They highlight the need for long-horizon evaluations and conversation-level safeguards that account for risk accumulating across turns.

</details>


### [14] [Doc2LoRA Provides Decodable Representations of Scientific Ideas](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38374)

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有论文向量表示虽支持检索，但混合点缺乏语义解释；作者希望让向量空间中的任意点（尤其是组合新颖性点）都能通过自然语言被询问和生成新想法。

Method: 训练 Doc-to-LoRA 超网络从论文生成 LoRA 适配器；引入可逆变换使嵌入同时适配检索任务；在 APS 物理论文上验证子领域平均点的标签生成、插值点的摘要生成及检索性能。

Result: 子领域平均点生成的标签比五种基线更接近官方名称；插值点生成的摘要随混合权重平滑过渡；可逆变换后的嵌入检索性能与 SPECTER2、EmbeddingGemma 持平、接近 SBERT。

Abstract: Representing scientific papers as points in a space lets us search for similar papers and inquire about how fields relate to one another and drive innovation. Beyond search, the vector space of papers invites generation: mixing papers through simple vector operations creates new points, mirroring combinatorial novelty, the recombination of existing ideas into new ones. However, a mixed point often represents an idea no paper has yet realized, with no papers nearby to identify the idea. We propose representing each paper by a LoRA adapter generated by the Doc-to-LoRA hypernetwork. Every point in the space, including mixtures, thus represents a large language model (LLM) open to questions and instructions in natural language. On papers from the American Physical Society (APS), we instruct the LLM at the average of each subfield to name the field in a few words and obtain labels closer to the official names than the labels of five baselines, as judged by word overlap and a panel of five LLM judges. We also ask the LLMs at points between two APS papers to write an abstract and obtain descriptions shifting from one paper to the other in step with the mixing weight. While Doc-to-LoRA is trained for generation, a small invertible transform makes the embeddings competitive for search, on par with SPECTER2 and EmbeddingGemma and close to SBERT. Because the transform is invertible, every point in the transformed space still maps back to an LLM. The embeddings thus serve both search and generation, enabling researchers to question the idea at any point in the space as a starting point for generating new ideas.

Abstract: Major venues now publish detailed rules about how authors, reviewers, and area chairs may use AI, and those rules differ by role, by task, and by what must be disclosed. Policy makes the governing rule an explicit input. Inference reports hypotheses, evidence, calibration regime, and uncertainty in place of verdicts such as "AI detected". Evaluation builds benchmarks from reproducible pipelines that generate compliant and non-compliant workflows, and reports true positive rate at a false positive rate the venue fixes in advance. We work the framework through peer review, where at plausible violation rates a detector at a strong operating point still flags more compliant authors than violating ones. TRACE - Target-Aware Retrieval, Attributed Evidence, and Contract-Constrained Extraction - addresses this gap with target-grouped retrieval, independent typed evidence localization, multimodal table extraction, schema-driven table construction, and fail-closed validation. It indexes 27,487 papers through passage, object, alias, citation, and dense representations while retaining the question target behind each signal. For tables, TRACE predicts the observation unit before extracting values and assembles rows with evaluator-compatible key normalization. Our audited selected clean-track artifact scores 0.760613 on the official 71-question test set, including 0.9728 paper F1, 0.6847 evidence F1, 0.9800 multiple-choice accuracy, 0.5423 table-row F1, and 0.3508 macro cell accuracy. On 11 public-development table records, a clean baseline and coordinate-aware visual fill obtain row F1 of 0.291 and 0.411, respectively; this diagnostic comparison includes fallback outputs and is not an official-test claim. ### [18] [The Backdrop Exposes What the World Around an Agent Costs It](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38469)
*Nusrat Jahan Lia,Shubhashis Roy Dipta*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: BACKDROP 是一个用于评估智能体在动态、多危害现实环境中鲁棒性的基准，通过在任务中植入四种常见危害（权威冒充、注入攻击、边界越界、故障重试），测试智能体在真实世界中的表现下限。实验表明，引入所有危害后，16 个模型的平均通过率从 69.5% 暴跌至 31.3%，最强模型跌幅最大；智能体虽能抵抗文本注入，但极易遵循他人未授权指令（46.4%），揭示了清洁环境评分仅为现实性能上限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体基准多在静态、干净的环境中测试，忽略了部署后环境会被其他人修改、包含恶意注入、跨应用请求或写入故障等现实干扰。论文旨在量化这些日常危害对智能体能力的实际削弱程度，建立更贴近真实部署的评估标准。

Method: 提出 BACKDROP 框架：给定任务及执行环境，依次单独及组合植入四种危害——Authority（他人消息覆盖用户指令）、Injection（记录中植入恶意文本重定向智能体）、Boundary（请求诱导智能体进入未授权应用）、Fault（写入失败未明确反馈时是否重试前校验）。保持指令与正确终态不变，在 3,678 个变体上评测 16 个模型。

Result: 全危害下平均通过率从 69.5% 降至 31.3%；最强模型 Claude Fable 5.1 从 96.6% 跌至 56.0%。仅统计植入文本到达智能体的运行，遵循他人消息的比例为 46.4%，遵循注入文本仅 20.3%，且该差距在所有 16 模型中一致。智能体已学会抵抗注入，但普遍易受未授权人为请求影响。

Conclusion: BACKDROP 形式化了智能体在清洁世界与现实世界的性能鸿沟，证明任务世界中的分数只是现实性能的上界。未来研发需重点加强对未授权指令的识别与拒绝、跨边界访问控制及故障后的状态确认能力。

Abstract: Agent benchmarks test agents in worlds that stay still. Deployed agents work in worlds that other people also change. Someone texts the agent to send the money elsewhere or an order confirmation asks it to reply with a door code. We present BACKDROP, which asks how much of an agent's capability in a clean world survives in such a world. BACKDROP takes a task along with the agents execution environment, and plants four everyday hazards in its world, one at a time and all together. The instruction and the correct end state stay the same. Each hazard asks one question. Authority: does a message from another person override the user? Injection: does text planted in a record redirect the agent? Boundary: does a request pull it into an app it was not given? Fault: after a write fails without saying whether it landed, does the agent check before it retries? Across 3,678 variants and 16 models, , the average pass rate falls from 69.5% to 31.3% once all four hazards are present; the strongest models fall furthest (Claude Fable 5.1 from 96.6% to 56.0%). Agents have learned to resist injected text but often follow other unauthorized requests of other people. With all four hazards present, and counting only runs where the planted text reached the agent, agents followed another person's message in 46.4% of runs and injected text in 20.3%. The gap is consistent throughout all 16 models. BACKDROP formalizes these gaps and shows how an agent's score in a task's world is a ceiling on real-world performance.

</details>

Abstract: Most clinical benchmarks evaluate language models (LMs) on diagnosis using complete case descriptions. In clinical practice, however, patients present information in different ways, and clinicians must obtain relevant history and determine which examinations are needed before reaching a diagnosis. Diagnostic accuracy alone therefore cannot establish whether an agent gathered essential information or conducted an appropriate clinical assessment. Furthermore, existing benchmarks lack professional clinicians' verification. To address this gap, we introduce KlinikeBench, a benchmark of 333 clinician-authored tasks, each providing an isolated sandbox environment with a virtual patient, clinical tools, and task-specific success criteria. Overall, KlinikeBench provides a testbed for evaluating the full clinical encounter and reveals a substantial gap between diagnostic accuracy and performance in interactive clinical assessment.

Abstract: Argument structure prediction (ASP) constructs complete argument structures from discourse by identifying argumentative units and their relations. Conclusion: PE混合架构报告的长上下文增益掩盖了本质的检索权衡：机制从位置检索向语义检索的转移解释了不同任务上的性能差异，这不是简单的长上下文能力提升，而是检索策略的根本性改变。

Abstract: Language models increasingly use architectures that vary attention span and positional encoding across layers, such as applying RoPE with sliding-window attention and NoPE with global attention (SWA NoPE). However, how these choices shape in-context retrieval remains unclear. To study this question, we take a mechanistic view, tracing how positional encoding (PE) choice shapes the internal mechanisms models use for in-context retrieval. Across 22 open-weight models spanning eight families, we find that standard RoPE models rely primarily on positional retrieval, while PE hybrids shift toward semantic retrieval. We further show on a controlled pre-training ablation that confining positional encoding to local layers produces this semantic shift, degrading representations of positional information. Finally, we show that the reported long-context gains of PE hybrids mask a retrieval trade-off: SWA NoPE improves over RoPE on multiple-target retrieval and QA, but degrades when distinguishing competing keys. We show that these behavioral differences better track the mechanism shift from positional toward semantic mechanisms than a uniform improvement in long-context retrieval.

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实世界医学知识持续演进，过时知识带来安全风险；现有评估聚焦事实回忆，无法反映新整合知识在实际任务中的可用性，亟需细粒度、多维度的评测体系。

Abstract: Constantly evolving real-world knowledge necessitates models to be updated continuously. Especially in medicine, as clinical evidence changes over time, outdated knowledge can pose safety risks. Existing evaluations of knowledge integration focus on factual recall, offering limited insight into whether newly integrated knowledge is actually usable. Our benchmark MedKIT (Medical Knowledge Integration and Transfer) provides a granular evaluation of how models integrate and apply knowledge under realistic sequences of clinical updates. Each instance corresponds to a factual update derived from clinical evidence, paired with targeted probes that assess transfer across lexical variation, relational transformations, compositional reasoning, and open-ended operationalization, as well as locality tests for knowledge preservation. Using MedKIT, we conduct a large-scale empirical study of 12 knowledge integration strategies across 5 diverse models, including both general-purpose and medical LLMs. Our results reveal a consistent gap between recall and usable knowledge: while most methods achieve strong gains on the original update task and under lexical variation, relational generalization is limited, and no method yields meaningful improvements on compositional or operational tasks. These findings highlight a fundamental challenge in knowledge integration and position MedKIT as a testbed for developing methods that make newly integrated knowledge more consistently usable across tasks and contexts.

</details>

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 专家编写技能成本高且未针对特定模型优化，现有自动技能优化需精心策划的分布内训练集，而新兴任务往往缺乏现成技能库和训练数据，亟需一种仅凭任务描述即可自动构建技能的方法。

Abstract: Skills are external artifacts that Large Language Models (LLMs) consume at inference time to improve their performance on specialized domains by incorporating relevant procedural and domain knowledge. Expert-authored skills are expensive to produce, and the resulting artifacts are not optimized for the specific model that consumes them, whose failure modes can vary with version, scale and training. In addition, emerging tasks may fall outside the scope of existing skill libraries, creating a need to develop new skills before curated training data become available. Recent works have explored automated skill optimization through reflection, but they require a curated, in-distribution training set, which users might not always have. To address these limitations, we present Prompt2Skill, a framework that builds skills from natural-language task description alone. From the prompt, the system derives a task specification, discovers or synthesizes datasets, and refines the skill in a closed loop of reflective editing. Abstract: Modern LLM agents increasingly tackle complex tasks through interactive, long-horizon exchanges with users, while existing benchmarks generally assume that users always accurately and sufficiently communicate a fixed intent. Abstract: Yorùbá is a tonal language in which contour tones pose persistent orthographic challenges. Conclusion: 提出的多语言实体标注器通过前沿模型标注微调、覆盖感知重放和边界修复，在隐私编辑任务上达到最优性能，同时保持高推理效率，代码和数据已开源，为多语言隐私保护提供了实用方案。

Abstract: Privacy redaction must remove personal information while preserving relationships expressed in text. We develop a multilingual named-entity tagger with fine-grained distinctions supporting varied redaction policies and methods for cheaply learning additional distinctions. We fine-tune a multilingual encoder with an affine span-tagging head on frontier-model annotations in 35 languages, replay mapped human gold with coverage-aware masking so unannotated types are not treated as negatives, and repair subword boundaries with a learned +/-1-character adjustment. Local LLMs fitting on a single 96-GB GPU underperformed as prompted annotators and frozen encoders, with encoding 30-95 times slower than XLM-R inference and prompted annotation roughly 180-1,100 times slower in the evaluated configurations. The encoder architecture delivers 4.9 times GLiNER2's CPU throughput. We release code, prompts and training recipes, with data-acquisition scripts and source links.

</details>

*Haibo Jin,Xinjie Li,Najmeh Sadoughi,Yang Liu,Yibo Wang,Zhu Liu,Yuzong Liu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: SMART 是一个自我进化的多智能体系统，用于长视频字幕翻译，通过测试时训练构建系列级记忆、动态路由和混合智能体层，结合术语验证、字幕约束验证和上下文检索工具，并采用评判-优化循环更新智能体提示和路由策略，在 Subtitle Arena 和 MuSC 基准上均取得最佳性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的单一 LLM 方法多为句子级，多智能体系统常采用静态工作流，难以适应场景复杂度和制作语境，无法有效处理跨剧集或整个系列的语篇和文化语境推理，且难以保持术语和风格一致性。

Method: SMART 在测试时训练阶段构建持久的系列级记忆，通过动态路由器和混合智能体层（配备术语验证、字幕约束验证、上下文检索工具）翻译部分句子；引入评判-优化循环，对候选译文评分并利用文本批评更新智能体提示和路由策略，无需重新训练底层 LLM；测试时推理阶段使用进化后的配置翻译剩余剧集。同时构建了 Subtitle Arena 基准（14 类型、2-198 集、1959-2023 年、15 目标语言）和 SubMQM 评价框架（7 维度、19 错误类别）。

Result: SMART 在 Subtitle Arena 的全部 15 个翻译方向上均获得最佳整体 MQM 得分，平均惩罚分较最强竞争智能体系统降低 6.9%；在公开 MuSC 基准上，在所有四个语言对上均取得最佳模型结果，且在人工评估中获得 4.50/5 的最高总分。

Conclusion: SMART 通过自我进化的多智能体架构和测试时自适应机制，有效解决了长视频字幕翻译中的跨语篇推理、术语一致性和风格保持问题，显著优于现有方法，并为该领域提供了大规模基准和细粒度评价框架。

Abstract: Long-form subtitle translation requires reasoning over discourse and cultural context spanning episodes or entire series, while maintaining consistent terminology and style. Existing single-LLM methods are largely sentence-level, and multi-agent systems often use static workflows that do not adapt to scene complexity or production context. During test-time training, SMART builds persistent series-level memory and translates a subset of sentences through a dynamic router and Mixture-of-Agents layer with tools for terminology verification, subtitle constraint validation, and contextual retrieval. A judge-refiner loop scores candidates and uses textual critiques to update agent prompts and routing policies without retraining the underlying LLMs. During test-time inference, the evolved configuration translates the remaining series. We also introduce Subtitle Arena, covering 14 genres, 2--198 episodes per series, production years 1959--2023, and 15 target locales, together with SubMQM, a subtitle-adapted MQM framework with seven dimensions and 19 error categories. SMART achieves the best overall MQM score in all 15 Subtitle Arena directions, reducing average penalty by 6.9% over the strongest competing agent system. On the public MuSC benchmark, SMART obtains the best model result across all four language pairs and also achieves the best human-evaluation result, with an overall score of 4.50/5.

</details>


### [34] [MetaSteer: Context-Conditioned, nonlinear Steering via Attention-Projection Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38718)
*Mehdi Jafari,Hao Xue,Flora Salim*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: MetaSteer是一种新型大语言模型引导方法，通过在注意力投影矩阵上应用非线性、上下文相关的干预，在零样本设置下实现跨概念和分布外上下文的可迁移引导，性能匹配或超越强基线。

  <summary>Details</summary>

Method: MetaSteer将引导建模为基于偏好的优化问题，在汇聚的偏好语料库上一次性训练低秩适配器，作用于注意力投影矩阵，产生随输入上下文变化的激活效果，无需线性概念几何假设。

Result: 在三个受控文本生成基准和三个智能体设定中，跨多个模型家族和规模评估，MetaSteer在零样本下匹配或超越强任务特定基线；文本生成引导强度与智能体引导性能正相关；隐状态轨迹表现出结构化、上下文相关的变化，同时部分保留局部动力学（速度、曲率）。

Abstract: Steering large language models typically relies on linear, context-independent interventions in activation space, an assumption that recent work has challenged and that can induce an information bottleneck when a fixed representation must encode many behavioral distinctions. We introduce MetaSteer, a method that learns nonlinear interventions with context-dependent effects and applies them to attention projection matrices, producing activation effects that vary with the input context by construction and requiring no linear concept-geometry assumption. Framed as preference-based optimization, MetaSteer is trained once on a pooled preference corpus and transferred zero-shot to unseen concepts and out-of-distribution contexts. We find that, despite using low-rank adapters, MetaSteer induces structured, context-dependent changes in hidden-state trajectories while partially preserving aspects of their local trajectory dynamics, including velocity and curvature. Across the evaluated settings, stronger text-generation steering is associated with stronger agentic steering performance. </details>


### [35] [Training LLM Judges from Language Feedback via Position-Selective Self-Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38792)
*Ilgee Hong,Changlong Yu,Zhenghao Xu,Xin Liu,Yuwei Zhang,Qin Lu,Bing Yin,Tuo Zhao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文研究如何利用自然语言反馈训练 LLM 判断器，特别是针对主观任务。现有基于结果的 RL（如 GRPO）仅用最终裁决的标量奖励监督，忽略了准则选择标记和丰富的语言反馈。作者提出基于教师-学生熵位移的位置掩码自蒸馏方法：识别“语境锐化”（教师概率集中于单一准则表达）与“语境扩散”（教师概率分布于多个备选准则）两种模式，保留低熵位移位置（扩散模式）以促进语义理解，屏蔽高熵位移位置（锐化模式）以避免死记硬背。实验表明，该方法在主观子类别上比基于结果的 RL 高 2-9 个百分点，在客观任务上保持竞争力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于结果的 RL（如 GRPO）仅以最终裁决的准确性提供单一标量奖励，无法对准则选择标记给予单独信用，也忽略了偏好标签天然附带的语言反馈（如偏好理由）。自蒸馏虽能利用语言反馈提供密集监督，但并非所有位置都包含同等有用的信号。需要一种机制自动区分有利于语义理解的位置和导致死记硬背的位置，从而提升主观任务的分布外泛化能力。

Method: 1. 采用自蒸馏框架：同一模型在条件化语言反馈后作为教师，为学生提供逐位置的密集监督。2. 计算教师与学生在每个位置的熵位移，识别两种模式：语境锐化（教师概率集中于单一反馈对齐的准则表达）和语境扩散（教师概率分布于多个反馈对齐的备选准则）。3. 将锐化视为鼓励记忆特定准则表达，扩散视为促进语义理解。4. 基于熵位移分布的低尾部设计位置掩码，保留扩散模式位置，屏蔽锐化模式位置。5. 仅在保留位置上计算蒸馏损失训练判断器。

Result: 在主观评估子类别上，提出的位置掩码自蒸馏判断器比基于结果的 RL 判断器高出 2-9 个百分点；在客观任务上保持竞争力。消融实验证实，屏蔽高熵位移位置能显著提升分布外泛化，优于朴素自蒸馏。

Abstract: Understanding multi-perspective alternative narratives requires identifying how their information agrees, conflicts, or differs across sources. Abstract: Uncontrolled repetition can prolong autoregressive generation in large language models (LLMs) and enable resource consumption attacks. Prior analyses of repetitive generation have identified strongly activated features in intermediate and late layers. However, how uncontrolled repetition activity emerges and develops before becoming prominent in these layers remains insufficiently understood. In this paper, we investigate this question primarily in large vision-language models (LVLMs), which support a richer set of uncontrolled repetitions through both visual and textual inputs. We propose Tokenwise Residual Comparison (TRC), a method that identifies and localizes anomalies associated with repetition from residual dynamics during generation. Our analysis further shows that repetition semantics emerge in shallow layers and propagate through the residual stream, disrupting normal representations. Our work broadens the study of repetitive generation from its prominent internal representations to earlier opportunities for intervention, providing insights for mitigating resource consumption attacks.

These results show that fingerprint detectability should not be conflated with source authenticity, and that text-only attribution can provide misleading evidence of model identity under targeted rewriting, even when it is accurate on unmodified text.

Abstract: Scaling attention parameters can improve language model quality, but retaining full token histories makes additional heads costly at long contexts. Each head retains only its assigned tokens and performs causal attention within this subsequence. It remains compatible with GQA and existing sparse attention mechanisms. We hope this work offers a new path for scaling attention, with parameter scaling directly enabling context scaling.

Abstract: End-to-end accuracy on compositional tasks records how often MLLMs fail, but cannot distinguish whether a failure reflects an intrinsic deficit in the targeted capability or a cascading error from an upstream prerequisite. Abstract: Working agents need to read diverse files, coordinate tools, and produce deliverables. Abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) traces often serve as a proxy for how Large Language Models (LLMs) arrive at their answers. Experiments show that we can substantially improve CoT parametric faithfulness while maintaining or improving the task accuracy. We provide rich analysis, such as their generalization patterns. Abstract: LLM services are billed per token and context windows are measured in tokens, yet the number of tokens needed for the same content varies across languages. In a controlled experiment (BPE, Europarl, 50k vocabulary), adding French to tokenizer training data quickly reduces the premium, with diminishing returns and a growing cost for English.   <summary>Details</summary>

Conclusion: 修辞鲁棒性是独立评估目标，科学核心审稿设计可有效提升该指标，为 AI 辅助同行评审提供新方向。

Abstract: AI reviewers can assign different judgments to manuscripts that report the same science in different wording, potentially rewarding rhetorical optimization over scientific improvement. We formulate Rhetorical Robustness as the joint requirement of stability across content-preserving rewrites and discrimination across papers. We introduce RobustReview, a controlled full-manuscript benchmark with 1,260 manuscript versions, and evaluate 30 reviewer configurations. The benchmark reveals false robustness, where low rewrite sensitivity coincides with score collapse across papers, and shows that human alignment and rhetorical robustness rank reviewers differently. Moreover, the evaluated content-focused prompting protocol does not consistently improve robustness across backbones. Motivated by these findings, we introduce SciCore, a dual-branch reviewer that averages a full-manuscript judgment with a judgment based on an extracted, structured science core. This design combines manuscript-level assessment with a content-normalized view intended to reduce rhetorical sensitivity. In our primary GPT-5.5 comparison, SciCore achieves a leading joint stability-discrimination profile among the benchmarked reviewers while maintaining competitive human alignment. These results identify rhetorical robustness as a distinct evaluation target and demonstrate the potential of science-core review to improve it.

</details>

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Recent advances in large language models have made automatic game generation increasingly feasible, yet reliably improving generated games beyond a playable version remains challenging. Concretely, a local explore-diagnose-improve loop broadly explores the executable game, diagnoses and prioritizes discovered issues, and performs evidence-grounded revision, where an evolving checklist continually accumulates new testing and improvement guidance. A global loop tracks overall quality, preserves the best checkpoint, and detects saturation or regression over long-horizon development. Beyond test-time improvement, RSIGame further internalizes successful development experience into the generator through training. Across 140 GameCraft-Bench tasks, two game engines, and five generators, RSIGame consistently improves game quality under matched development budgets. Notably, experience internalization enables Qwen3.8-27B to reach 61.38 on Godot and 58.53 on Phaser, exceeding GPT-5.5 one-shot scores while reducing Qwen's generation tokens by 11 times.

Abstract: A large language model (LLM) can rate depression severity directly from a social media post or mark which clinical criteria the post shows and let code turn the count into a label. Neither model's gain is significant, with or without recalibrating chain-of-thought on the same labels. With thresholds fixed a priori from PHQ-9's criteria, extraction shows no gain on either corpus, even where models mark over two criteria per post. The 9B model behaves differently on a corpus from depression communities. It labels most posts severe, whether prompted directly or with chain-of-thought, while the a priori rule beats both without labels. After chain-of-thought is recalibrated on the same labels, no significant gap remains, consistent with a calibration effect. Yet higher ordinal agreement does not ensure better detection of severe cases. PHQ-9 criteria extraction misses most severe posts, and moving from direct prompting to chain-of-thought and then to extraction increases misses in nearly all comparisons. On the primary corpus, a relabeled stress dataset, a model using that dataset's own features, including word counts from the text, is not significantly different from frontier criteria extraction under the a priori rule.

### [55] [CORE: Conflict-Oriented Reasoning Elimination for Verifiable Language-Model Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39069)
*Siyu Song,Rui Xu,Jia Lin,Kai Liu,Weifang Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出CORE，一种用于测试时推理系统的搜索控制器，通过从验证器获取认证冲突核、回跳到冲突核中的最新决策并缓存冲突，显著减少验证器调用次数并提升推理成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有测试时推理系统在遇到失败时通常重启或修订最新步骤，即使错误源于更早的决策，导致搜索效率低下且可能重复相同错误。

Method: CORE从验证器请求认证冲突核（certified conflict core），回跳到该冲突核中的最新决策点，并缓存冲突以避免重复。理论上在合理假设下（合理验证、有限分支深度、穷尽提议），无上限搜索完备且不剪枝有效解。

Result: 在2000个植入图着色实例上，CORE较时间顺序修复将中位验证器调用减少39.8%（30变量）和35.0%（36变量）；缓存进一步改进回跳。在五个推理任务上，CORE配合Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct达75.9%平均成功率，配合Qwen3-8B达84.2%，均优于Tree of Thoughts（分别为72.5%和81.8%），且验证器调用与生成token均更少。

Conclusion: 实验证明利用认证失败解释指导语言模型搜索具有显著价值，CORE在保证完备性的前提下大幅提升搜索效率与成功率。

Abstract: Test-time reasoning systems often respond to failure by restarting or revising the latest step, even when an earlier decision caused the error. We introduce CORE, a search controller that requests a certified conflict core from a verifier, backjumps to the latest decision in that core, and caches the conflict to avoid repeating it. Under sound verification, finite branching and depth, and exhaustive proposals, the uncapped search is complete and never prunes a valid solution. On 2,000 planted graph-coloring instances with matched proposals and an exact verifier, CORE reduces median verifier calls by 39.8% at 30 variables and 35.0% at 36 variables relative to chronological repair; caching further improves on backjumping alone. Across five reasoning tasks, CORE achieves 75.9% mean success with Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and 84.2% with Qwen3-8B, compared with 72.5% and 81.8% for Tree of Thoughts. It also uses fewer verifier calls and generated tokens on both backbones. These results show the value of using certified failure explanations to direct language-model search.

</details>


### [56] [LexReward: A Taxonomy-Driven Reward Framework for Legal Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39071)
*Yida Cai,Xin Dai,Bingxiang He,Huiyuan Xie,Yuxiao Ye,Zhenghao Liu,Yang Bai,Zhiyuan Liu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出 LexReward，一个基于分类学的法律奖励建模框架，将法律回答质量分为 Style（文风）、Element（要素）、Chain（推理链）三个维度，并为每个维度制定评分细则。实验表明，基于细则的奖励能可靠区分回答质量，DPO 训练提升三个维度表现，且训练出的 LexRM 在无需参考答案的情况下，通过强化学习在各自维度上提升策略性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有法律奖励方法多依赖粗粒度整体判断，缺乏领域特异性和可解释性，无法捕捉法律回答的多维质量（如法律术语规范性、要素完备性、推理逻辑性）。因此需要一个细粒度、可解释、领域特定的奖励建模框架。

Method: 构建三维分类学：Style（词汇与句法质量）、Element（法律主体、事实、法条、判决要素）、Chain（推理顺序、完整性、正确性、非冗余性）。为每个维度编写评分细则，明确评价标准与质量等级。利用细则生成成对偏好数据，用于 Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) 和奖励模型训练，得到 LexRM。

Result: 细则奖励能可靠区分不同质量的法律回答；DPO 训练在 Style、Element、Chain 三个维度均显著提升性能；各维度专用 LexRM 在无需参考答案的情况下，通过强化学习在对应维度上提升策略性能；维度级分析验证了分类学与奖励构建的有效性。

Conclusion: LexReward 通过分类学驱动的细粒度奖励建模，解决了法律语言模型奖励信号缺乏领域特异性和可解释性的问题，实现了多维度质量的精准评估与优化，为法律 AI 的对齐提供了有效范式。

Abstract: Legal language models require reward signals that capture not only answer correctness but also the multidimensional quality of legal responses. Existing reward methods, however, often rely on coarse-grained holistic judgments, providing limited domain specificity and interpretability. We introduce LexReward, a taxonomy-driven framework for legal reward modeling. LexReward characterizes legal response quality along three complementary dimensions: Style, covering lexical and syntactic quality; Element, assessing legal subjects, facts, statutes, and decisions; and Chain, evaluating the order, completeness, correctness, and non-redundancy of legal reasoning. For each dimension, we develop rubrics that specify evaluation criteria and quality levels. The resulting rewards are used to construct pairwise preference data for Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) and reward-model training. Experiments show that the rubric-based rewards reliably distinguish legal responses of different quality and that DPO training on the preference data improves performance across all three dimensions. The learned reward models, LexRM, also support effective downstream optimization: each dimension-specific reward model improves policy performance in its corresponding dimension through reinforcement learning, without requiring reference answers at reward time. Dimension-wise analyses further support the effectiveness of the proposed taxonomy and reward construction.

</details>

*Yutong Hu,Jinho Choi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出基于大语言模型的框架，在IEMOCAP数据集上进行离散情感识别和VAD连续维度评估，利用语音线索的自然语言描述增强模型。实验表明，LoRA微调的LLaMA模型显著优于提示工程的GPT模型，最佳模型在Valence维度上达到CCC 0.7822的新SOTA。消融研究显示音频文本描述对小模型提升明显（+3.5-3.6加权F1），对大模型贡献微乎其微，且VAD各维度性能差异与标注者一致性层级相符。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管对话情感识别研究广泛，但将大语言模型应用于多模态对话中的连续维度情感评估（如VAD）尚未充分探索。现有工作多关注离散情感分类，缺乏对语音声学线索与语言模型结合的系统研究，以及对不同规模模型在零样本、少样本和微调设定下表现的对比。

Method: 提出LLM-based框架，采用SpeechCueLLM方法将声学线索转为自然语言描述融入模型。在IEMOCAP上评估六个模型（涵盖LLaMA、GPT、Qwen家族），对比零样本提示、少样本提示和LoRA微调三种范式。任务包括离散情感识别和VAD三维连续回归。

Abstract: Emotion recognition in conversation has been widely studied, but applying Large Language Models (LLMs) to continuous dimensional emotion evaluation in multimodal dialogue remains largely unexplored. We propose an LLM-based framework that performs discrete emotion recognition and Valence-Arousal-Dominance (VAD) dimensional evaluation on IEMOCAP, incorporating acoustic cues as natural language descriptions following the SpeechCueLLM approach. We evaluate six models spanning the LLaMA, GPT, and Qwen families under zero-shot prompting, few-shot prompting, and LoRA fine-tuning. LoRA fine-tuned LLaMA models substantially outperform prompt-engineered GPT models on both tasks despite GPT's larger scale, a gap we attribute to domain adaptation rather than model capacity. Our best model achieves a Valence CCC of 0.7822, a new state-of-the-art on IEMOCAP. Ablation studies confirm that textual audio descriptions meaningfully improve smaller models (+3.5 to 3.6 weighted F1) while contributing little for the largest model, suggesting audio cues are most valuable when linguistic capacity is limited. The performance asymmetry across VAD dimensions closely mirrors the annotator agreement hierarchy in IEMOCAP's own annotations.

</details>


### [58] [False Frontiers: Diagnosing and Mitigating Co-Cheating in Self-Evolving Search Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39102)
*Meijia Chen,Hao Li,Zheng Lu,Hongshan Lin,Junbai Tian,Yichen Liu,Zijun Tian,Yufan Zou,Shuhan Sun,Hanxin Chen,Zeyu Zhang,Weizhi Du,Yueting Li,Tianyu Shi,Alaa Khamis*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出 CrossFit 方法解决自进化搜索代理中的共谋作弊问题：通过将源文档分为 A/B 两组，交叉使用不同组训练的求解器评分，打破提议者与求解器的错误共识，显著降低虚假一致率并提升下游搜索基准表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自进化搜索代理通过联合优化提议器和求解器构建训练课程，但存在共谋作弊失效模式：两者越来越多地达成共同错误，导致内部奖励提升而外部正确性不增甚至下降。事后审计显示该问题随自进化轮次加剧，伪标签正确率停滞或下降。

Method: 主要方法 CrossFit：将提议器的源文档划分为 A、B 两组；由仅在 B 上训练的辅助求解器对 A 生成的问题评分，反之亦然。交叉拟合的一致性决定提议器奖励，使得同源伪标签无法通过反馈求解器复现，同时保持原始求解器更新规则不变。辅助基线 MSV：对同一模型查询三次（含源/不含源）决定任务准入并替换不可靠伪标签。

Result: 在 Qwen3.5-4B 和 9B 上：MSV 将虚假一致质量从 6.1%→5.7% 和 8.8%→7.2%；CrossFit 进一步降至 3.0% 和 3.7%。重放相同提议并排除源反馈可进一步降至 0.4% 和 0.1%。七个下游搜索基准上，CrossFit 较标准耦合自进化平均提升 8.8/8.4 分，较 Search-R1 提升 8.7/7.8 分（4B/9B）。

Conclusion: CrossFit 通过交叉拟合机制有效缓解共谋作弊，大幅降低虚假一致率并显著提升下游搜索性能，优于 MSV 等事后验证方法，为自进化搜索代理提供了更可靠的课程构建范式。

Abstract: Self-evolving search agents build their own training curricula by jointly optimizing a proposer that generates questions and a solver that answers them. This closed loop introduces a failure mode we call co-cheating: the proposer and solver increasingly agree on shared errors, so internal reward improves without a matching gain in external correctness. A post-hoc audit against source evidence shows co-cheating growing more severe over successive rounds of self-evolution, with pseudo-label correctness stagnating or declining even as the in-loop training signal improves. The most direct mitigation is to verify proposals before training: we introduce multi-sample verification (MSV), which queries the same model three times with the source and three times without it to decide task admission and replace unreliable pseudo-labels. MSV partially reduces false agreement but leaves substantial residual co-cheating and costs six extra labeler generations per candidate. These limitations motivate CrossFit, our main method: it partitions the proposer's source documents into groups A and B; questions generated from A are scored by an auxiliary solver trained only on B, and vice versa. The cross-fitted agreement determines proposer reward, so a same-source pseudo-label cannot be reproduced through the feedback solver, while the original solver's update rule is unchanged. Rerunning the loop with Qwen3.5-4B and Qwen3.5-9B, MSV reduces false-agreement mass from 6.1% to 5.7% and from 8.8% to 7.2%, whereas CrossFit reduces it to 3.0% and 3.7%. Replaying identical proposals with source-excluded feedback further reduces false agreement to 0.4% and 0.1%, isolating feedback ancestry from curriculum changes. Across seven downstream search benchmarks, CrossFit improves average performance over standard coupled self-evolution by 8.8 and 8.4 points and over Search-R1 by 8.7 and 7.8 points at 4B and 9B.

</details>


### [59] [Bongard: Training Machine Intuition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39111)
*Li Ding,Haidi Jin,Chen Ji*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 Bongard，一个开放权重的 System One 模型，将机器直觉视为独立能力进行设计和训练。采用 T5Gemma 2 4B-4B 编码器-解码器架构，编码器双向读取状态与指令，多个解码器分支共享编码，实现一次读取多次判断。三阶段训练（监督判断、语义关系、行动结果）在单张 Blackwell GPU 上更新 70.9 亿参数。联合嵌入后训练将重述准确率从 75.7% 提升至 85.9%，沙盒阶段通过动作回合和精确神谕学习结果分布，将冻结沙盒面板准确率从 50.6% 提升至 64.8%。在 DecisionBench 上达到 78.05% 准确率，位列 61 个系统第 4 名。单张 RTX PRO 6000 上短请求中位延迟 36 ms，同一状态 32 个问题仅需 221 ms。证明机器直觉可通过表示学习和结果反馈系统性训练，为高吞吐决策工作负载提供开放高效的替代方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类智能严重依赖后天直觉：无需显式展开每个中间步骤即可识别模式和判断情境。现有系统多将直觉隐含在大模型生成中，缺乏专门针对直觉能力的架构设计与训练范式。需要一种高效、开放、可系统训练的机器直觉模型，用于高吞吐决策任务。

Method: 1. 架构：T5Gemma 2 4B-4B 编码器-解码器。编码器双向读取状态与问题指令，多个解码器分支共享编码表示，实现一次状态读取支持多次判断。训练头直接输出候选概率，无需生成文本。2. 三阶段训练：第一阶段监督判断，第二阶段语义关系，第三阶段行动结果；每阶段在单张 Blackwell GPU 上全参数更新 70.9 亿参数。3. 联合嵌入后训练提升重述鲁棒性。4. 沙盒阶段利用动作回合与精确神谕学习结果分布。

Result: 联合嵌入后训练将保留重述准确率从 75.7% 提升至 85.9%。沙盒阶段将冻结沙盒面板准确率从 50.6% 提升至 64.8%。DecisionBench 基准上 23,900 个决策达 78.05% 准确率，在 61 个公开系统中排名第 4。单张 RTX PRO 6000 上短请求中位延迟 36 ms，同一状态 32 个问题仅 221 ms。

Conclusion: Bongard 证明机器直觉可通过表示学习和结果反馈系统性训练，提供开放、高效的高吞吐决策替代方案，展示了将直觉作为独立能力进行架构设计与分阶段训练的可行性。

Abstract: Human intelligence relies heavily on learned intuition: recognising patterns and judging situations without explicitly unfolding every intermediate step. We introduce Bongard, an open-weight System One model that treats machine intuition as an independent capability to design and train. A T5Gemma 2 4B-4B encoder-decoder separates reading the evidence from making judgments. The encoder reads the state bidirectionally together with the question instructions, and separate decoder branches share this encoding, so many judgments about the same situation require only one reading of the state. A trained head returns probabilities over the supplied candidates without generating text. Training proceeds in three stages, from supervised judgments to semantic relationships to action outcomes, and each stage updates all 7.09 billion trainable parameters on one Blackwell GPU. Joint-embedding post-training raises accuracy on held-out rephrasings from 75.7% to 85.9%. A sandbox stage then learns outcome distributions from action rollouts and exact oracles, raising accuracy on a frozen sandbox panel from 50.6% to 64.8%. On DecisionBench, the final model reaches 78.05% accuracy over 23,900 decisions and ranks fourth of 61 systems in the public comparison. On one RTX PRO 6000, its median latency is 36 ms for short requests, and 32 questions about one state take 221 ms. Bongard demonstrates that machine intuition can be systematically trained via representation learning and outcome feedback, providing an open, efficient alternative for high-throughput decision workloads.

</details>


### [60] [Diagnosing On-Policy Self-Distillation for Reasoning Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39118)
*Yang Li,Gongle Xue,Yuheng Yuan,Yijia Guo,Shizhe Zhang,Liwen Hu,Lei Ma*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文通过控制实验和token级分析，系统诊断了on-policy self-distillation (OPSD)在数学推理任务上的表现，发现OPSD仅在极窄的兼容性条件下能提升推理能力，否则会导致无效的长度增长、性能稳定下降甚至行为崩塌；教师信号由推理模式对齐和完整教师前缀决定，而非单纯依赖特权语义，且信号不稳定、无法预测下游性能，结论认为OPSD是一种敏感算法，而非普适可靠的推理增强后训练方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: OPSD作为一种无需外部奖励或独立强教师的自我蒸馏方法，因其潜在提升语言模型推理能力而受到关注，但其在语言推理中的行为表现尚不清晰，既有报告显示适度收益，也有出现行为崩塌，因此需要系统性诊断其有效性边界与失效机制。

Method: 跨0.6B–8B参数规模模型开展控制实验与token级分析，剖析教师信号形成机制，考察推理模式对齐、完整教师前缀对信号的影响，评估OPSD在不同兼容性条件下的推理表现，并追踪token级信号稳定性与下游性能的相关性。

Result: 教师信号主要由推理模式对齐与完整教师前缀塑造，而非仅靠特权语义；OPSD仅在极窄兼容性区间内提升推理，超出该区间则出现无效长度增长、稳定性能下降或行为崩塌；token级分析显示教师信号不稳定且无法预测下游性能。

Conclusion: OPSD是一种高度敏感的算法，而非普遍可靠的推理能力提升后训练方法，其有效性强依赖于特定的模型-任务兼容性条件，实际部署需谨慎评估适用边界。

Abstract: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) has attracted growing interest as a promising approach to improve the reasoning ability of language models. Without external rewards nor a separate stronger teacher, the self-teacher with privileged information could provide dense signals on student's trajectories. However, its behavior in language reasoning remains unclear, with reported outcomes ranging from modest gains to behavioral collapse. In this work, we diagnose OPSD for mathematical reasoning across models spanning 0.6B--8B parameters. We conduct controlled experiments and token-level analyses to fully delve into OPSD. We point out that teacher's signal is shaped by reasoning-mode alignment and the complete teacher prefix, rather than by privileged semantics alone. OPSD improves reasoning only in narrow compatibility regimes. Otherwise, it produces ineffective length growth, stable degradation, or behavioral collapse. Token-level analysis shows that teacher's signal is not stable and does not predict downstream performance. Based on these results, we argue that OPSD is a sensitive algorithm rather than a generally reliable reasoning-improvement post-training method.

</details>


### [61] [DAGent: Evaluate-then-Grow Planning for Deep Research Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39154)
*Hanwen Liu,Yuanfu Sun,Qiaoyu Tan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: DAGent 是一种基于有向无环图（DAG）的多智能体框架，采用 Evaluate-then-Grow 增量规划策略，通过 Orchestrator 根据完成节点的置信度与不确定性信号逐批次扩展任务图，并引入层级上下文层和结构化强化学习算法 DAGRPO，在多个深度研究基准上显著超越现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的 DAG-based 多智能体系统采用 Plan-then-Patch 策略：在执行前实例化任务级计划，仅在失败或证据缺失后修补图结构。这种策略在深度研究任务中表现脆弱，因为系统在证据最薄弱时做出最强承诺，后续修订会在本不该规划的分支上浪费计算资源。

Method: DAGent 提出 Evaluate-then-Grow 增量规划：Orchestrator 根据已完成节点的置信度与不确定性信号，逐批次增长任务图。层级上下文层默认传播紧凑的 QueryDocs，同时保留完整执行轨迹以供按需召回。记录的 DAG 拓扑提供结构化 RL 信号，DAGRPO 将 GRPO 改造为拓扑条件下的 Executor 回放信用分配，并对 Orchestrator 计划施加结构合规正则化。

Result: 在 BrowseComp-Plus、GAIA、xbench-DeepSearch 三个基准上，DAGent 在 Qwen3-235B-A22B 规模下分别比最强开源基线高出 5.3、5.8、2.0 分；优势在四个开源骨干模型上复现，并延伸至 GPT-5（327K 上下文）。在 Qwen3-8B 规模下，DAGRPO 比同预算 outcome-only GRPO 基线平均 Pass@1 提升 3.0 分。同架构对比显示，evidence-conditioned 规划在更低的 per-task token、tool-call 和 step 开销下达到更高准确率。

Conclusion: DAGent 通过基于证据的增量规划和结构化强化学习，有效解决了深度研究任务中 Plan-then-Patch 的脆弱性，实现了更高的准确率和更低的资源消耗，并在多种模型规模和基准上展现出一致的优势。

Abstract: Deep research tasks require agents to navigate large knowledge spaces, synthesize evidence across many sources, and adapt their plans as findings emerge. Directed acyclic graph (DAG)-based multi-agent systems suit this setting because they support parallel execution and isolate each sub-task within a focused dependency context. Yet existing DAG-based agents instantiate a task-level plan before execution and repair the graph only after failures or missing evidence are observed. This Plan-then-Patch strategy is brittle for deep research: the system commits most strongly when its evidence is weakest, and later revisions waste computation on branches that should not have been planned. We propose DAGent, a DAG-based multi-agent framework with Evaluate-then-Grow incremental planning: an Orchestrator grows the task graph one batch at a time, conditioning each expansion on confidence and uncertainty signals from completed nodes. A hierarchical context layer propagates compact QueryDocs by default while preserving full execution traces for on-demand recall. The recorded DAG topology admits structural RL signals that outcome-only recipes cannot define; DAGRPO, a GRPO adaptation, injects topology-conditioned credit on Executor rollouts and a structural compliance regularization on Orchestrator plans. Across BrowseComp-Plus, GAIA, and xbench-DeepSearch, DAGent surpasses the strongest open-source baseline by 5.3 / 5.8 / 2.0 points at the Qwen3-235B-A22B scale, and the lead replicates across four open-source backbones and extends to GPT-5 at 327K context. At the Qwen3-8B scale, DAGRPO improves over a same-budget outcome-only GRPO baseline by 3.0 average Pass@1 points. A same-architecture comparison shows that evidence-conditioned planning reaches higher accuracy at lower per-task token, tool-call, and step footprints than its Plan-then-Patch counterpart. Code: https://github.com/hanwenliu6825/DAGent

</details>

Abstract: Trustworthy Legal AI requires systems that can answer legal questions while grounding their responses in authoritative sources. However, existing Vietnamese legal benchmarks provide limited coverage of real-world legal consultations. We introduce \textbf{ViLegalExpert}, a large-scale benchmark constructed from authentic citizen--lawyer consultations, containing over \textbf{172K} questions across \textbf{34 legal domains}, together with professional answers and expert-verified legal evidence. ViLegalExpert supports legal information retrieval, extractive QA, and abstractive QA. ### [63] [RAIM: Robust Aggregation of Inexpensive Models for Hallucination Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39229)
*Elia Onofri,Roberto Di Pietro*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 RAIM，一种将多个廉价开放权重 LLM 判官（4-9B）聚合以替代昂贵专有前沿模型（如 Claude Sonnet）的方案。实验显示，聚合面板在八个忠实性基准上保留了前沿模型 93% 的 Cohen's κ，平衡准确率仅平均下降 2.9 点，推理成本仅为前沿模型的 1/64，且仅需 50-100 条标注数据一次性校准。聚合是否有效取决于成员间的错误相关性，可通过校准集免费审计判断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 忠实性自动评估越来越依赖大语言模型作为判官，但最可靠的判官是专有前沿模型，成本高昂且不适合高吞吐监控。研究旨在探究：多个廉价开放权重判官能否通过聚合替代前沿模型？替代会牺牲什么性能？何时值得进行这种替代？

Method: 提出 RAIM（Robust Aggregation of Imperfect Members）聚合方案：采用交叉拟合堆叠逻辑回归，结合一个可采纳性测试，该测试仅从成员自身输出中读取，识别何时聚合优于最佳单一成员且仍接近前沿判官。实例化时使用来自不同模型家族的十个判官，在八个忠实性基准上评测。

Result: 对比 Claude Sonnet：面板保留中位 93% 的 Cohen's κ，平均平衡准确率仅让步 2.9 点；成对差异显示在一个基准上显著改进，三个基准上显著变差（仅两个非微小），四个未决。推理价格为前沿模型的 1/64，仅需一次 50-100 条标注的域内校准。面板在专用检测器的主场基准上也具竞争力（与 GPT-4o 相差 1.3 准确率点，与 LLM-AggreFact 顶尖相差 1.9 点），在作者构建的 grounded 集上击败最强重跑基线 6 点。聚合收益取决于成员特性：多个强成员在不同样本上犯错时，面板超越最佳成员并逼近前沿；单一成员主导时，堆叠器恢复领先者，前沿仅在此处仍有实质领先。两种条件均可从校准集零成本读取。

Conclusion: 廉价开放权重判官面板经 RAIM 聚合后，可在校准审计允许的场景下替代专有前沿模型，以极低成本实现近似前沿的忠实性评估性能，适合高吞吐监控部署。

Abstract: Automatic evaluation of faithfulness increasingly relies on a large language model acting as a judge, yet the most reliable judges are proprietary frontier models, costly and ill-suited to high-throughput monitoring. We investigate whether a panel of cheap open-weight judges (4--9B) can be aggregated to stand in for a frontier one, what the substitution sacrifices, and when it is worth making. We propose RAIM, an aggregation scheme robust to the members' correlated errors, coupling a cross-fitted stacked logistic regression with an admissibility test that, read from the members' own outputs, identifies when aggregating them improves on their best member and stays within reach of the frontier judge. We instantiate RAIM with ten judges from disjoint families across eight faithfulness benchmarks. Against Claude Sonnet, the panel retains a median 93% of its Cohen's $κ$ and gives up only 2.9 points of balanced accuracy on average; read as paired differences, it clearly improves on one benchmark and clearly worsens on three (only two by a non-negligible margin), leaving four unresolved. At a sixty-fourth of the frontier's inference price, the operative expense is a one-time in-domain calibration on 50--100 labelled records. The panel is also competitive with purpose-trained detectors on their home benchmarks (within 1.3 accuracy points of GPT-4o and 1.9 of the LLM-AggreFact leader), and beats the strongest one we reran by 6 points on our grounded sets. Whether aggregation pays depends on the members themselves: where several capable members err on different items, the panel improves on its best judge and approaches the frontier; where one dominates, the stacker recovers the leader, and only there does the frontier remain materially ahead. Both conditions are read off the calibration set at no further cost, so a cheap panel can stand in for a frontier one wherever this audit admits it.

</details>

  <summary>Details</summary>

Method: 1. 提出双向几何诊断：计算提取基与解嵌入矩阵右奇异向量主导方向的重叠能量，并引入面向输出的正向控制（如同层 next-token 预测、最终层 PCA）进行基准对比。2. 测试平台为 FARS：从 18 个推理概念的 6 种表面形式中提取的 10 维基。3. 覆盖 9 种秩匹配估计器、26 个模型；补充跨概念重提取实验（24 个生成模型）与 4 模型、3 种子的干预研究。

Abstract: A concept subspace's effect on model behavior does not establish how it relates to the output readout. Given an extracted basis, the raw diagnostic requires only model weights. Our testbed is the Format-Agnostic Reasoning Subspace (FARS), a ten-dimensional basis extracted from eighteen reasoning concepts expressed in six surface forms. Across nine rank-matched estimators and twenty-six models, four activation-derived concept estimators carry only 0.38--0.80% mean energy in the top-ten readout span. Final-layer PCA carries 3.56%, exceeding FARS in 25 of 26 models. A same-layer next-token control, evaluated using a fitted linear translator for depth matching, carries approximately thirteen times more energy than FARS, with separation in all 25 tested models. Re-extracting FARS on ten disjoint concepts yields 62--100% cross-format retrieval across twenty-four generative models, demonstrating transfer of the extraction procedure rather than a fixed basis. <details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型 (LLM) 推理能力强但商业 API 调用成本高，小语言模型 (SLM) 易于本地部署但推理能力弱。现有知识蒸馏需离线训练并更新参数，在线协作需反复调用 LLM 且指导不可复用。论文聚焦更受限设定：仅离线访问 LLM、SLM 参数固定、在线推理仅由 SLM 完成，旨在以零在线 LLM 调用、零参数更新的方式提升 SLM 推理。

Conclusion: RLC 通过将一次性自然语言指导转化为可检索的隐空间纠错经验，有效弥合了 LLM 强推理与 SLM 易部署之间的鸿沟，为受限资源下的模型协作提供了新范式。代码已开源。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) offer strong reasoning capabilities but are often costly to access through commercial APIs, while small language models (SLMs) are easier to deploy locally yet remain weaker in reasoning. This capability-deployment gap has motivated LLM-SLM collaboration, which aims to improve SLM reasoning using LLM capabilities while preserving the deployment advantages of SLMs. Existing approaches mainly follow two paradigms. Knowledge distillation uses LLM-generated answers and reasoning trajectories to train SLMs offline, but requires parameter updates and additional training. Alternatively, online collaboration routes difficult problems to an LLM or leverages LLM-generated guidance and corrections when an SLM encounters difficulties. Although effective, online collaboration requires repeated LLM access. Moreover, the guidance produced for a particular problem is discarded after inference and cannot benefit subsequent problems involving similar reasoning states. In the paper, we focus on a more constrained setting in which the LLM is accessed only offline, the SLM parameters remain fixed, and online inference is performed solely by the SLM. To this end, we propose Reusable Latent Correction (RLC), which converts one-off natural-language guidance from a black-box LLM into persistent corrective experiences in the hidden space of an SLM. RLC stores these experiences in an external bank and retrieves them according to the SLM's current reasoning state, enabling the SLM to reuse LLM-derived corrections during inference without any online LLM calls. Experiments across multiple reasoning benchmarks and SLM scales show that RLC consistently improves SLM reasoning without parameter updates or online LLM calls. Code is available at https://github.com/ZBH031/reusable-latent-correction.

</details>

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 持续对齐要求LLM在适应新需求时不遗忘已有行为。自然语言指令虽灵活可组合但控制间接；后训练虽适应性强但需反复更新参数。现有方法难以同时兼顾灵活性、强适应性和参数效率，亟需一种冻结主干、少量参数、支持推理时动态组合的持续对齐方案。

Method: Ready2Blend包含三大核心组件：(1) AlignFormer：将每个需求编码为固定长度的对齐提示词，存储于模块化提示词库；(2) 冻结主干与先验提示词：骨干网络和已有提示词保持冻结，仅训练新提示词；(3) 可组合性正则化：将文本需求的语义几何结构迁移至提示词空间，使提示词间保持语义关系，从而支持推理时的线性混合与重加权。训练仅需少量提示词token，大幅降低计算开销。

Result: 在两个实际持续对齐基准上，Ready2Blend是唯一匹配后训练对齐方法性能的冻结主干方法：达到联合训练参考基线的93.1%-98.5%，保持具有竞争力的抗遗忘能力；仅使用极少提示词token，训练时间最多减少4.3倍。模块化设计进一步实现了无需重训练的加权个性化和无序组合能力。

Conclusion: Ready2Blend通过提示词库模块化设计和可组合性正则化，成功融合了自然语言指令的灵活性与后训练的强适应性，在冻结主干的前提下实接近联合训练的上界性能，大幅降低训练成本，并原生支持推理时的动态个性化与组合，为持续对齐提供了高效、灵活的新范式。

Abstract: Continual alignment requires LLMs to adapt to new requirements without forgetting previously acquired behaviors. Natural-language instructions are flexible and composable but offer only indirect control, whereas post-training provides stronger adaptation at the cost of repeated parameter updates. We introduce Ready2Blend, which combines the flexibility of natural language with learned alignment. AlignFormer maps each requirement to a fixed-length alignment prompt stored in a modular prompt bank, while the backbone and prior prompts remain frozen. Composability regularization transfers the semantic geometry of textual requirements into prompt space, enabling inference-time blending and reweighting. Across two practical continual alignment settings, Ready2Blend is the only frozen-backbone method that matches post-training-based alignment methods, reaching $93.1$-$98.5\%$ of a joint-training reference with competitive retention, while requiring only a few prompt tokens and up to $4.3\times$ less training time. Its modular design further enables weighted personalization and order-free composition without retraining. Code will be released upon acceptance.

</details>

TL;DR: 本文揭示了网格束搜索在约束文本生成中存在偏见，倾向于优先满足容易的约束，并提出了公平网格束搜索来修复这一问题，同时保持线性计算复杂度并获得更高概率的生成结果。

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的约束解码方法中，DFA约束束搜索虽然公平但需要指数级前向传递，而网格束搜索虽然只需线性前向传递却存在偏见，会优先满足容易的约束而将困难约束推迟到序列末尾。需要一种既高效又公平的解码方法。

Method: 提出公平网格束搜索，对标准网格束搜索进行修改以消除对约束满足顺序的偏见，同时保持仅需线性数量前向传递的计算优势。

Abstract: A common formalism for constraining the output of autoregressive text generation models involves lexical constraints, words or phrases which are required to occur in the generated text. DFA-constrained beam search and grid beam search are two widely used paradigms for decoding from autoregressive models while enforcing lexical constraints. As the former approach requires a number of forward passes exponential in the number of constraint tokens, it is often dispreferred to the latter, which requires only linearly many forward calls. However, while grid beam search achieves an exponential speedup, it does so in a manner which does not treat all of the constraints equally. In this paper, we demonstrate that grid beam search is biased to incorporate easier-to-satisfy constraints first, leaving harder constraints to the end of the sequence. This contrasts with DFA-constrained beam search, which exhibits no such bias. To address this shortcoming, we propose fair grid beam search, a modification to grid beam search which avoids this bias while still requiring only linearly many forward passes. Experimentally, we confirm grid beam search's bias on two constrained generation tasks, finding significant differences in how it orders constraint tokens as compared to DFA-constrained beam search and fair grid beam search. Furthermore, we find that fair grid beam search not only fixes grid beam search's bias, but finds higher-probability strings in the process.

</details>

Abstract: Specialized models encode task-oriented behavior, but transferring that behavior to a general language model usually requires training, distillation, or representation alignment. Intersection-Merge (IM) injects a prefix-aligned donor slice matching the recipient shape, while Activate-Prune-Merge (APM) uses forward-pass activation statistics to select which donor dimensions to retain before injection. Across embedding, reranking, reward modeling, and MoE code-specialist transfer, both methods improve the general recipient, showing that simple heterogeneous merging can move capabilities across diverse specialist roles.

</details>

Abstract: Argument Mining (AM) is a critical NLP task that remains significantly under-resourced in Arabic. This paper presents $\testtt{STAR-Ar}$, a BERT-BiLSTM-CRF architecture for argument discourse detection and classification, as our system for Daleel 2026, the inaugural Arabic argument mining shared task. The task requires the identification and classification of argumentative discourse units (ADUs) in debate and editorial texts.We jointly model these two objectives as a token-level sequence labeling task using a BERT-BiLSTM-CRF architecture that combines contextual transformer embeddings with structural transition constraints to support accurate span detection. $\testtt{STAR-Ar}$ achieves an F1-score of 72.69 on validation and 73.7 on test data. Our domain-specific analysis shows that models trained exclusively on editorials underperform those trained on debates, a disparity we primarily attribute to the smaller size of the editorial dataset. The code for $\testtt{STAR-Ar}$ is available at ${\href{https://github.com/ENTAILab/daleel_2026_Arabic-Argumentative-Discourse-Mining}{\faGithub~TTLab at Daleel 2026}}$

</details>


### [71] [QuantCode Model: Specializing Language Models for Executable Algorithmic Trading Code](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39420)
*Alexey Chernysh,Orkhan Ekhtibarov,Dmitry Zmitrovich*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究如何将大语言模型专门化用于算法交易代码生成（Backtrader框架），提出持续预训练和基于智能体验证的监督微调两种互补机制，并在QuantCode-Bench基准上评估，发现持续预训练提升单轮通过率，微调进一步大幅提升多轮智能体修复成功率，但领域专门化会损害结构化工具调用能力，需显式评估能力保持。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 算法交易代码生成要求模型将自然语言策略规范转换为专用交易框架的正确程序逻辑，并在历史数据上执行回测，保持语义忠实。现有通用代码生成模型难以直接胜任此专业任务，需要针对性专门化方法。

Method: 采用两种互补机制：1) 在算法交易框架代码上进行持续预训练；2) 在智能体验证的请求-代码对上进行监督微调（SFT）。评估基于QuantCode-Bench（400任务Backtrader策略生成）和仓库级SWE-bench风格轨道。实验对象为Qwen3.5-397B-A17B和Qwen3.6-35B-A3B。

Result: 持续预训练使Qwen3.5-397B-A17B单轮Judge Pass从41.5%提升至47.5%，Qwen3.6-35B-A3B从27.8%提升至33.0%。随后进行SFT使Qwen3.6-35B-A3B达到58.2% Judge Pass、83.5%成功回测；智能体评估中首轮成功从22.3%提升至58.3%，最多10轮修复后最终成功从47.5%提升至79.5%。持续预训练单独使用虽提升首轮智能体成功但降低修复后最终成功（47.5%→32.5%），说明指令跟随能力下降。领域专门化导致解析器一致的结构化工具调用能力退化，针对性恢复SFT虽恢复工具调用格式，但未恢复基础检查点的仓库级智能体性能。

Conclusion: 面向框架的持续预训练、经过验证的监督微调、以及显式的能力保持评估，分别解决了领域特定可执行代码生成中不同的失效模式：预训练提供框架知识，微调对齐指令跟随与修复能力，能力保持评估揭示工具调用退化风险。

Abstract: Large language models are strong general-purpose code generators, but executable algorithmic trading remains a demanding specialization target: a model must translate a natural-language strategy specification into correct program logic for a specialized trading framework, execute on historical data, produce trades, and remain semantically faithful to the request. We study two complementary mechanisms for specializing language models for this setting: continued pretraining on algorithmic-trading framework code and supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on agent-validated request-to-code pairs. Evaluation is centered on QuantCode-Bench, our 400-task benchmark for Backtrader strategy generation, together with a repository-level SWE-bench-like track. Continued pretraining improves single-turn Judge Pass from 41.5% to 47.5% for Qwen3.5-397B-A17B and from 27.8% to 33.0% for Qwen3.6-35B-A3B. SFT applied after continued pretraining yields a larger gain for Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, reaching 58.2% Judge Pass and 83.5% successful backtests; in agentic evaluation it raises first-turn success from 22.3% to 58.3% and final success after up to 10 turns from 47.5% to 79.5%. Continued pretraining alone improves first-turn agentic success but lowers final success after repair from 47.5% to 32.5%, consistent with degraded instruction following, whereas SFT improves both. We also identify a capability-retention failure: domain specialization degrades parser-conformant structured tool calling, and targeted recovery SFT restores tool-call formatting but not the base checkpoint's repository-level agent performance. The results show that framework-oriented pretraining, validated SFT, and explicit capability-retention evaluation address distinct failure modes in domain-specific executable code generation.

</details>

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Method: 构建DuplexAct-Bench双语基准，涵盖六类交互行为（打断、让话、主动发起、主动静默、回声反馈）和三种会话条件（会话前、会话中、无显式条件），对12个全双工语音系统进行1,290次英语和中文流式试验，从Timing（时序）和Content（内容）两个维度评估。

Result: 实验显示不同行为、条件和系统间表现差异巨大，且语义质量与行为时序频繁出现错配，表明当前系统难以稳健处理实时交互中何时、是否、如何参与的决策。

Conclusion: DuplexAct-Bench填补了全双工语音交互评测的空白，实证证明现有系统距离真实实时交互的鲁棒参与管理仍有显著差距，为未来研究提供了系统性评测框架和明确改进方向。

Abstract: Existing full-duplex speech benchmarks cover only subsets of real-time interaction behaviors, often under limited contextual conditions. We introduce DuplexAct-Bench, a bilingual benchmark that systematically covers six complementary behaviors, from interruption and yielding to proactive initiation, active silence, and backchanneling, across Pre-session, In-session, and No-explicit conditions. Across 1,290 English and Chinese streaming trials, we evaluate 12 full-duplex speech systems on both Timing and Content. Results reveal substantial variation across behaviors, conditions, and systems, as well as frequent mismatches between semantic quality and behavioral timing. These findings show that current systems remain far from robustly managing when, whether, and how to participate as real-time interaction unfolds. Project page: https://alitaxky.icu/DuplexAct-Bench/

</details>


### [73] [Synthetic Data Characterization via Training Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39447)
*Irene Lago,Ana Ezquerro,David Vilares*

Main category: cs.CL

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解LLM生成数据的效用和局限性对于跨学习任务至关重要，需要系统表征合成数据的可学习性属性，并与人类数据对比，以指导数据选择和使用策略。
