Inspired by this result, we propose NFA-LM, a polynomial-time engine for NFA-constrained generation with theoretical guarantees under mild assumptions. Experiments show that NFA-LM efficiently generates high-quality outputs with theoretically bounded approximation error.

</details>


### [111] [SCB: SpeechConversationBench for Evaluating Multi-Turn Reasoning in Speech-to-Speech Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40198)
*Kanpat Vesessook,Saksorn Ruangtanusak*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出SpeechConversationBench (SCB)，用于评估语音对话系统在多轮数学推理中的表现，对比了全题一次性给出、拼接碎片、增量分轮三种条件下的准确率，发现商业系统在增量条件下性能下降5-25个百分点，而内部开发的LEGO管道在三种条件下均达到77.5%准确率，优于GPT-4o Realtime的76.6%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语音到语音系统需要解决跨对话轮次涌现的任务需求，现有评估缺乏对增量语音交互中数学推理能力的专门测试。

Method: 使用103个拆分的GSM8K问题，构建三种呈现条件：full（完整问题单轮给出）、concat（碎片拼接一次性给出）、sharded（碎片跨多轮增量给出）。测试四个商业语音系统和自研LEGO管道（显式对话上下文管理），比较最终答案准确率。

Result: 相对于concat，商业系统在sharded条件下准确率下降5.0-25.3个百分点。LEGO在三种条件下均达到77.5%准确率，GPT-4o Realtime在sharded条件下为76.6%。单轮基线区分了问题重述敏感性与增量交互带来的额外挑战。

Conclusion: 增量语音交互对商业系统数学推理能力构成显著挑战，显式对话上下文管理（如LEGO）可有效缓解性能下降，SCB为评估多轮语音推理提供了标准化基准。

Abstract: Speech-to-speech systems must solve tasks whose requirements emerge across conversational turns. We introduce SpeechConversationBench (SCB), a focused evaluation of spoken mathematical reasoning using 103 sharded GSM8K problems. The framework compares the original problem delivered in one turn (full), its concatenated information shards delivered together (concat), and incremental spoken disclosure across turns (sharded). We report final-answer accuracy for four commercial speech systems and LEGO, a proprietary speech pipeline developed internally by the SCBX Innovation Lab team with explicit conversational context management. Relative to concat, sharded accuracy decreases by 5.0-25.3 percentage points across the four commercial systems. LEGO achieves 77.5 percent accuracy in all three conditions, compared with 76.6 percent sharded accuracy for GPT-4o Realtime. The two single-turn baselines distinguish sensitivity to problem reformulation from the additional challenges introduced by incremental spoken interaction.

</details>


### [112] [Comparison of techniques for fine-tuning open-weight models for entity extraction from radiology reports](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40236)
*Aawez Mansuri,Kush Mehta,Mohammadreza Chavoshi,Jahanzaib Malik,Theodorus Dapamede,Frank Li,Rohan Isaac,Beatrice Brown-Mulry,Chiratidzo Rudado Sanyika,YoungSeok Jeon,Judy W. Gichoya,Ali Emami,Hari Trivedi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究开源模型Gemma-3-12B经微调后能否在颅内出血（ICH）急性期标签提取任务上媲美GPT-4o，并探究关键因素。实验表明，使用真实报告蒸馏数据进行指令微调（DIFT）的模型宏观F1达到0.845，与GPT-4o的0.850无显著差异（p=1.000），显著优于基础模型0.178。关键在于训练数据来源（真实蒸馏优于合成数据），而非微调方法。微调和推理均可在单张24GB消费级GPU上完成，为临床标签提取提供了私有、低成本、版本稳定的本地化替代方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将自由文本放射学报告转化为结构化标签可支持队列构建、质量保证和临床影像模型监控，但最强的标签提取器多为托管专有模型，引发隐私、成本和可复现性担忧。因此，需要探索开源模型经微调后能否达到同等性能，并明确关键成功因素。

Method: 采用2×2因子设计，交叉两种适应策略（判别式分类头CH、生成式指令微调IFT）与两种训练数据来源（真实GPT-4o标注报告蒸馏、GPT-4o基于真实范例生成的合成报告），在五种训练规模下训练Gemma-3-12B，使用100份专家裁定报告为基准，对比GPT-4o及未微调基础模型。

Result: 蒸馏指令微调模型（DIFT）宏观F1为0.845，与GPT-4o的0.850无统计学差异（p=1.000），比基础模型高0.178。决定性因素是训练数据来源：所有合成数据模型在任何训练规模下均未超越基础模型，且在所有急性期类别上均劣于蒸馏模型。微调与推理均可在单张24GB消费级GPU显存内完成。

Conclusion: 对于窄域、高价值的临床标签提取任务，使用真实报告蒸馏数据而非生成合成数据，是缩小开源模型与托管专有模型性能差距的关键，从而实现私有、低成本、版本稳定的本地化部署。

Abstract: Converting free-text radiology reports into structured labels supports cohort building, quality assurance, and monitoring of clinical imaging models, but the strongest label extractors are hosted proprietary models whose use raises privacy, cost, and reproducibility concerns. We asked whether a fine-tuned open-weight model (Gemma-3-12B) can match GPT-4o at multi-label intracranial hemorrhage (ICH) acuity extraction from non-contrast head-CT reports, and which ingredients matter. Using a 2x2 design, we crossed two adaptation strategies (a discriminative classification head, CH; generative instruction fine-tuning, IFT) with two training-data sources (distillation of real GPT-4o-labeled reports; synthetic reports generated by GPT-4o from real exemplars), across five training sizes, benchmarked on 100 expert-adjudicated reports against GPT-4o and the un-tuned open-weight base. The distilled instruction-tuned model (DIFT) matched GPT-4o (macro-F1 0.845 vs 0.850; p = 1.000) and exceeded the base model by 0.178. The decisive factor was the training-data source, not the fine-tuning method: both synthetic-data models failed to exceed the un-tuned open-weight base at any training size and underperformed the distilled models across all acuity classes. Fine-tuning and inference fit within the memory envelope of a single 24 GB consumer GPU. For narrow, high-value clinical label-extraction tasks, distilling real reports, rather than generating synthetic ones, is what closes the gap to a hosted model, enabling a private, low-cost, version-stable on-premises alternative.

</details>


### [113] [Linguistic Loopholes in LLM Unlearning: From a 174-Language Benchmark to Coverage-Aware Unlearning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40286)
*Tyler Skow,Shravan Chaudhari,Rama Chellappa,Abhay Yadav*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出语言预算多语言遗忘任务，旨在选择一组语言以最大化跨语言知识擦除。引入跨语言遗忘张量基准（174语言-脚本对，25种原子释义类型），提出COVER方法，利用良性校准数据和冻结模型选择源语言，在三个模型家族和两个遗忘集上将平均保留残留访问降低7.8%-27.3%，且在低资源语言真实新闻文档上也有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单语言遗忘无法保证跨语言知识移除，改变查询或回答语言可能重新暴露被遗忘知识（跨语言漏洞）。在所有语言中遗忘既不具扩展性又会损害无关模型能力。因此需要在有限语言预算下选择最优源语言集合以最大化跨语言擦除泛化。

Method: 1. 构建跨语言遗忘张量基准，覆盖174语言-脚本对和25种原子释义类型，系统评估遗忘跨语言泛化。2. 提出COVER算法：基于良性校准数据和冻结模型，预测各源语言对未监督语言的覆盖率，通过组合优化选择源语言集合，而非简单选取强个体源语言。

Result: 在三个模型家族和两个不相交遗忘集上，COVER相较均匀源语言选择将平均保留残留访问降低7.8%-27.3%。实验表明单纯选择强个体源语言无法可靠组合成强源语言集，验证COVER的组合优化必要性。增益推广至低资源语言真实新闻文档（LORELEI语料库人工翻译数据）。

Conclusion: 语言预算多语言遗忘是可行且必要的任务。COVER通过预测覆盖率优化源语言选择，无需额外训练即可显著提升跨语言遗忘效果，为大规模多语言模型知识编辑提供实用方案。

Abstract: Unlearning a fact in one language does not guarantee its removal in others as changing the query or even the requested answer language can reopen seemingly forgotten knowledge -- a cross-lingual loophole. The most straightforward solution to this challenge -- unlearning in all languages -- is neither scalable nor desirable as it amplifies damage to unrelated model capabilities. We introduce the task of language budgeted multilingual unlearning where the goal is to select a subset of languages that maximizes cross-lingual erasure. To study this task we introduce the Cross-Lingual Unlearning Tensor, an unlearning benchmark that spans 174 language--script pairs and 25 atomic paraphrase types to examine when forgetting generalizes across linguistic expressions of the same knowledge. We further propose COVER, which selects source languages to maximize predicted COVERage of languages receiving no forget supervision, enabling unlearning on a language budget. Surprisingly, we find naively selecting strong individual sources does not reliably compose into strong source sets motivating our development of COVER. At deployment COVER only requires benign calibration data and access to the frozen model. Across three model families and two disjoint forget sets, COVER reduces mean held-out residual access by 7.8--27.3% relative to uniform source selection. We find these gains extend beyond synthetic benchmarks to real news documents in low-resource language settings using human translated data from the Low Resource Languages for Emergent Incidents (LORELEI) corpus.

</details>


### [114] [How Much Is an AI Token Worth? Scaling Laws for Wild AI-Generated Web Text](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40295)
*Jenna Russell,Ben Glickenhaus,Katherine Thai,John Wieting,Mohit Iyyer,Max Spero,Bradley Emi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文研究了‘野生’AI生成文本（未标记、面向人类、来自多模型）在预训练语料库中日益增多对语言模型训练的影响。通过预训练800个模型并拟合缩放定律，发现AI文本对数据稀缺模型初期有益但很快转为有害；对高预算人类文本模型则立即有害。现有缩放定律无法预测此行为，提出新定律分离收益与损害项，预测误差降低41%。建议过滤AI文本、优先重复人类文本、分开报告验证损失。发布了WildAI语料库（83B tokens）及模型代码。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Web预训练数据中AI生成文本比例快速上升（2026年6月27.5%→8月31.1%），且呈‘野生’特性：多模型来源、面向人类读者、未标记混入语料库。现有研究多关注合成数据或模型崩溃设定，缺乏对真实野生AI文本大规模混入预训练的系统实证与理论建模，亟需量化其对人类文本建模的实际影响并指导数据策略。

Method: 1) 使用FineWeb质量过滤后的Web数据，用Pangram标注AI生成比例；2) 预训练800个语言模型，系统变换添加AI token与人类token的比例；3) 在保留的人类文本与AI文本上分别计算held-out loss；4) 拟合缩放定律，对比Hoffman et al. (2022)等现有定律；5) 提出新缩放定律：引入单独的收益项与损害项，使AI token价值可随比例变号，且在无AI文本时退化为Chinchilla定律；6) 在小模型上拟合参数，外推预测至3.6倍大模型。

Result: • 数据稀缺模型：添加AI token初期降低人类文本loss，但收益迅速饱和并反转为损害。• 高人类文本预算模型：AI token几乎立即提升loss，同等数量新鲜人类token持续降低loss。• 现有缩放定律（如Hoffman等）无法捕捉此非单调行为。• 新提出的双项缩放定律在全AI比例范围内，预测大模型（至3.6×）held-out人类文本loss的误差比最佳现有定律降低41%。• AI文本在目标为AI文本建模时仍具价值。

Conclusion: 当预训练目标为人类文本建模时，应过滤野生AI文本；在扩充训练集引入AI生成Web文本前，优先重复高质量人类文本；验证时应分别报告人类文本与AI文本上的loss。发布WildAI语料库（83B tokens，含AI/主题/格式标签）、全部800个模型检查点及代码，支持后续研究。

Abstract: Web text makes up the majority of pretraining data and is increasingly AI-generated. After applying FineWeb quality filtering, we find that 27.5% of tokens from June 2026 web data are labeled as AI-generated by Pangram, rising to 31.1% by August. Unlike synthetic data or model-collapse setups, this *wild* AI text comes from many models, is written for human readers, and arrives unlabeled in pretraining corpora. How does AI text in the wild affect language model pretraining? To answer this question, we pretrain 800 language models, varying the ratio of added AI tokens to human tokens, and fit scaling laws to held-out losses on both human and AI-generated text. For data-starved models, adding AI tokens to pretraining data initially lowers loss on human text, but the benefit saturates as more are added and quickly *reverses* into harm. For models trained on high budgets of human text, AI tokens raise loss almost immediately, while the same number of fresh human tokens keeps lowering it. Scaling laws such as Hoffman et al. (2022) fail to predict this behavior. We propose a new scaling law with separate benefit and harm terms that allows the value of an AI token to change sign while also reducing to Chinchilla in the absence of AI text. When fit on smaller models, our scaling law predicts the effect of AI text on held-out human-text loss for models up to 3.6x larger with 41% lower error than the best existing law over all AI ratios. We recommend filtering AI text when the target is human text, repeating human text before expanding the training dataset with AI-generated web text, and reporting validation loss on human and AI text separately AI text remains valuable when the target is AI text. We release WildAI, an 83B-token corpus with AI, topic, and format labels, all 800 models and code at https://github.com/pangramlabs/WildAI.

</details>


### [115] [EvoDuet: Bilevel Co-Evolution of Web Searching and Task Solving for Scientific Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40340)
*Young-Jun Lee,Jinheon Baek,Soyeong Jeong,Minki Kang,Seungyeon Jwa,Jonghyun Choi,Seungho Han,Dongyeop Kang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: EvoDuet 是一种双层优化方法，通过协同进化解决方案和搜索查询，解决大语言模型在进化搜索中因缺乏外部知识而停滞的问题。它引入检索门控机制评估知识缺口，内层循环优化查询并按预测解决方案得分排序文档，外层循环并行生成候选并记录结果。在21个优化任务上，EvoDuet 显著提升了 GPT-5.6-Luna 和 Gemini-3.8-Flash 的归一化发现增益，在8个任务上超越先前最佳分数，并适用于多种进化搜索脚手架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型在进化搜索中往往因缺乏特定外部知识而停滞。虽然提供相关文档有帮助，但简单添加网络搜索工具会随着解决方案变化而反复返回相同页面，无法有效适应搜索需求的动态变化。需要一种能够动态评估知识缺口、协同优化搜索查询与解决方案的方法。

Method: EvoDuet 采用双层优化架构：内层循环通过检索门控让 LLM 评估知识缺口，决定检索新文档、复用存储文档或不使用文档；然后优化搜索查询并按预测解决方案得分对文档排序。外层循环从这些文档并行生成候选解决方案，并记录评估结果供后续搜索使用。模型参数保持固定，通过协同进化解决方案和查询实现知识获取与解决方案优化的闭环。

Result: 在21个优化任务（每迭代一个候选）上，EvoDuet 将 OpenEvolve 的归一化发现增益从74.1%提升至78.0%（GPT-5.6-Luna），从61.3%提升至82.3%（Gemini-3.8-Flash）；Qwen3.5-9B 未获益。最佳运行在8个任务上超越先前报告的最佳分数（包括Q20和Rosetta上的Swap Reduction），在3个任务上持平。EvoDuet 在 Sums/Diffs 和 Denoising 任务上也改进了 Top-K 和 EvoX 等其他脚手架，展示了跨脚手架的适用性。

Conclusion: EvoDuet 通过双层协同进化机制有效解决了 LLM 进化搜索中的知识获取瓶颈，检索门控与查询优化的动态交互显著提升了搜索效率和发现质量。该方法在强模型上效果显著，但在较小模型（如9B参数）上效果有限，提示模型能力阈值对知识利用至关重要。EvoDuet 的模块化设计使其能无缝集成到现有进化搜索框架中，具有广泛的适用性和扩展潜力。

Abstract: Evolutionary search with large language models (LLMs) can stall when progress requires external knowledge the model lacks. Supplying relevant documents helps, but simply adding web search tool can keep returning the same pages as solutions change. We introduce EvoDuet, a bi-level optimization method that co-evolves solutions and search queries with fixed model parameters. At each iteration, a retrieval gate lets the LLM assess its knowledge gap and choose to retrieve new documents, reuse stored ones, or proceed without them. An inner loop refines queries and ranks documents by the solution scores they are predicted to yield; an outer loop generates candidates in parallel from these documents and records the evaluated outcomes for later searches. Across 21 optimization tasks with one candidate per iteration, EvoDuet raises OpenEvolve's normalized discovery gain from 74.1% to 78.0% with GPT-5.6-Luna and from 61.3% to 82.3% with Gemini-3.8-Flash, whereas Qwen3.5-9B does not benefit. Our best runs surpass the previously reported best scores on eight tasks, including Swap Reduction on Q20 and Rosetta, and match them on three more. EvoDuet also improves with other scaffolds (e.g., Top-K, EvoX) on Sums/Diffs and Denoising, demonstrating its applicability across evolutionary search scaffolds.

</details>


### [116] [Instability Floors: Separating Bias from Noise in Fairness Audits of Clinical LLM Agents with FairMedAgent](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03221)
*Rohith Reddy Bellibatlu,Manpreet Singh,Deepak Parashar,Rahul Joshi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文指出临床语言模型代理的公平性审计中使用的“翻转率”包含随机性基线，必须测量并报告这一基线才能正确解读公平性；实验测量了多模型、多解码配置下的基线，并提出四步报告流程及开源工具 FairMedAgent。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 公平性审计常用翻转率（仅改变人口统计学描述符时动作改变的频率）评估偏见，但随机代理在输入不变时也会改变动作，导致翻转率无法直接解释。需量化这种随机性基线，以区分真实人口统计学效应与固有随机波动。

Method: 在十六个合成临床场景上，对同一条件重复运行十次，测量默认采样下的翻转基线；跨六个模型（五家厂商）对比汇总基线；测试多数投票（五次采样）和温度为 0 等解码配置对基线的影响；理论推导二元动作下无人口统计学效应时的期望翻转率等于基线，真实效应仅增加其平方项；制定四步报告规程并发布 FairMedAgent 测评套件。

Result: 默认采样下临床代理在 8.7% 的复现对中改变动作（ICU 升级 2.2%，管制药物谨慎 17.9%）。六模型汇总基线范围 2.5%–23.7%，不随模型规模、厂商或托管方式有序。多数投票消除 39% 基线（95% CI 18%–64%）；温度 0 时四个本地部署模型中三个无分歧，但托管模型仍有分歧。翻转率落在基线内不等于公平，必须用配对符号检验验证方向性。

Conclusion: 随机性基线是公平性审计的必要基准，未测量基线即宣称公平是无效的。论文提供标准化测量协议、分析脚本与开源工具 FairMedAgent，使任意团队能为自有代理建立基线并进行可解释的公平性审计。

Abstract: Counterfactual fairness audits of clinical language-model agents report a flip rate: how often an action changes when only the patient's demographic descriptor changes. Part of that rate is not demographic. A stochastic agent also changes its own action when nothing changes, and a flip rate cannot be interpreted without knowing how often. We measured it. Re-running one condition ten times over sixteen synthetic vignettes at default sampling changed a clinical agent's action in 8.7 percent of replicate pairs, from 2.2 percent for intensive-care escalation to 17.9 percent for controlled-substance caution, an output given no operational criteria. Across six models from five vendors, pooled floors ranged from 2.5 to 23.7 percent; in this panel neither disclosed size, vendor, nor hosting ordered them. The floor depends on the decoding configuration: majority voting over five draws removed 39 percent of it (95 percent confidence interval (CI) 18 to 64); at temperature 0 three of four locally served models showed no disagreement, but a hosted model still did. We also show that, for a binary action, the flip rate expected under no demographic effect equals the floor and a real effect adds only its square, so a flip rate inside the floor is not evidence of fairness, and direction must be tested with a signed paired test. We give a four-step reporting procedure and release FairMedAgent, the harness, with its protocol, vignettes and analysis scripts, so any team can measure the floor for its own agent.

</details>


<div id='cs.IR'></div>

# cs.IR [[Back]](#toc)

### [117] [TAGGRAPH: Tag-Augmented Graphs for Graph Retrieval of Agent Persistent Histories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38353)
*Yu-Su Chen,Yu-Jung Liang,Pengtao Xie*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 论文提出了一种基于共享5W风格对话记忆的受控评估框架，系统对比了图记忆、BM25和OpenClaw等长期记忆检索方法，揭示了检索策略需结合记忆设置联合评估，且需对比强词法基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长期记忆让LLM代理能回忆过往交互并保持跨会话一致性，但现有记忆系统在表示、索引、检索和评估上差异大，难以公平比较，因此需要统一的评估基准。

Method: 构建共享5W风格对话记忆库，实现局部图遍历、AdaptiveGraph（添加时序边并用Personalized PageRank扩散）、BM25（基于抽取笔记）和OpenClaw（原始输入外部参考）四种检索配置；在LongMemEval-S和ATANT Core两个基准上进行受控对比实验。

Result: LongMemEval-S上AdaptiveGraph以0.844 MRR为最强图配置，但BM25达0.867、OpenClaw达0.880；ATANT Core上局部图遍历优于扩散和BM25，压力轮次BM25领先；存储规模可能影响扩散惩罚；词汇归一化和抽取质量显著影响图检索，Top-5漏召常缺失抽取标签。

Conclusion: 检索策略必须与记忆设置联合评估，并以强词法基线（如BM25）为参照；图记忆虽具结构优势，但在大规模或抽取噪声下易被词法方法超越，实际部署需权衡图构建开销与检索增益。

Abstract: Long-term memory lets LLM agents recall past interactions and remain consistent across sessions, but memory systems are hard to compare because they often vary in representation, indexing, retrieval, and evaluation. We present a controlled evaluation framework based on shared 5W-style conversational memories. Localized graph configurations traverse a common base graph; AdaptiveGraph adds chronological edges and Personalized PageRank diffusion. We also evaluate BM25 over the same extracted notes and OpenClaw as a raw-input external reference. Retrieval rankings vary across memory settings. On LongMemEval-S, AdaptiveGraph is the strongest graph configuration at 0.844 MRR, but BM25 reaches 0.867 and OpenClaw 0.880. On ATANT Core, localized graph traversal outperforms diffusion and BM25, whereas BM25 leads the stress rounds. Reducing LongMemEval-S within the tested range does not reproduce the ATANT diffusion penalty, but the smallest tested store remains larger than ATANT Core, so store size cannot be ruled out. The penalty also persists under a permissive content-match criterion. Vocabulary normalization and extraction quality substantially affect graph retrieval, and missing extraction tags are common among top-five misses. Retrieval strategies should therefore be evaluated jointly with the memory setting and against strong lexical baselines.

</details>


### [118] [AdaM-Rec: Adaptive Modality Routing for Multimodal Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38455)
*Honghao Fu,Jiacheng Chen,Manxi Lin,Junjun Zheng,Xiangheng Kong,Yiwei Wang,Xin Yu,Miao Xu,Yuning Jiang,Yujun Cai*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 论文提出AdaM-Rec，一种基于LLM的自适应模态路由框架，用于多模态推荐系统，能够根据查询需求动态调整对文本和视觉模态的依赖程度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态推荐系统多采用静态模态融合，假设文本和视觉信号的相对重要性在不同推荐场景中保持稳定。然而，不同查询需求差异大：部分需要细粒度视觉线索，另一些则更依赖文本或功能语义，静态融合会引入无信息线索，降低推荐质量。

Method: 基于物品和用户偏好的结构化自然语言表示，通过代理召回任务估计模态可靠性。具体生成与实际查询粒度匹配、指向用户正向交互物品的伪查询作为可验证代理目标，评估哪种模态在类似场景下召回效果更好，以智能体方式优化路由策略。随后按优化策略执行路由召回，融合协同物品，并按查询与用户偏好相关性对候选重排。

Result: 实验表明AdaM-Rec在最先进基线上取得优异性能，验证了自适应控制模态依赖在多模态推荐中的有效性。

Conclusion: 自适应模态路由在多模态推荐中具有显著效果和广泛应用潜力，能根据查询特性动态校准模态依赖，提升推荐质量。

Abstract: While recent multimodal recommender systems have demonstrated the effectiveness of incorporating visual and textual information to improve downstream performance, most existing methods rely on static modality fusion, assuming that the relative importance of textual and visual signals remains stable across recommendation scenarios. This design may not fully account for an important variation across recommendation requests: some queries require fine-grained visual cues, whereas others are better served by textual or functional semantics, in which case indiscriminate modality fusion brings in uninformative cues and impairs recommendation quality. To address this, we propose AdaM-Rec, an LLM-based framework for adaptive modality routing in multimodal recommendation, which enables dynamic calibration of reliance on textual and multimodal evidence for user-specific queries. Built on structured natural-language representations of items and user preferences, it estimates modality reliability using proxy recall tasks. Specifically, it generates pseudo-queries that match the granularity of the actual query while pointing to the user's positively interacted items as verifiable proxy targets, evaluating which modality yields better recall performance in analogous scenarios and optimizing the routing strategy in an agentic manner. It then performs routed recall with optimized strategy, enriches results with collaborative items, and ranks candidates by their relevance to both the query and user preferences. Experiments demonstrate that AdaM-Rec delivers strong performance against state-of-the-art baselines, highlighting the effectiveness and broader potential of adaptive control over modality reliance in multimodal recommendation.

</details>


### [119] [Re-ranking and Late Interaction Drive Retrieval Quality: A Controlled Comparison of RAG Strategies for Scientific Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38473)
*Bhagyesh Rathi,Eshan Chawla,William B. Andreopoulos*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文对比了六种RAG检索策略在科学问答上的表现，使用统一的生成器、提示词、评估协议和完整的arXiv语料库（463,971篇论文），并发布了合成问答数据集（19,484个问题）和代码，为RAG设计选择的成本-质量权衡提供开放测试平台。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RAG已成为LLM接入外部知识的标准方式，但检索管道的设计空间大，不同变体间的权衡在领域特定语料库和真实规模下尚不清楚，尤其缺乏系统性的受控对比研究。

Method: 在相同生成器、提示词、评估协议和语料库下，对比六种检索策略：(i) 经典top-k稠密检索，(ii) LLM查询重写，(iii) 查询重写+LLM重排序，(iv) 多查询融合(RRF)，(v) Agent工具调用管道，(vi) ColBERTv2晚期交互检索。五种单向量管道共享SPECTER2嵌入和Chroma向量库。构建了19,484个合成问答对（从10,000篇论文生成），并采用LLM-as-a-judge多维度评估及金标准检索指标。

Result: 实验揭示了六种策略在检索质量、生成质量、延迟和成本上的权衡，不同策略在不同质量维度上表现差异显著，为RAG设计选择提供了实证依据。

Conclusion: 本工作为研究文献语料库上的RAG设计选择提供了开放、可复现的大规模测试平台，支持未来在忠实性、检索鲁棒性和Agent式检索方面的研究。

Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is now the standard way to ground Large Language Models (LLMs) in external knowledge, yet the design space of retrieval pipelines is large and the trade-offs between variants are not well understood, especially on domain-specific corpora at realistic scale. In this work, we present a controlled comparison of six retrieval strategies for scientific question answering: (i) classic top-k dense retrieval, (ii) LLM-based query rephrasing, (iii) query rephrasing followed by LLM-based reranking, (iv) multi-query fusion via Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF), (v) an agentic tool-call pipeline in which the generator decides for itself whether to retrieve, and (vi) late-interaction retrieval with ColBERTv2. All six pipelines share the same generator (Meta-Llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct), prompt, and evaluation protocol; the five single-vector pipelines additionally share SPECTER2 embeddings and a Chroma vector store; and all six retrieve from the full corpus of 463,971 arXiv papers dated 2024-2025. To support reproducible, large-scale evaluation, we also release a synthetic question dataset of 19,484 problem-statement and methodology questions generated by Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct from a random sample of 10,000 papers across academic domains (query generation succeeded for 9,742 of them), and every strategy is evaluated on this same query set. We describe the architecture and implementation of each pipeline, release the code and the synthetic question dataset, and evaluate each strategy with an LLM-as-a-judge protocol along multiple quality dimensions, together with direct gold-paper retrieval metrics. The result is an open testbed for studying the cost and quality trade-offs of RAG design choices on a research-literature corpus, and a basis for future work on faithfulness, retrieval robustness, and agentic retrieval.

</details>


### [120] [Exploring Forum Post Retrieval with Generative Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38646)
*Yang Li,Yaguang Liu,Heng Liu,Shengbo Guo,Samson Komo,Jane Kou,Yulian Zhou,Gang Yang,Shubhojeet Sarkar,Gaurav Chakravorty,Yujie Liu,Haipeng Chen,Yonghuan Yang,Deepti Chheda,Yamin Wang,Mike Plumpe,Rish Tandon*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文探讨在Facebook Forum这一新推荐场景上部署生成式推荐（GR），利用跨平台语义ID（SID）和更广泛的Facebook Groups交互数据进行迁移学习，通过指令微调3B参数语言模型直接生成SID，系统消融关键设计选择，证明跨平台SID可迁移至新推荐界面，并为实际部署提供实用指导。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式推荐作为基于嵌入检索的替代方案崭露头角，但Facebook Forum作为新业务面，自身交互数据稀疏，难以从头训练GR模型；需解决冷启动与数据稀疏问题，实现跨平台知识迁移。

Method: 采用双轴迁移策略：1) 在更广泛的Facebook Groups交互语料上训练，而非仅用Forum会话；2) 复用从跨平台Facebook Feed数据学习的层级前缀式语义ID（SID），避免训练Forum专用分词器。随后对3B参数指令微调语言模型进行监督微调，直接从用户上下文生成SID。系统消融SID构建、用户历史组成与长度、用户画像特征等关键设计。

Result: 实验表明跨平台SID能有效迁移至新推荐界面，消融研究揭示了SID构建方式、历史长度、用户画像特征等对性能的影响，为工业界在真实社交平台部署生成式推荐提供了实证指导。

Conclusion: 跨平台语义ID迁移是解决新推荐场景数据稀疏的有效路径，结合大规模预训练语言模型微调可实现零样本或少样本生成式推荐，相关设计选择对落地性能有显著影响，需根据业务场景权衡。

Abstract: Generative recommendation (GR) has emerged as an alternative to embedding-based retrieval, building on the success of generative models in language and vision. We are exploring GR on Facebook Forum, a standalone application for medium-to-heavy users of Facebook Groups. Because Forum is a new surface, its own interaction data are too sparse to train a GR model from scratch. We address this with transfer along two axes: we train on a broader corpus of Facebook Groups engagements rather than Forum sessions alone, and we reuse hierarchical, prefix-based semantic IDs (SIDs) learned from cross-platform Facebook Feed data instead of fitting a Forum-specific tokenizer. A 3B-parameter instruction-tuned language model is then supervised-fine-tuned to generate SIDs directly from user context. We systematically ablate the design choices that matter most in practice, including SID construction, the composition and length of user history, and the inclusion of user-profile features. Our results show that cross-platform SIDs transfer to a new recommendation surface, and offer practical guidance for teams deploying GR on real-world social platforms.

</details>


### [121] [PatchHolmes: Agentic Patch Retrieval via Listwise Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38807)
*Guanqun Yang,Yingming Zhou,Jiangrui Zheng,Shudong Hao,Xueqing Liu*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: PatchHolmes 是一种两阶段补丁检索系统，结合混合式初级检索器和代理式二级检查循环，用于查找修复已知漏洞的提交。它在 GitHubAD 数据集上显著优于现有方法，且仅需一个代理对话即可实现高召回率，无需微调或外部搜索 API。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主流漏洞公告数据库中 60% 到 63% 的 CVE 缺乏补丁链接，补丁检索是漏洞管理工作流的基础，但现有点对点方法效果有限且效率低下。

Method: 两阶段系统：第一阶段使用混合检索器获取候选提交；第二阶段采用代理式列表式检查循环，代理一次性查看前 100 个候选，通过四个预算工具选择性阅读 3 到 10 个提交，最后提交单个最佳提交。整个系统基于冻结的开放权重模型在本地 Git 仓库运行，无需微调或外部搜索 API。

Result: 在 GitHubAD 上，PatchHolmes 的 Recall@1 比点对点二分类器 Favia 高 25.34%，比检索加 CoT 基线 IRCoT 高 31.40%，且仅需每个 CVE 一个代理对话（Favia 需十个）。在相同候选集下，代理比直接取检索器首选提升 27.32% Recall@1；迁移到 PatchFinder_top10 将 Recall@1 从 24.28% 提升至 39.86%。在 Qwen 模型家族内更换骨干网络 Recall@1 变化小于 1%，另一模型家族 gpt-oss 仍远超无代理基线，证明增益源于列表式代理循环。

Conclusion: PatchHolmes 通过列表式代理循环实现了高效、鲁棒的补丁检索，显著提升召回率，且不依赖微调或外部 API，适合实际部署。

Abstract: Patch retrieval, the task of finding the commit that fixes a known vulnerability, is the foundation of vulnerability management workflows, yet 60% to 63% of CVEs in the major advisory databases lack a patch link. We present PatchHolmes, a two-phase patch retrieval system that pairs a hybrid first-stage retriever with an agentic second-stage inspection loop. Unlike pointwise prior work that scores each candidate independently, the Phase 2 agent reads the top-100 listwise: it sees the full candidate list at once and selectively reads 3 to 10 commits through four budgeted tools before submitting a single best commit. On GitHubAD, PatchHolmes beats the pointwise binary classifier Favia by 25.34% Recall@1 and the retrieve-and-CoT baseline IRCoT by 31.40%, at one agent conversation per CVE versus Favia's ten; with the candidate set held identical, the agent adds 27.32% Recall@1 over taking the retriever's top candidate, and the same agent, transferred unchanged to PatchFinder_top10, lifts Recall@1 from PatchFinder's own top-1 pick (24.28%) to 39.86%. Swapping the LLM backbone within the Qwen family changes Recall@1 by under 1%, and a second model family (gpt-oss) stays far above the no-agent floor, so the gain comes from the listwise agent loop; the entire system runs on a frozen open-weight model over a local Git repository, without fine-tuning or external search APIs.

</details>


### [122] [SkillSeek: Revisiting Agent Skill Retrieval at Marketplace Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38822)
*Guanqun Yang,Wenlong Zhang,Tian Shi,Ping Wang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 论文提出 SkillSeek，一种基于标准信息检索（IR）配方的两阶段技能检索器，用于解决大规模智能体技能库中的选择瓶颈。实验表明，简单的 BM25 加小型 cross-encoder 在 SkillsBench 基准上能以极低成本达到与 LLM 中介检索循环相当的性能，将每次试验成本从 51.30 美元降至 27.54 美元，接近无技能基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着开源智能体技能聚合超过 23 万条，技能选择而非编写成为主要瓶颈。现有文献将选择外包给 LLM 中介的检索循环，需在每个任务中支付大量 LLM token 成本，亟需一种低成本、高效率的替代方案。

Method: 构建 SkillSeek：采用标准 IR 两阶段流程——第一阶段用 BGE-base bi-encoder 进行稠密检索，第二阶段用小型 cross-encoder 重排序，通过 MCP 接口暴露。对比基线包括纯 BM25、LLM 中介检索循环等，在 89 任务 SkillsBench 基准上，跨 4 个技能池、11 个骨干模型和多种方法进行网格实验。

Result: SkillSeek 在观测性能上与 Liu 等人的 LLM 中介循环达到平齐，且额外成本极低。纯 BM25 在四个设置中的三个上通过率已达到或超过 LLM 循环；小型 cross-encoder 补齐了第四个设置的差距。首阶段召回上限解释了该模式。总每试验花费从 51.30 美元降至 27.54 美元，仅比无技能基线高出约 0.5 美元。

Conclusion: 在 SkillsBench 任务和 OpenHands 框架下，标准 IR 配方（BM25 + 小型 cross-encoder）是智能体技能检索的强默认基线，LLM 中介检索仅在确定性方法失效时才作为自然补充。

Abstract: Anthropic's Agent Skills package reusable procedural know-how for an LLM agent into SKILL.md directories, and open-source aggregations have grown past 230,000 skills, making selection rather than authoring the bottleneck. The standing answer in the literature outsources selection to the agent itself: an LLM-mediated retrieval loop that rewrites queries and refines candidates inside the agent's decision loop, paying LLM tokens on every task. We present SkillSeek, an open-source two-stage skill retriever built from the standard IR recipe (a BGE-base bi-encoder feeding a small cross-encoder, exposed over MCP). Across a $4 \times 11$ grid of pool, backbone, and method on the 89-task SkillsBench benchmark, SkillSeek reaches observed parity with the LLM-mediated loop of Liu et al. at essentially no extra cost: plain bm25 alone records a pass rate at or above their refined loop on three of four settings, and a small cross-encoder covers the remaining difference on the fourth. A first-stage recall ceiling explains the pattern, and total per-trial spend drops from USD 51.30 to USD 27.54 (within fifty cents of the no-skill baseline). Under the SkillsBench tasks and OpenHands harness we tested, this positions the standard IR recipe as a strong default for agent-skill retrieval, with LLM-mediated alternatives a natural fit for cases where deterministic methods fall short.

</details>


### [123] [Text-Video Retrieval via Multi-Dimensional Saliency Assessment and Granularity-Aware Query Decomposition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38949)
*Shuquan Wei,Xi Chen,Xu Chen,Xiangyang Jia*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出MMTI方法，通过关键特征选择(KFS)机制和多粒度文本-视频交互模块(TVIM)，联合缓解视觉冗余并实现多粒度语义对齐，在四个标准基准上超越现有最优方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文本-视频检索方法存在两大问题：1) 视觉重要性评估依赖单一准则，忽视视频多面时空特性；2) 文本编码为单一全局嵌入，将时序事件和空间实体压缩至统一空间，加剧跨模态错位。

Method: 提出MMTI框架，包含两大核心模块：1) 关键特征选择(KFS)机制：联合评估多维显著性和可学习重要性分数，自适应识别并聚合信息丰富的帧和补丁，压缩稠密视觉特征；2) 多粒度文本-视频交互模块(TVIM)：采用动态门控机制将文本查询分解为句子、帧、补丁查询(SFP)，实现多粒度互补对齐。

Result: 在四个标准基准数据集上进行大量实验，结果表明该方法优于现有最先进的文本-视频检索方法。

Conclusion: MMTI通过联合视觉冗余缓解和多粒度交互，有效解决了跨模态语义对齐中的关键问题，为文本-视频检索任务提供了更精准的多粒度语义匹配方案。

Abstract: Text-video retrieval, which aims to bridge visual and textual modalities by learning a joint embedding space, has become a crucial task in multimodal intelligence. Despite extensive efforts to mitigate visual redundancy, previous methods typically rely on a single-aspect criterion to assess visual importance, overlooking the multifaceted spatiotemporal nature of video. In addition, encoding text into a single global embedding to align with videos compresses temporal events and spatial entities into a unified representation space, further aggravating cross-modal misalignment. To address these issues, we propose MMTI, a method that jointly mitigates visual redundancy and enables multi-grained text-video interaction to achieve accurate multi-grained semantic alignment. Specifically, a key feature selection (KFS) mechanism adaptively identifies and aggregates informative frames and patches by jointly evaluating multi-dimensional saliency and learnable importance scores, effectively compacting dense visual features and mitigating visual redundancy. Furthermore, our proposed multi-grained text-video interaction module (TVIM) employs a dynamic gating mechanism to decompose the text query into sentence, frame, and patch queries (SFP), enabling multi-grained text-video alignment. Complementary alignment at different granularities is thereby achieved. Extensive experiments on four standard benchmarks demonstrate that our method outperforms state-of-the-art methods.

</details>


### [124] [When LLM-Inferred User Context Adds Value in Production Streaming Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38999)
*Milad Sabouri,Neeraj Sharma,Sardar Hamidian,Shaghayegh Agah*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文评估了基于大语言模型（LLM）生成的语义用户画像与传统聚合嵌入画像在流媒体推荐系统中的表现，发现两者的优劣取决于用户的消费模式：习惯性消费用户（约80%）适合聚合画像，探索性消费用户适合LLM生成画像；LLM画像虽提升列表内多样性，但降低目录覆盖率和新颖性。建议根据推断的消费模式动态选择画像策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推荐系统中的上下文信息正从静态预定义变量转向从行为中推断的潜在表示。大语言模型支持将非结构化交互历史转化为自然语言摘要，生成主题性用户上下文，可替代聚合画像。然而，何种条件下生成式画像优于聚合嵌入仅在领域层面有限表征，需在实际生产环境中系统评估。

Method: 在生产级流媒体平台上进行在线评估，采用2×2实验设计：画像表示类型（聚合嵌入 vs LLM生成）与上下文范围（全历史 vs 注意力融合的短长期上下文）交叉。对全目录进行排序，分析不同消费模式（习惯性 vs 探索性）用户的推荐效果，并测量多样性、目录覆盖率、新颖性等指标。

Result: 实验表明：聚合画像在习惯性消费用户（约占用户四分之三）上持续优于LLM生成画像；LLM生成画像在探索性消费用户（后续交互与历史语义发散）上表现更强。LLM画像存在“流行度吸引效应”：略微提升列表内多样性，但显著降低目录覆盖率和新颖性。

Conclusion: 结果表明，上下文感知系统应根据推断的用户消费模式动态选择画像策略，而非对所有用户统一应用单一表示方法。

Abstract: Contextual information in recommender systems is shifting from static, predefined variables toward latent representations inferred from behavior. Large language models support this shift by rendering an unstructured interaction history as a natural-language summary, which yields a thematic user context that can be encoded and used in place of an aggregate profile. The conditions under which such generated profiles outperform aggregate embeddings have received limited characterization mainly at the domain level. We evaluate semantic user-profiling strategies on a production streaming platform, ranking against the full catalog. The evaluation covers a 2*2 design space crossing representation type (aggregate or LLM-generated) with contextual scope (holistic history or attention-fused short-term and long-term contexts). The relative ordering of the two representation types is conditional on the user's consumption regime. Aggregate profiles are consistently stronger under habitual consumption, which characterizes approximately four-fifths of the population, while LLM-generated profiles are stronger for exploratory users whose subsequent interactions diverge semantically from their history. We also observe a popularity-attractor effect in LLM-generated profiles, which modestly raises within-list diversity while substantially lowering catalog coverage and reducing novelty. These results indicate that a context-aware system can select a profiling strategy from the inferred consumption regime rather than applying one representation to all users.

</details>


### [125] [RouteRec: Behavior-Guided Sparse Routing for Sequential Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39007)
*Junyeong Song,Jaemin Yoo*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: RouteRec 是一种序列推荐模型，利用会话化历史中的四类行为线索（交互节奏、物品群聚焦、重复与延续、流行度倾向）在宏、中、微三个层级引导专家混合（MoE）的路由选择，实现了条件计算，在 6 个公开数据集的 18 个数据集-指标组合中平均排名 1.61，显著优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有序列推荐模型对所有会话使用相同参数，忽视了会话间的行为差异；虽然专家混合（MoE）支持条件计算，但缺乏明确的路由准则来决定专家分配。

Method: 从会话化历史中提取四类行为证据：交互节奏、物品群聚焦、重复与延续、流行度倾向。基于这些线索在宏（专家组选择）、中、微三个层级进行路由：线索派生的分数先选择专家组，再由当前主干网络状态在组内细化专家选择。

Result: 在 6 个公开数据集的 18 个数据集-指标组合中，RouteRec 有 12 个排名第一、3 个排名第二，总体平均排名 1.61，远优于次优基线的 4.11。消融实验表明行为线索引导的路由超越了单纯增加模型容量的效果，且路由模式与观测行为一致。

Conclusion: RouteRec 证明了利用会话行为线索作为 MoE 路由依据的有效性，在不增加过多参数的前提下实现了最优推荐性能，且产生了可解释的、与用户行为对齐的路由模式。

Abstract: Sessionized interaction histories contain behavioral patterns that can improve sequential recommendation. However, existing models process all sessions through the same parameterized blocks, regardless of their behavioral differences. Mixture of Experts (MoE) enables conditional computation, but it leaves open what should guide expert allocation. We propose RouteRec, a sequential recommender that uses observed session behavior as the routing criterion. RouteRec summarizes four types of behavioral evidence from sessionized histories: interaction tempo, item-group focus, repetition and carryover, and popularity tendency. It uses these cues to route computation at macro, mid, and micro scopes. Cue-derived scores first select expert groups; within each selected group, the current backbone state then refines expert selection. Across six public datasets and 18 dataset-metric combinations, RouteRec ranks first in 12 and second in three, yielding the best overall average rank of 1.61 compared with 4.11 for the next-best baseline. Additional analyses suggest that the behavioral cues guide expert allocation beyond added capacity and produce routing patterns aligned with observed behavior. Our code is available at https://github.com/jy1559/RouteRec

</details>


### [126] [Routing Between Generative and Collaborative User Profiles: A Serving-Time Gate for Controllable Novelty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39043)
*Milad Sabouri,Neeraj Sharma,Sardar Hamidian,Shaghayegh Agah*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出一种服务时路由门控机制，选择性地将用户分配给基于LLM生成画像的推荐模型或协同序列推荐模型，在保持相关性的前提下提升新颖性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM生成的用户画像虽语义丰富，但生成成本高且不适合统一部署，因此研究如何在生产推荐流水线中选择性调用这些画像。

Method: 使用真实流媒体数据集，训练一个服务时路由门控，仅基于服务时特征决定将用户路由至协同序列推荐模型或LLM画像驱动模型，门控学习识别能从画像路由中获益的用户，通过阈值控制新颖性-相关性权衡。

Result: 在NDCG损失预算5%下，学习型门控使Novelty@10提升6.5%，仅路由12.5%用户，优于启发式和随机路由策略；非生成语义画像实验表明收益源于选择性路由而非LLM生成本身。

Conclusion: LLM生成的用户画像可作为协同推荐的可控补充，选择性路由机制能有效平衡新颖性与相关性，且核心优势在于路由策略而非生成技术。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) enable rich semantic user profiles for recommendation, but such profiles are more expensive to generate and are not necessarily desirable to deploy uniformly. We study whether LLM-generated profiles can instead be invoked selectively within a production recommendation pipeline. Using a real-world streaming dataset covering movies, TV shows, and sports content, we train a serving-time routing gate that assigns each user to either a collaborative sequential recommendation model or a recommendation model driven by an LLM-generated profile. The gate uses only serving-time features and learns to identify users for whom profile-based routing can increase Novelty@10 while preserving ranking relevance. A routing threshold controls how aggressively users are sent to the generative model, exposing a tunable novelty--relevance trade-off. At an overall NDCG-loss budget of 5\%, the learned gate increases Novelty@10 by 6.5\% while routing 12.5\% of users, outperforming simple heuristic and random routing policies at comparable relevance cost. These results show that LLM-generated user profiles can serve as a controllable complement to collaborative recommendation, while results with non-generative semantic profiles indicate that the benefit stems from selective routing rather than LLM generation alone.

</details>


### [127] [Learning Multiresolution Relevance for Hierarchical Generative Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39312)
*Weihao Shen,Wei Chen,Fuwei Zhang,Guojun Liu,Qingsong Hua,Wei Lin,Fuzhen Zhuang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出 RARS（Resolution-Aligned Relevance Supervision），一种针对生成式检索中语义标识符（SID）层次结构的多粒度相关性监督方法。RARS 将文档级相关性沿 SID 前缀聚合，训练前缀条件预测器在同级分支间分配相关性质量，通过局部竞争损失并按父节点到达的相关性质量加权，使查询编码器同时捕捉粗粒度共享结构和细粒度分支分配。推理时丢弃预测器，保持标准自回归解码。在三个多语言 ESCI 数据集上，RARS 持续优于全 SID 监督及多种基线，且泛化至不同标识符结构和相关性定义。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式检索中，相关文档在 SID 层次中共享粗粒度前缀、在细粒度分歧，分支模式随查询变化。标准全 SID 监督将每条路径视为独立目标，忽略了相关性在层次细化过程中的显式分配，导致查询编码器难以同时学习粗细两级结构。

Method: RARS 从单一文档级相关性度量推导出跨 SID 层次的一致条件分布，将多粒度相关性显式化。具体做法：1）沿前缀聚合文档相关性；2）训练前缀条件预测器，在同级分支间分配相关性质量，所有携带相关性的子节点参与局部竞争；3）每个局部损失按到达父节点的相关性质量加权；4）联合优化查询编码器与预测器，训练后丢弃预测器，推理保持自回归解码。

Result: 在三个多语言 ESCI 本地化数据集上，RARS 在自回归解码下持续超越匹配的全 SID 训练。同时优于分组软目标、解码器软目标和采样树监督等基线。增益在不同标识符结构（如原子 ID、语义 ID）和相关性定义（二值、分级）下均保持。

Conclusion: RARS 通过显式建模 SID 层次上的多粒度相关性分配，有效指导查询编码器学习粗细结合的相关性表示，无需改变推理流程即可稳健提升生成式检索性能，且泛化能力强。

Abstract: Generative retrieval with semantic identifiers (SIDs) makes successive decisions over a document hierarchy. Relevant documents for the same query may share coarse prefixes and diverge at finer depths, with branching patterns varying across queries. These paths reveal how relevance is distributed across successive refinements, yet standard full-SID supervision treats them as separate training targets. To make this allocation explicit, we formulate multiresolution relevance as consistent conditional distributions induced by a single document-level relevance measure across the SID hierarchy. We introduce \textbf{RARS}, \textbf{R}esolution-\textbf{A}ligned \textbf{R}elevance \textbf{S}upervision, which uses the resulting refinement-level distributions to supervise a shared query representation. RARS aggregates document relevance over prefixes and trains a prefix-conditioned predictor to allocate relevance among sibling branches. All relevance-bearing children participate in local competition, and each local loss is weighted by the relevance mass reaching its parent. This objective trains the query encoder to capture both the coarse structure shared by relevant documents and their finer branch allocations. The predictor is discarded after training, preserving standard autoregressive retrieval at inference. Experiments on three multilingual ESCI locales show consistent improvements over matched full-SID training under autoregressive decoding. RARS also outperforms grouped soft-target, decoder soft-target, and sampled-tree supervision under a common retrieval rule. The gains persist across alternative identifier structures and relevance definitions. Code is available at: https://github.com/Nevaeh7/RARS

</details>


### [128] [Residual Trajectory Distillation for Generative Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39319)
*Weihao Shen,Wei Chen,Fuwei Zhang,Guojun Liu,Qingsong Hua,Wei Lin,Fuzhen Zhuang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出 ResTD（残差轨迹蒸馏）框架，解决生成式检索中硬 SID 监督丢弃残差量化轨迹信息的问题。将冻结的 RQ 索引器作为过程教师，将残差诱导的码字偏好蒸馏到 SID 解码状态中，恢复硬分配掩盖的区别，使早期解码器状态能捕捉后续量化决策信息，在保持原有检索索引和推理流程不变的前提下提升检索性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式检索使用残差量化（RQ）构建语义 ID（SID），但标准训练仅监督选中的硬码字，丢弃产生这些码字的残差轨迹。相同的硬码字可能源于不同的码字偏好，且残差轨迹包含后续量化决策的信息。硬 SID 监督将不同的量化行为折叠为相同目标，导致索引构建阶段可用的信息在检索训练中未被利用。

Method: ResTD 框架：将冻结的 RQ 索引器视为过程教师，提取残差量化过程中产生的码字偏好分布（软目标），通过蒸馏损失将这些偏好迁移到生成式检索模型的解码器状态中。具体来说，在解码每个 SID token 时，利用教师模型在该步骤的残差轨迹信息（如码字概率分布）指导学生模型，使早期解码状态编码后续量化决策信息。保持原有索引结构和推理流程不变。

Result: 在多语言电商检索任务上，ResTD 持续优于强基线和匹配的训练对照组。控制实验表明残差派生的软目标优于仅基于码本的软目标。表征探测显示，未来码本偏好从早期解码器状态中变得更可恢复。ResTD 还可直接扩展到生成式推荐任务。

Conclusion: ResTD 通过残差轨迹蒸馏有效回收了 RQ 索引构建过程中被丢弃的信息，弥补了硬 SID 监督的信息损失，在不改变检索索引和推理流程的情况下显著提升了生成式检索性能，并展现了向生成式推荐泛化的潜力。

Abstract: Generative retrieval has emerged as a general retrieval paradigm, representing items with discrete Semantic IDs (SIDs) and retrieving them through autoregressive identifier generation. When SIDs are constructed with residual quantization (RQ), standard retrieval training supervises only the selected codes and discards the residual trajectories that produce them. The same hard code can nevertheless arise from different preferences over competing codewords, while the residual trajectory also contains information about subsequent quantization decisions. As a result, hard SID supervision collapses distinct quantization behaviors into identical targets and leaves information available during indexing unused in retrieval training. We introduce ResTD, a Residual Trajectory Distillation framework that transfers this discarded indexing information into retrieval training. Treating the frozen RQ indexer as a process teacher, it distills residual-induced codeword preferences into SID-decoding states. This supervision recovers distinctions hidden by hard assignments and allows earlier decoder states to capture information about subsequent quantization decisions before the corresponding SID suffix is generated. In this way, richer information from SID construction is incorporated into retrieval learning while preserving the original retrieval index and inference procedure. Experiments on multilingual e-commerce retrieval show consistent improvements over strong baselines and matched training controls. Controlled comparisons show that residual-derived targets outperform the tested codebook-only soft targets. Representation probes further show that future codebook preferences become more recoverable from earlier decoder states. ResTD can also be readily extended beyond retrieval to generative recommendation. Code is available at: https://github.com/Nevaeh7/iclr2027_ResTD.git.

</details>


### [129] [Generative End-to-end Ad Retrieval at Douyin](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39327)
*Shaowen Zeng,Yanhua Huang,Jiacheng Sun,Jiarui Liu,Qian Dai,Zhikai Yang,Hancheng Li,Boya Wu,Tuoyu Zhang,Yekui Chen,Xiang Sun*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: GEAR框架解决生成式检索中的表示崩塌和物品碰撞问题，提出BasisVQ/BasisRQ稳定分词器，引入上下文感知重排序头，实现端到端可微分可扩展范式，已在抖音广告大规模部署并显著提升效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式检索将推荐建模为离散物品token生成，但在实际系统中面临两大瓶颈：1)表示崩塌，分词器在连续分布漂移下收敛到退化结果，阻碍稳定端到端适配；2)物品碰撞，海量候选池导致不同物品共享相同token序列，降低检索精度。且二者耦合：扩大码本容量缓解碰撞反而加剧崩塌。

Method: 提出GEAR端到端框架联合优化分词器、生成器和重排序器。1) BasisVQ：将码本重参数化为正交基，实现全局梯度共享和潜在空间刚性旋转，稳定梯度动态；2) BasisRQ：前缀感知扩展，在相同时间复杂度下大幅提升码本表达能力；3) 上下文条件重排序头：集成到生成过程中，高效消除碰撞物品歧义，计算开销极小。

Result: GEAR建立完全可微分且可扩展的生成式检索范式，已在抖音广告服务数亿日活用户，大规模在线A/B测试显示显著经验改进。

Conclusion: 通过统一稳定分词与联合重排序，GEAR同时解决了表示崩塌和物品碰撞这一对耦合瓶颈，为工业级生成式推荐提供了理论可靠且工程可行的解决方案。

Abstract: Generative retrieval reformulates recommendation as the generation of discrete item tokens. However, scaling this paradigm to real-world recommender systems reveals two critical bottlenecks: 1) Representation collapse, where the item tokenizer converges to degenerate results under continuous distribution shifts, fundamentally hindering stable end-to-end adaptation. 2) Item collisions, where the massive candidate pool causes distinct items to share identical token sequences, compromising the final retrieval precision. Crucially, these bottlenecks are inherently coupled: expanding codebook capacity to mitigate collisions inevitably exacerbates collapse. To address them simultaneously, we propose GEAR, an end-to-end framework that jointly optimizes the tokenizer, generator, and reranker. To mitigate representation collapse, we introduce BasisVQ, which re-parameterizes the codebook via an orthogonal basis to enable global gradient sharing and rigid spatial rotation of the latent space, effectively stabilizing gradient dynamics without ad-hoc heuristics. We further extend it to prefix-aware BasisRQ, substantially enhancing the codebook's expressiveness with the same asymptotic time complexity. To resolve item collisions, GEAR integrates a context-conditioned reranking head into the generative process, efficiently disambiguating colliding items with minimal computational overhead. By unifying stable tokenization and joint reranking within an end-to-end generative framework, GEAR establishes a fully differentiable and scalable paradigm. It currently serves hundreds of millions of daily active users on Douyin Ads, yielding substantial empirical improvements in extensive online A/B tests.

</details>


### [130] [When the Label Ignores the Request: Auditing Policy-Selected Targets in Synthetic Conversational Music Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39696)
*Sanjeev Suresh*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 论文审计了基于LLM管道生成的合成对话基准（RecSys Challenge 2026 TalkPlay），发现官方标签在一半被审计的开发轮次中与用户精确点歌请求冲突。提出在少量训练轮次中添加目录解析的请求满足目标，使冲突轮次的nDCG@20相对提升53.3%，且不损害官方指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前对话推荐基准依赖LLM生成的合成对话，官方标签由策略选取的LLM推荐者产生，仅为用户请求的代理。真实音乐搜索中精确点歌是主导意图，部署系统避免替代精确命名的条目。需审计标签与请求的直接可比之处（精确点歌轮次），量化冲突程度并改进训练。

Method: 1) 利用可见对话与目录元数据，审计开发集中用户精确点歌的轮次，对比官方标签与请求歌曲是否一致。2) 构建训练时补充：在少量训练轮次中加入目录解析的请求满足目标（即用户点歌的真实条目）。3) 与仅用官方标签训练的匹配对照组对比，验证在冲突轮次上的nDCG@20提升及官方指标保持。

Result: 在被审计的开发轮次中，官方标签与用户精确点歌请求冲突比例达50%。引入请求满足目标后，冲突轮次（43个）的nDCG@20相对提升53.3%，同时官方整体指标保持不变。对照实验确认：相同请求检测下，仅用官方标签训练无此提升。

Conclusion: 合成对话基准的官方标签在精确点歌场景下高频偏离用户真实意图，这反映真实部署风险。微小的训练数据增强（目录解析的请求满足目标）能显著缩小差距，且不损害基准官方指标，为对话推荐系统的鲁棒训练提供低成本修正方案。

Abstract: Synthetic dialogues generated by LLM pipelines now serve as complete conversational-recommendation benchmarks: an LLM listener talks to an LLM recommender, and the track logged next in the conversation becomes the official label for each turn. These policy-selected labels make large-scale evaluation reproducible, but they are proxies for what the simulated user asked. We audit the one place where label and request are directly comparable: turns where the user asks for an exact song by name. In the RecSys Challenge 2026 TalkPlay benchmark, using visible dialogue and catalog metadata alone, we find that the official label contradicts the user's exact-song request in half of the audited development turns. This matters beyond one benchmark: naming the desired item is the dominant intent in real music search, where deployed systems avoid substituting an alternative for an exactly named item, on the premise that it costs satisfaction. A small training-time supplement closes most of the gap: adding catalog-resolved request-satisfying targets to a small fraction of training turns yields a 53.3% relative gain in nDCG@20 on the 43 conflict turns while leaving the official metric intact, verified against a matched control that detects the same requests but trains only on official labels.

</details>


### [131] [KUAISHOU Explorer LLM-Rec Challenge 2026: Reasoning Generative Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39828)
*Jiangxia Cao,Hao Peng,Wenlong Xu,Jiaxin Deng,Zhixin Ling,Xingmei Wang,Kun Shang,Can Tang,Zhihuai Cai,Jun Du,Fang Su,Xiaojuan Liu,Yiling Li,Chenglong Yu,Chongling Rao,Haixuan Gao,Haitao Xu,Jian Liang,Ruiming Tang,Chenglong Chu,Guohong Mu,Honghui Bao,Hui Wang,Jialong Chen,Jiao Ou,Muhao Wei,Peng Zhang,Renpu Liu,Ruochen Yang,Shugui Liu,Xinqi Jin,Yan Sun,Yifan Wang,Yingzhi He,Yufei Ye,Yusen Huo,Tingkuo Wang,Jihong Zhang,Lanxi Zhu,Pengyuan Liu,Zhipeng Yi,Luankang Zhang,Hang Lv,Xuyang Zhi,Tianyu Li,Bintao Wu,Chuang Ou,Siyue Su,Ziyuan Wang,Yuliang Sun,Baiyan Che,Feiyang Xu,Shiwen Zhang,Shiteng Cao,Chongcong Jiang,Yuan Fang,Xiangwu Yang,Hao Deng,Zijian Du,Pengxun Wang,Xiaoming Wang,Shun Qin,Yingqi Song,Tianyi Li,Naixiao Peng,Chenyu Zhou,Qiliang Jiang,Quan Zheng,Cheng Jin,Siying Zeng,Hongjia Xu,Junwu Hu,Teng Fu,Zhengkang Mei,Haijun Yu,Kai Li,Shengyang Zhou,Zhijia Wei,Siyi Xiong,Bo Liu,Zichun Guo,Zhubin Han,Jinpeng Fu,Bingqian Liu,Yuyi Wang,Yu Liu,Qinghai Tan,Ruijie Zhou,Zhuohang Li,Zhijia Zhong,Xiangnan He,Jirong Wen,Min Zhang,Wenwu Ou,Peng Jiang,Han Li,Kaiqiao Zhan,Yanan Niu,Lantao Hu,Kun Gai*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 该团队基于语义ID开发了OneRec系列生成式推荐模型，并进一步探索将自然语言与推理链（CoT）引入推荐，提出OneReason增强语义对齐、模板监督和强化学习，同时发起SIGIR 2026推理生成式推荐挑战赛。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式推荐在工业界和学术界受到关注，大语言模型发展推动下一代推荐系统研究。团队已成功部署基于语义ID的OneRec/OneRec-V2，并希望进一步挖掘自然语言链式推理在推荐中的潜力，解决CoT推理不一定提升推荐性能的问题。

Method: 1. 开发基于语义ID的自回归下一个物品预测模型OneRec/OneRec-V2；2. 探索OneRec-Think、OpenOneRec、OneReason等模型，将物品语义ID与自然语言统一到同一表示空间；3. OneReason引入结构化模板监督进行兴趣推理，强化语义对齐，并应用先进强化学习技术使推理更有益于推荐。

Result: OneRec/OneRec-V2已大规模部署于生产环境，验证了自回归生成式推荐的扩展潜力；初步工作发现引入CoT推理并不总能提升推荐性能；OneReason通过语义对齐、模板监督和强化学习改进了推理效果；团队联合SIGIR 2026举办KUAISHOU Explorer LLM-Rec Challenge 2026挑战赛。

Conclusion: 推理生成式推荐是构建推荐基座模型的前沿课题，具有重要研究价值。团队希望通过开源模型系列和挑战赛，鼓励更多研究者共同探索该方向。

Abstract: Generative recommendation, has been attracted a surge of attentions in industrial and academic research community, towards to build more smart system to build next-generation recommender. Under the significant developing wave of large language model, our team have been developed Semantic ID based OneRec/OneRec-V2. These models have been widely deployed in production and demonstrate the scaling potential of the autoregressive next-item prediction paradigm for industrial recommender systems. Building on the success of OneRec, we further explored a series of models, including OneRec-Think, OpenOneRec, and OneReason, that connect item Semantic IDs with natural language in a unified representation space and seek to unlock the potential of natural-language chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning for recommendation. However, our preliminary works found that introducing reasoning CoT does not always improve the recommendation performance. To address this issue, OneReason strengthens the semantic alignment between items and language, introduces structured template-based supervision for interest reasoning, and applies advanced reinforcement learning techniques to make reasoning more beneficial to recommendation. As a frontier topic to building recommendation foundation models, we believe this topic has significant research value and hope to encourage more researchers to explore it together. To this end, together with the SIGIR 2026 community, we organized the KUAISHOU Explorer LLM-Rec Challenge 2026: Reasoning Generative Recommendation.

</details>


### [132] [Decision-Oriented Recommendation Reranking: An Empirical Study of Jev](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40241)
*Hanjia Lyu,Yinglong Xia*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 论文探索决策导向模型 Jev（System One Model）用于推荐重排序，对比推荐专用模型和 Qwen 点式/列式重排序器，发现在多个 Amazon Reviews 领域和候选集规模下，Jev 能保持强推荐效果且延迟增长更平缓，但延迟仍高于推荐专用模型，形成独特的质量-延迟工作区间，激励进一步研究决策导向模型在结构化输出排序任务中的应用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型（LLM）虽在推荐重排序表现优异，但引入推荐质量与服务效率的重要权衡；重排序本质上是从预定义候选项中进行结构化选择，决策导向模型可能提供更优替代方案。

Method: 进行受控实证研究：在多个 Amazon Reviews 领域和不同候选集规模上，将 Jev 与推荐专用模型、点式 Qwen 重排序器、列式 Qwen 重排序器对比，同时评估推荐效果（如 NDCG、HR 等）和观测服务延迟。

Result: Jev 在推荐效果上与基线持平或略优，延迟增长随候选集规模增加显著慢于点式 Qwen 重排序器，但绝对延迟仍明显高于推荐专用模型；这使 Jev 处于独特的质量-延迟工作区间。

Conclusion: 决策导向模型 Jev 为推荐重排序提供了新的质量-延迟权衡点，验证了其在结构化输出排序任务中的潜力，值得进一步研究此类模型在推荐及其他排序任务中的应用。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise for recommendation reranking, but their use introduces an important tradeoff between recommendation quality and serving efficiency. We investigate whether a decision-oriented model provides a useful alternative when the reranking task is fundamentally a structured choice among predefined candidate items. Specifically, we conduct a controlled empirical study of Jev, described by TypeSafe AI as a ``System One Model,'' for personalized recommendation reranking and compare it with recommendation-specific models and pointwise and listwise Qwen rerankers across multiple Amazon Reviews domains and candidate-set sizes, evaluating both recommendation effectiveness and observed serving latency. Our results show that Jev maintains strong recommendation effectiveness relative to the evaluated baselines while exhibiting substantially more gradual latency growth than the pointwise Qwen rerankers, although its observed serving latency remains substantially higher than that of recommendation-specific models. Together, these characteristics place Jev in a distinct quality--latency operating regime across candidate sizes and domains. These findings motivate further investigation of decision-oriented models for recommendation and other ranking tasks with structured output spaces.

</details>


### [133] [LegalPincite: Multi-level Legal Information Retrieval Dataset](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03756)
*Theresia Veronika Rampisela,Henrik Palmer Olsen,Giovanni Colavizza*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 论文发布了一个大规模法律信息检索数据集 LegalPincite，基于欧盟法院（CJEU）判决书构建，解决现有数据集存在的查询文本数据泄露、语料库排除非引用段落等问题，支持案例到案例、段落到案例、段落到段落多粒度检索任务，并提供部分人工专家验证的真值标注。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有公开法律 IR 数据集缺乏段落级引用标注；含段落级引用的数据集存在查询文本中的引用信息泄露，且语料库排除了非引用段落，导致检索设置过于简化、性能虚高，无法反映真实法律检索场景中精准定位段落（pincite）的需求。

Method: 从 CJEU 判决书构建数据集，包含三大核心组件：(i) 掩码后的案例/段落查询，移除了引用信息；(ii) 包含所有段落的完整语料库，不再仅保留被引/引用段落；(iii) 案例级与段落级的真值引用标注，并经过部分人工专家验证。数据集支持案例到案例、段落到案例、段落到段落三种检索粒度。

Result: 发布了 LegalPincite 数据集及代码（Hugging Face），提供大规模、真实、多粒度的法律 IR 评测基准，填补了段落级精准引用检索的数据空白，消除了查询泄露与语料库不完整带来的评测偏差。

Conclusion: LegalPincite 为法律 IR 研究提供了更严谨、更贴近实战的评测环境，推动段落级精准引用检索方法的开发与公平比较，有助于缩小学术基准与实际法律检索需求的差距。

Abstract: A common task in legal Information Retrieval (IR) is to find relevant legal sources from case-law collections. While legal practice often requires pinpoint citations (pincites) to specific case paragraphs, most existing public legal IR datasets lack paragraph-level citation annotations. Yet, publicly available datasets with such information contain data leakage in the query text and exclude paragraphs that are neither citing nor cited from the corpora, creating an unrealistic and oversimplified retrieval setting, potentially leading to inflated performance. To address these limitations, we contribute a large-scale legal IR dataset constructed from Court of Justice of the European Union (CJEU) judgments. The dataset contains: (i) masked case/paragraph queries, with removed citation information; (ii) a corpus that includes all paragraphs; and (iii) case- and paragraph-level ground truth citations, with partial human expert validation. Our dataset supports both the development and rigorous evaluation of legal IR methods, at multiple query-document levels (case-to-case, paragraph-to-case, and paragraph-to-paragraph retrieval). Link to dataset and code: https://huggingface.co/datasets/theresiavr/legalpincite

</details>

### [134] [Travel Time Prediction in Supply Chain Management Using Machine Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38190)
*Balaji Venkateswaran*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究旨在利用机器学习和深度学习方法，基于大量历史数据构建准确的供应链运输物流旅行时间预测模型，以提升物流一致性和性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 供应链生态系统复杂且高度依赖原材料和成品的运输物流，准确的旅行时间预测对于改善物流一致性、规划、需求预测、前置时间管理、装配规划以及客户满意度至关重要。

Method: 收集大量历史数据，采用新颖的机器学习和深度学习技术，构建库存旅行时间预测模型。

Result: 成功建立了能够准确预测供应链运输物流旅行时间的模型。

Conclusion: 基于机器学习和深度学习的旅行时间预测模型能够有效提升供应链物流性能，支持规划、预测和客户满意度管理等关键环节。

Abstract: The purpose of this research is to find data and methods using machine learning and deep learning to correctly predict the estimated travel time for transportation and logistics in a supply chain system. The supply chain ecosystem is very complex and heavily relies on the transportation and logistics of raw materials and finished goods. Accurate travel time estimation is critical because it helps supply chain members to improve logistics consistency and performance. This helps in planning, demand forecasting, lead time management and assembly planning. The logistics on the delivery side of the customer also plays a crucial role in customer satisfaction and voice of customer. With the collection of huge historical data and using novel techniques, the research builds an accurate model to predict travel time of inventory.

</details>


### [135] [EHR2Trace: Auditable EHR Data Infrastructure for Patient World Models and Clinical Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38193)
*Xinye Yang,Yuli Wang,Cheng Ting Lin,Harrison Bai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: EHR2Trace 系统将异构 EHR 数据转换为可追溯的患者事件，支持模型训练与评估，实验表明其能检测数据错误并揭示时间泄漏导致的性能虚高问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 患者世界模型和临床智能体需要可靠的患者病史、治疗及决策时可用信息，但不同来源的 EHR 记录方式不一致，难以统一使用。

Method: 提出 EHR2Trace 系统：将 EHR 转换为可追溯事件，链接源记录，分离事件时间与信息可用时间，区分医嘱、配药、给药；统一事件表示支持 OMOP 和 MEDS 导出，提供自动化验证与可复现构建。

Result: 在三个临床数据集上转换 8.464 亿事件，除 MIMIC-IV 一项单位一致性检查外均通过，检出全部 28 个注入故障；受控实验显示将后续诊断归于入院时间会虚高性能，且基于此类数据训练的模型在按可用性过滤的历史上准确率下降。

Conclusion: EHR2Trace 为患者世界模型和临床智能体提供可复用的数据基础，帮助研究者检查病史、验证转换决策、用显式数据规则评估模型。

Abstract: Patient world models and clinical agents aim to predict changes in patients' health and support clinical work. Developing these systems requires reliable histories of patient conditions, treatments, and the information available at each decision. Electronic health records (EHRs) contain these histories, but differences in how events are recorded make them difficult to use consistently. We present EHR2Trace, a system that converts EHRs from different sources into traceable patient events for model training and evaluation. It links events to source records, separates event time from information availability, and distinguishes medication orders, dispensing, and administration. A shared event representation supports both OMOP and MEDS exports, with automated validation and reproducible builds. Across three clinical datasets, EHR2Trace converted 846.4 million events, with every applicable check passing except one unit-consistency check on MIMIC-IV, and detected all 28 injected faults. A controlled prediction experiment showed that assigning later diagnoses to admission time substantially inflated measured performance, and that a model trained on such data lost accuracy when deployed on histories filtered by availability. EHR2Trace provides a reusable data foundation for patient world models and clinical agents, helping researchers inspect patient histories, check conversion decisions, and evaluate models with explicit data rules.

</details>


### [136] [A Moving-Horizon Approximate Branch-and-Reduce Method for Deep Classification Trees](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38194)
*Chenxuanyin Zou,Jiayang Ren,Qiangqiang Mao,Jing Liu,Marcus Lai,Yankai Cao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种移动视界近似分支缩减方法，用于在大规模连续特征数据集上训练近似最优的深层分类树，结合层次化根-子树优化框架，通过分支缩减求解根节点问题，用贪心启发式近似子树问题，并采用低成本移动视界策略迭代提升精度，实验表明其在测试准确率上优于现有启发式基线，且在数据集规模和树深度上显著优于全局最优求解器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 决策树虽然具有良好的可解释性，但面临严重的可扩展性挑战：现有全局最优方法受限于二元特征选择和浅层树深度，而传统启发式方法往往牺牲预测准确性。因此需要一种能够在大规模连续特征数据上训练深层树、兼顾最优性与效率的方法。

Method: 基于层次化根-子树优化框架：根节点问题使用分支缩减求解，子树问题采用贪心启发式近似（相当于强化学习中的前瞻卷积）。虽然框架理论上可保证全局最优，但近似显著提升深层结构的效率。进而采用低成本移动视界策略迭代细化模型精度。

Result: 大量数值实验表明，该方法的测试准确率超过现有启发式基线，且在数据集规模和树深度两方面的可扩展性显著优于全局最优求解器。

Conclusion: 移动视界近似分支缩减方法有效平衡了最优性与计算效率，为大规模连续特征数据上的深层分类树训练提供了可扩展且高精度的解决方案。

Abstract: Despite the importance for interpretability, decision trees face severe scalability challenges. Existing global optimal methods are often limited by binary feature selection and shallow tree depths, whereas traditional heuristic approaches frequently sacrifice predictive accuracy. To overcome these limitations, this paper proposes a moving-horizon approximate branch-and-reduce method to train near-optimal deep classification trees on large-scale datasets with continuous features. Built on a hierarchical root-subtree optimization framework, the method solves the root-level problem via branch-and-reduce while approximating the induced subtree problem using greedy heuristics. Although the underlying framework is capable of guaranteeing global optimality, the approximation, which functions as a lookahead rollout in a reinforcement learning context, significantly boosts efficiency for deeper structures. A low-cost moving-horizon strategy is then employed to iteratively refine model accuracy. Extensive numerical results demonstrate that our method exceeds the testing accuracy of existing heuristic baselines while offering significantly greater scalability, in terms of both dataset size and tree depth, than global optimal solvers.

</details>


### [137] [A Data-Free Physics-Informed Neural Operator for Level-Set Interface Advection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38195)
*Muhammad Akbar Khan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种无数据物理信息神经算子，用于水平集界面平流问题，仅利用输运残差和几何约束训练，无需参考解。采用时空傅里叶骨干网络一次性输出全时空轨迹，初始条件通过构造而非惩罚强制满足。在反向单涡和固体旋转两个基准测试中，无数据算子的相对L2误差分别为监督基线的4.4倍和1.5倍，但在正负距离约束有效区域，其面积保持性能比监督基线好2.7倍；混合算子仅用8个参考解即超越用16个参考解的监督算子。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有神经算子训练依赖求解器生成的参考解，获取成本高且难以推广。旨在开发完全无需标签数据的物理信息神经算子，直接从物理方程残差和几何约束学习界面演化算子，消除数据依赖。

Method: 构建时空傅里叶神经算子骨干网络，输入初始水平集函数输出全时空演化轨迹。损失函数仅包含输运方程残差和正负距离约束，初始条件通过网络架构构造强制满足，避免锚定项与残差项竞争。对比实验设置相同架构、预算、测试集的监督、混合、无数据三种训练范式。

Result: 反向单涡测试：无数据算子相对L2误差1.614±0.067%，监督基线0.369±0.035%，差距4.4倍。固体旋转测试：无数据算子3.804±1.075%，监督基线2.576±0.159%，差距1.5倍。在正负距离约束有效区域，无数据算子面积守恒性能比监督基线好2.7倍。混合算子(8参考解)超越监督算子(16参考解)。两基准排名差异归因于正负距离约束有效性差异：涡流下86.9%区域违反约束，旋转下仅0.3%。

Conclusion: 无数据物理信息神经算子虽场误差大于监督算子，但在物理约束有效区域表现出更优的几何守恒性能。混合训练能以极少标签数据超越全监督基线。正负距离约束的有效性是决定无数据训练性能的关键因素，揭示了物理约束与数据驱动范式的互补关系。

Abstract: Operators for interfacial problems are trained on reference solutions produced by the solver they are intended to replace. This work develops a data-free physics-informed neural operator for level-set interface advection, in which the interface is the equation's unknown and the operator maps an initial interface to the full spatiotemporal trajectory under a prescribed flow. Training uses only the transport residual and a geometric constraint; no reference solution enters the objective at any point. A spacetime Fourier backbone emits the entire trajectory in one pass, and the initial condition is imposed by construction rather than by penalty, which removes the competition between the anchoring term and the residual that otherwise arises when no solution data are available. Supervised and hybrid operators are trained under an identical architecture, family, budget and test set, and are reported throughout as baselines that quantify what refusing labels costs. On a reversed single vortex the data-free operator reaches 1.614 +/- 0.067% relative L2 error on 100 held-out initial interfaces against 0.369 +/- 0.035% for the supervised baseline, a factor of 4.4; on solid-body rotation the corresponding figures are 3.804 +/- 1.075% and 2.576 +/- 0.159%, a factor of 1.5. The two benchmarks rank the arms differently, and the difference is attributable to the eikonal constraint: the exact solution violates |grad phi| = 1 over 0.3% of the domain under rotation and 86.9% under the vortex. Where the constraint is valid the physics-trained operator conserves enclosed area 2.7 times better than the supervised baseline despite a larger field error, and a hybrid arm using eight reference solutions outperforms a supervised arm using sixteen.

</details>


### [138] [Conformal Adversarial Generative Ensemble](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38196)
*Ahmad Shahi,Mamehgol Yousefi,Brendon J. Woodford,Farhaan Mirza,Tapabrata Chakraborti*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CAGE框架，结合生成模型、对抗判别和共形预测，通过基于非一致性分数的p值动态调整模型权重，提升时间序列预测的可靠性和准确性，在奶牛奶收集和猴痘数据上优于传统集成方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统集成方法易受极端预测不成比例影响，导致预测可靠性下降，需一种能动态抑制不可靠预测、提供统计严谨保证的集成框架。

Method: CAGE包含多个生成模型产生初始预测，判别组件利用共形预测计算非一致性分数及p值，据此动态调整各模型权重，仅保留最可信预测贡献最终集成输出。

Result: 在新西兰奶牛奶收集数据和全球猴痘公开数据集上，CAGE显著优于传统集成方法，尤其在处理异常值和噪声数据时表现更稳健，提供准确且统计严谨的预测。

Conclusion: CAGE通过融合生成建模、对抗判别与共形预测，实现了通用的、可靠的时间序列预测集成方案，适用于金融、天气、供应链等多领域决策支持。

Abstract: Accurate time series forecasting is critical across various domains, yet traditional ensemble methods often suffer from the disproportionate influence of extreme forecasts. We introduce the Conformal Adversarial Generative Ensemble (CAGE), a novel framework that combines generative modeling, adversarial discrimination, and conformal prediction to enhance forecast reliability and accuracy. CAGE employs multiple generative models to produce initial forecasts, which are then evaluated by a discriminative component using conformal prediction techniques. P-values derived from nonconformity scores help dynamically adjust model weights, minimizing the impact of unreliable forecasts. This approach ensures that only the most credible predictions contribute to the final ensemble output. Our empirical and statistical analyses of time series data from New Zealand's milk collection and the global health data from the public owid-monkeypox dataset show that the CAGE outperforms traditional ensemble methods, especially in handling outliers and noisy data. By incorporating conformal prediction, CAGE delivers accurate and statistically rigorous forecasts, enhancing decision-making. We have demonstrated performance on two different datasets deliberately to showcase that the proposed method offers a versatile solution potentially applicable across finance, weather, and supply chain management.

</details>


### [139] [DualCast: A Dual-Path Language Model for Bimodal Financial Time-Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38197)
*Wentao Zhao,Hongqiang Wu,Shanghang Liu,Zhaochen Zan,Yu Zhang,Biqing Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DualCast 是一种双路径金融时间序列预测框架，结合冻结语言模型与离散金融词汇，通过快速数值预测路径和可选的文本条件修正路径实现高精度预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决金融时间序列预测中需同时捕捉异质资产价格动态并融合预测时刻可用新闻的问题。

Method: 1) 将对数收益率补丁表示为学习的摘要 token 和三个残差形状 token，保留局部漂移和波动率；2) 自适应频率均衡残差向量量化提升码本利用率；3) 快速路径：在冻结的 Qwen3-8B 上仅训练金融 token 嵌入和输出头；4) 慢速路径：可切换的 LoRA 适配器基于快速预测和新闻进行修正，经监督微调初始化后用收益空间组相对策略优化目标进一步优化。

Result: 在股票和能源价格的五分钟、日、周频零样本评估中，慢速路径在 12 个数据集-预测期设置中的 8 个达到最低 MAPE，包含所有最长预测期；新闻消融实验显示多数设置下有额外增益，但幅度随市场变化。

Conclusion: DualCast 成功融合了快速数值预测器与可选的文本条件修正机制，在多资产、多周期预测任务中表现优异，尤其擅长长周期预测，新闻信息能进一步提升性能。

Abstract: Financial time-series forecasting must capture price dynamics across heterogeneous assets while incorporating news available at prediction time. We introduce DualCast, a dual-path framework that extends a frozen language model with a discrete financial vocabulary. Each log-return patch is represented by a learned summary token and three residual shape tokens, preserving local drift and volatility while allowing shape patterns to be shared across assets. To improve codebook utilization, we develop adaptive frequency-equalizing residual vector quantization, which rebalances overloaded codewords without compromising reconstruction accuracy. The fast path trains only the new financial-token embeddings and output heads on a frozen Qwen3-8B backbone. A toggleable LoRA adapter enables a slow path that conditions on the fast forecast and news available at the forecast origin to produce a revised prediction. The reviser is initialized by supervised fine-tuning and further optimized with a return-space group relative policy optimization objective that rewards improvements over the fast forecast. In zero-shot evaluations covering equities and energy prices at five-minute, daily, and weekly resolutions, the slow path achieves the lowest mean absolute percentage error among the compared methods in 8 of 12 dataset-horizon settings, including every longest-horizon setting. News ablations indicate additional gains in most tested settings, although their magnitude varies across markets. DualCast thus combines a fast numerical forecaster with an optional text-conditioned revision mechanism.

</details>


### [140] [FlashDiffusion: Fused Tiled Kernel Spectral Decomposition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38198)
*Julio Candanedo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FlashDiffusion 是一种无矩阵的扩散映射方法，通过融合 GPU 瓦片计算稠密高斯核块，并引入经验 β-flow 选择有限样本分辨率尺度，结合样本量与带宽的延续策略热启动谱求解，解决了小带宽下稠密高斯核 O(N^2) 内存瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散映射和核方法提供可解释的非线性谱表示基础，但在几何极限（小带宽）下核矩阵趋于高秩，实例化稠密高斯核需要 O(N^2) 显存，限制了大规模几何学习的可行性。

Method: 1. 矩阵自由核评估：在融合 GPU 瓦片中按块计算稠密高斯核，避免显式存储全矩阵。2. 经验 β-flow：将特征求解器与自适应带宽选择耦合，自动确定有限样本分辨率尺度。3. 延续热启动：沿样本量和带宽的延续路径，从粗分辨率谱解热启动逐步细化的求解。

Result: 实现了在几何极限下高效计算扩散映射谱基，显著降低显存占用并加速大规模数据集上的谱分解，同时通过 β-flow 自动选择最优分辨率尺度。

Conclusion: FlashDiffusion 通过矩阵自由核计算、自适应尺度选择和延续热启动三大创新，突破了扩散映射的内存与计算瓶颈，为大规模几何学习提供了实用的高性能解决方案。

Abstract: Diffusion maps, and kernel methods more generally, provide an interpretable nonlinear spectral representation basis for geometric learning. In the geometric limit, small bandwidth, these matrices tend to be high rank and thus require materializing dense Gaussian kernels requires $O(N^2)$ memory. We introduce FlashDiffusion, a matrix-free method that evaluates dense Gaussian kernel blocks in fused GPU tiles and couples the eigensolver to an empirical $β$-flow that selects the finite-sample resolution scale. A continuation over sample size and bandwidth warm-starts increasingly expensive spectral solves from coarser resolutions.

</details>


### [141] [Kinematic signatures of impairment: Detecting alcohol intoxication in e-scooter riders using sensor data and machine learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38276)
*Rahul Rajendra Pai,Marco Dozza,Alexander Rasch,Ali Mohammadi,Marco Capuccini*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种基于车载传感器和熵分析的电动滑板车骑行者酒精中毒检测方法，通过实验验证了其高准确率（85%）和优异的分类性能（AuROC 0.94），为实时醉酒检测系统奠定了基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 酒精中毒是导致电动滑板车致命和重伤事故的主要原因，现有对策（如时间限制、骑行前认知筛查）无法实时持续评估骑行者的身体运动控制能力和损伤程度，因此需要一种能够实时监测骑行动力学特征的自动检测系统。

Method: 开展受控实验，25名参与者在清醒、血液酒精浓度0.05%和0.08%三种状态下骑行仪器化电动滑板车。滑板车配备六轴IMU（100Hz）、油门和刹车把位置传感器。计算归一化排列熵（量化时间复杂度）和标准差（量化信号幅度）两个互补特征。使用重复测量相关性分析识别随醉酒程度变化的运动学特征，构建基于熵的多类逻辑回归分类器，采用留一参与者交叉验证评估。

Result: 识别出7个运动学特征（全部为IMU和油门信号），其熵随醉酒程度增加显著降低（p<0.001），标准差显著增加（p<0.01），表明醉酒骑行者从连续的低幅度微调转向较少的高幅度反应性修正。分类器达到85%整体准确率，加权单对多AuROC为0.94，清醒vs高醉酒AuROC为1.00。转向速率和侧向加速度是最重要的预测特征，揭示酒精导致骑行时侧向平衡的显著崩塌。

Conclusion: 车载运动学传感结合基于熵的信号分析能够可靠地区分醉酒与清醒骑行，为保留清醒骑行者出行权利的自动醉酒检测系统提供了基础。

Abstract: Alcohol intoxication is a leading contributor to fatal and severe-injured e-scooterist crashes. Current countermeasures, such as temporal restrictions or pre-ride cognitive screening, cannot continuously assess an e-scooterist's physical motor control or impairment in real time. We conducted a controlled experiment in which 25 participants rode an instrumented e-scooter through a test track while sober and at two targeted blood alcohol concentration levels (0.05% and 0.08%). The e-scooter was instrumented with a six-axis inertial measurement unit (IMU), and throttle and brake lever position sensors, all sampled at 100 Hz. Two complementary signal features were computed: normalised permutation entropy, which quantifies temporal complexity, and standard deviation, which quantifies signal amplitude. Repeated measures correlation identified seven kinematic features (all IMU and throttle signals) whose entropy decreased (p < 0.001) while standard deviation increased (p < 0.01) with increasing intoxication, indicating that intoxicated riders shift from continuous, low-amplitude micro-corrections to fewer, high-amplitude reactive corrections. An entropy based multi-class logistic regression classifier, evaluated through leave-one-participant-out cross-validation, achieved 85% overall accuracy and a weighted one-vs-rest area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AuROC) of 0.94, with a sober-vs-high AuROC of 1.00. Steering rate and lateral acceleration were the most important predictive features, indicating that alcohol induces a distinct collapse in lateral equilibrium during riding. Ultimately, these results demonstrate that onboard kinematic sensing combined with entropy-based signal analysis can reliably distinguish sober from intoxicated e-scooter riding, providing a foundation for automatic intoxication detection systems that preserve mobility for sober riders.

</details>


### [142] [Hermes: Learning Contextual Reasoning Unlocks Test-Time Scaling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38332)
*Xinyu Li,Mononito Goswami,Hao Liu,Nikos Kanakaris,Langlin Huang,Prithwish Jana,Patrick Blöbaum,Purak Jain*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出 Hermes 可配置框架和 Hermes-Learn 两阶段训练方法，使模型能自主决定推理时的上下文分配与复用，从而有效利用额外推理算力提升性能，且对小模型亦有效且泛化性强。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有测试时扩展方法多通过固定 harness 规定上下文分配和复用决策，限制了模型自主利用额外推理算力的能力；需要将决策权下放给模型，实现自适应的上下文推理。

Method: 1) Hermes：一系列简单可配置的 harness，逐步赋予模型对上下文分配和复用的控制权；2) Hermes-Learn：两阶段训练框架，先通过监督微调学习基础上下文推理策略，再通过强化学习优化自适应策略。

Result: 强模型可直接利用 Hermes 灵活性随推理算力扩展性能提升；小开源模型初期难以利用，经 Hermes-Learn 训练后显著缩小差距，学会随问题和推理进度自适应调整策略。增益跨基准、跨模型泛化，外推至训练未见的推理算力，并迁移至 Hermes 之外的其他测试时扩展方法。

Conclusion: 将上下文推理决策权交给模型并配合专门训练，能激发模型自适应利用推理时算力的能力，为测试时扩展提供更通用、可扩展的范式。

Abstract: Test-time scaling improves model performance by allocating additional compute during inference. Using this compute effectively across multiple context windows requires deciding how to allocate fresh contexts and what information to carry between them. We call a model's ability to make these decisions contextual reasoning. Existing approaches largely prescribe these decisions through their harness; we instead shift them to the model. We introduce 1) Hermes, a family of simple, configurable harnesses that progressively varies model control over context allocation and reuse, and 2) Hermes-Learn, a two-stage framework for learning these capabilities. We find that capable models can exploit this flexibility to scale with additional inference-time compute, while smaller open-source models initially struggle to do so. Training with Hermes-Learn closes this gap, inducing adaptive contextual reasoning strategies that vary with both the problem and the progress of reasoning. These gains generalize across benchmarks and models, extrapolate beyond the inference-time compute seen during training, and transfer to complementary test-time scaling methods beyond Hermes.

</details>


### [143] [Activation-Conditioned Self-Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38342)
*Zhexi Lu,Subhajit Chaudhury,Tejaswini Pedapati,Keerthiram Murugesan,Lei Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出激活条件自蒸馏（ACSD），通过对比达到正确答案的轨迹与其余轨迹的激活差异提取引导向量，冻结教师模型应用该向量进行逐token蒸馏，无需参考文本和教师更新，在多个数学和代码基准上超越基于参考解的在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线策略自蒸馏虽利用模型自身作为教师提供密集推理监督，但仅提供参考解等特权信息无法保证长响应中有效的token级监督，导致后期位置监督信号衰减。

Method: 1. 在生成预算内采样自生成轨迹，按结果验证分为正确组与其余组；2. 对比两组激活提取引导向量；3. 冻结基座模型副本，在每个预测位置应用该向量得到教师分布；4. 学生在自身生成的前缀上学习教师的下一token分布；5. 仅需结果验证构建方向和校准，无需问题特定参考文本、教师参数更新，推理时仅使用蒸馏后的学生模型。

Result: 在五个模型上，ACSD在四个数学基准的平均准确率均最高。DeepSeek-R1-0528-Qwen3-8B上数学平均准确率达71.9%（OPSD 69.0%），LiveCodeBench v6 pass@12达70.9%（OPSD 66.3%）。正确轨迹间的对比也支持蒸馏，提取方向可跨数学训练数据集复用。固定学生轨迹下，ACSD在后期位置保持更稳定的logit更新幅度。

Conclusion: ACSD通过激活空间的对比学习获得通用推理引导向量，实现了无需参考文本、教师冻结、仅学生自蒸馏的高效范式，显著提升长链推理的token级监督质量，且方向具有跨数据集泛化性。

Abstract: On-policy self-distillation uses a model as its own teacher to provide dense supervision for reasoning, often through reference-solution conditioning. Providing privileged information does not by itself ensure effective token-level supervision throughout long responses. We introduce Activation-Conditioned Self-Distillation (ACSD), which extracts a steering vector by contrasting activations of self-generated trajectories that reach verified correct answers within a generation budget with those of all remaining trajectories. A frozen copy of the base model applies this vector at each prediction position, and the student learns from its next-token distributions on student-generated prefixes. Outcome verification is used for direction construction and calibration; distillation requires neither problem-specific reference text nor teacher parameter updates. The distilled student is used alone at inference. On each of five models, ACSD achieves the highest mean accuracy over four mathematical benchmarks among the evaluated methods. On DeepSeek-R1-0528-Qwen3-8B, mean mathematical accuracy reaches 71.9\% and LiveCodeBench v6 pass@12 reaches 70.9\%, compared with 69.0\% and 66.3\% for the reference-conditioned OPSD baseline. Contrasts among correct trajectories also support distillation, and extracted directions can be reused across mathematical training datasets. On fixed student trajectories, ACSD maintains more stable late-position logit-update magnitudes than OPSD.

</details>


### [144] [Function-Space Transformer with Adaptive Anchors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38348)
*Guorui Sang,Pedram Rooshenas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Function-Space Transformer (FST)，一种通过自适应连续潜在表示学习函数映射的框架，在PDE求解和图像分类任务上优于基线且参数更少。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 连续域函数（物理场、几何形状、视觉信号）常通过离散采样观测，固定均匀网格表示难以同时兼顾局部变化分辨率与计算效率；现有神经算子虽能学习函数映射，但缺乏显式空间组织的自适应潜在表示。

Method: FST在输入观测预测的锚点位置存储特征，通过函数空间交互递归细化锚点特征，实现空间组织随输入自适应调整，支持空间分辨率输出与有限维输出。

Result: 在PDEBench Burgers和Darcy流预测中，FST大幅优于Perceiver IO，与Fourier Neural Operator竞争力相当；在ImageNet-1K分类上，FST准确率高于Vision Transformer且参数更少；消融实验验证函数空间更新与递归细化的有效性。

Conclusion: 自适应连续表示在科学预测与视觉识别任务中展现出巨大潜力，FST为函数空间学习提供了灵活高效的新范式。

Abstract: Many forms of data, including physical fields, geometric shapes, and visual signals, are naturally described by functions over continuous domains but are observed through discrete samples.
