Representing these functions on fixed uniform grids imposes a trade-off between resolving localized variation and increasing computation across the domain. Neural operators address this mismatch by learning mappings between functions, while latent-attention architectures provide flexible processing of sampled observations. We introduce the Function-Space Transformer (FST), a framework for learning from functions through a spatially adaptive continuous latent representation. FST stores features at anchors whose locations are predicted from the input observations and recursively refines these anchor features through function-space interactions. This allows the representation to adapt its spatial organization to each input rather than inherit that of the observation grid, while supporting both spatially resolved and finite-dimensional outputs. On PDE solution prediction using PDEBench Burgers and Darcy flow, FST substantially outperforms the Perceiver IO baseline, whose latent representation lacks explicit spatial organization, and is highly competitive with the Fourier Neural Operator. On ImageNet-1K, FST achieves higher classification accuracy than the Vision Transformer baseline, with fewer parameters across these comparisons. Ablations further support the benefits of function-space updates and recursive refinement. Together, these results highlight the potential of adaptive continuous representations for both scientific prediction and visual recognition.

</details>


### [145] [MILO: Automated Harness Discovery via Orchestrated Multi-Agent Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38349)
*Prithwish Jana,Mononito Goswami,Hao Liu,Xinyu Li,Langlin Huang,Zhehui Huang,Zhishen Huang,Patrick Blöbaum,Anoop Deoras,Purak Jain,Nikos Kanakaris,Sahika Genc*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MILO 是一个元进化框架，通过共同进化智能体 harness（执行框架）和发现策略，在多个基准测试上超越现有最优方法，同时减少 token 使用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代智能体系统将 AI 模型与控制执行的 harness 结合，harness 设计对长程任务性能影响巨大，但其组合搜索空间需要大量人力且模型更新时需重复。现有自动化方法仅窄幅优化提示或技能，或陷入固定的利用型搜索策略。

Method: MILO 整合三大组件：(i) 基于岛屿树的分层谱系记忆，利用被拒突变作为负证据；(ii) 每岛层突变体智能体，基于全局搜索历史和父代反馈重写完整 harness；(iii) 协调器通过谱系嫁接、物种分化、突变体重分配和课程修订自适应调整搜索。

Result: 在 Terminal-Bench 2.1、PaperBench、DeepSWE 上，MILO 发现的 harness 超越 8 个 SOTA harness 和 6 种搜索方法。使用 Opus 4.8 时分别提升 +12.0%、+28.3%、+10.3%，远超先前最佳增益 +4.5%、+18.3%、0%。Terminal-Bench 2.1 达 86.1±2.0%，超过官方榜首 83.8±2.3%，且 token 减少 26%。在 EinsteinArena 开放问题上改进 Erdős 最小重叠和自相关不等式的已知上界。

Conclusion: MILO 通过元进化实现了 harness 设计的自动化，在前沿模型和开放权重模型上均达到最优性能，显著降低计算开销，并推动了数学问题的边界。

Abstract: Modern agentic systems combine an AI model with a harness that controls execution and environmental interactions. Harness design strongly affects long-horizon performance, yet its combinatorial search space demands substantial human effort that must be repeated as models change. Existing automated methods explore this space narrowly, optimizing only components such as prompts or skills or becoming trapped by fixed, exploitative search strategies. We introduce MILO (Meta-evolutionary Island Orchestration), a framework that co-evolves agent harnesses and the strategy used to discover them. MILO combines: (i) hierarchical lineage memory over island-based trees, using rejected mutations as negative evidence; (ii) per-island mutator agents that rewrite complete harnesses using global search history and parent-specific feedback; and (iii) an orchestrator that adapts search through lineage grafting and speciation, mutator reassignment and curriculum revision. Across Terminal-Bench 2.1, PaperBench, and DeepSWE, MILO-discovered harnesses outperform eight state-of-the-art harnesses and six search methods using frontier (Opus 4.8) and open-weight (gpt-oss-120b) models. With Opus 4.8, MILO improves resolution over its initial harness by $+12.0\%$, $+28.3\%$, and $+10.3\%$, respectively, compared with best prior-search gains of $+4.5\%$, $+18.3\%$, and $0\%$. On Terminal-Bench 2.1, it achieves $86.1 \pm 2.0\%$, exceeding the official leaderboard's top entry ($83.8 \pm 2.3\%$) while using 26\% fewer tokens than its initial harness. On EinsteinArena open problems, MILO improves best-known upper bounds for Erdős minimum-overlap ($0.3808586 \to 0.3808568$) and the first and third autocorrelation inequalities ($1.50274365 \to 1.50274360$; $1.45081 \to 1.44889$).

</details>


### [146] [Continual Learning of Dynamical Systems in Recurrent Neural Networks through Recyclable Unit Gating](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38356)
*Sima Hashemi,Daniel Durstewitz,Georgia Koppe*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出了一种名为 CRUG（持续可回收单元门控）的方法，用于解决持续动态系统重构（cDSR）中的灾难性遗忘和容量耗尽问题。CRUG 通过可微分门控与 L0 惩罚实现紧凑的任务专用单元分配，回收未使用单元，并利用有向连接实现前向迁移，在零遗忘的前提下达到最佳重构-容量权衡，并能可靠学习异构非线性与混沌系统序列，且优势延伸至序列认知任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 持续动态系统重构（cDSR）要求在学习新系统的同时保留先前学到的动力学行为。然而，循环模型中微小的参数更新可能导致长期自主演化的定性改变。现有的持续学习（CL）方法（参数正则化、重放、参数隔离）在可全训练且可解释的 AL-RNN 上基准测试显示：参数隔离虽能最有效保留早期动力学，但过度的任务专用分配会迅速耗尽固定大小网络的容量。因此需要一种既能保持零遗忘又能节省容量并支持前向迁移的方法。

Method: 提出 Continually-Recyclable Unit-Gating (CRUG)：1) 使用可微分门控并配合基于 L0 的稀疏性惩罚，为每个任务选择专用单元；2) 未被选中的单元被标记为可回收，供后续任务复用；3) 引入有向连接，允许后续任务复用早期任务的表示，同时不影响已提交单元的动力学。该方法在完全可训练的 AL-RNN 架构上实现。

Result: CRUG 在测试的 CL 方法中实现了最优的重构质量与网络容量权衡，实现零灾难性遗忘，并能可靠学习一系列异构的非线性与混沌动力系统。实验表明，当任务共享相似的底层动力学时，前向迁移更显著且更有用。此外，CRUG 的优势不仅限于自主 cDSR，还扩展到序列认知任务。

Conclusion: CRUG 通过紧凑的单元分配、单元回收机制和有向连接实现的前向迁移，有效解决了 cDSR 中的容量耗尽与灾难性遗忘问题。该方法在保持零遗忘的同时实现了最佳的重构-容量权衡，并展示了在共享动力学任务间的前向迁移效用，且泛化至更广泛的序列认知任务，为持续动态系统建模提供了实用且高效的解决方案。

Abstract: Dynamical Systems Reconstruction (DSR) aims to infer models from observed time series that reproduce a system's qualitative long-term behavior. Continual DSR (cDSR) requires learning new systems while preserving previously learned dynamics, yet even small parameter updates in recurrent models can qualitatively alter their behavior over long autonomous rollouts. We benchmark established continual learning (CL) methods spanning parameter regularization, replay, and parameter isolation on the fully trainable and interpretable Almost-Linear RNN (AL-RNN). Parameter isolation preserves earlier dynamics most effectively, but excessive task-specific allocations can rapidly exhaust a fixed-size network. We therefore introduce Continually-Recyclable Unit-Gating (CRUG), which conserves capacity through compact allocation and forward transfer. Differentiable gates trained with an $L_0$-based penalty select task-specific units, while unused units are recycled for subsequent tasks. Directed connections allow later tasks to reuse earlier representations without affecting the dynamics of previously committed units. CRUG achieves the strongest reconstruction--capacity trade-off among the tested methods with zero forgetting and reliably learns a heterogeneous sequence of nonlinear and chaotic systems. Furthermore, we show that forward transfer is more pronounced and useful when tasks share similar underlying dynamics. Lastly, we demonstrate that CRUG's advantages extend beyond autonomous cDSR to sequential cognitive tasks.

</details>


### [147] [On the Off-Policy Teacher in On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38360)
*Langlin Huang,Hao Liu,Mononito Goswami,Xinyu Li,Prithwith Jana,Nikos Kanakaris,Patrick Blöbaum,Purak Jain*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 SCOUT（Student-COnditioned Updates of the Teacher）框架，解决在线策略蒸馏（OPD）中教师模型面对学生生成的前缀时续写能力下降的问题，通过引入基于可验证奖励的强化学习周期性地将教师适配到学生分布，显著提升了多种配置下的蒸馏效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线策略蒸馏（OPD）虽让学生从自身轨迹学习，但存在根本不对称：采样轨迹对学生是 on-policy，对教师却是 off-policy。教师原本优化为从自身前缀续写，在 OPD 中却需监督学生生成的前缀；实验发现随着前缀变长，教师续写性能显著下降，限制了蒸馏质量。

Method: 提出 SCOUT 协同训练框架：在标准 OPD 更新之外，周期性地用带可验证奖励的强化学习优化教师的条件续写能力。具体做法是让教师从学生生成的前缀续写，并根据结果奖励更新教师，使其适应学生分布。

Result: 受控实验证实 SCOUT 能提升教师从学生前缀续写的能力，验证了预期机制。在多种教师-学生配置、模型规模和推理领域中，SCOUT 均能持续提升在线策略蒸馏的有效性。

Conclusion: SCOUT 通过学生条件化的教师更新，有效缓解了 OPD 中的分布错位问题，为后训练蒸馏提供了一个简单且通用的增强方案，适用于不同规模和任务的大语言模型蒸馏场景。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) has recently emerged as a promising post-training paradigm in which the student learns from trajectories generated by its own policy under dense teacher supervision. However, OPD introduces a fundamental asymmetry: although the sampled trajectories are on-policy for the student, they are off-policy for the teacher. The teacher is typically optimized to continue from prefixes generated by its own policy, but during OPD it must instead supervise prefixes generated by the student. Empirically, we find that its continuation performance degrades as these prefixes grow longer. To address this issue, we propose Student-COnditioned Updates of the Teacher (SCOUT), a co-training framework that adapts the teacher to student-generated prefixes. Alongside standard OPD updates, SCOUT periodically optimizes the teacher's conditional ability using reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, where the teacher generates continuations from student prefixes and learns from outcome rewards. Controlled experiments show that SCOUT improves the teacher's ability to continue from student-generated prefixes, supporting the intended mechanism of student-conditioned teacher adaptation. Across multiple teacher--student configurations, model scales, and reasoning domains, SCOUT also consistently improves the effectiveness of on-policy distillation.

</details>


### [148] [Simulator-Refined Diffusion for Radio-Frequency Inverse Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38363)
*Jinhao Liang,Jacob K. Christopher,Michael Frei,Tommaso Dreossi,Nando Fioretto*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Simulator-Refined Diffusion (SRD) 方法，结合低保真可微分代理模型与高保真不可微分全波电磁仿真器，解决扩散模型在 PCB 反向设计中难以满足定量电磁规格的问题。实验表明 SRD 在分布内和分布外目标上均显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型虽在 PCB 布局生成中展现潜力，但难以精确满足目标 S 参数等定量电磁规格。现有梯度引导方法面临两难：全波电磁仿真器精准但昂贵且不可微，可微分代理模型虽高效但可靠性不足。需要一种能融合两者优势的采样策略。

Method: 提出 Simulator-Refined Diffusion (SRD)：在扩散采样过程中，利用低保真可微分代理模型的梯度建议扰动方向，再由高保真不可微分仿真器沿该方向搜索有效设计更新。此举避免了零阶优化所需的大量随机扰动，实现代理模型梯度与仿真器精准评估的协同。

Result: 在多种设置下实验表明，SRD 持续优于当前最先进方法。生成布局的仿真 S 参数与目标规格匹配度：分布内目标提升高达 21.2%，分布外目标提升高达 19.8%。

Conclusion: SRD 通过巧妙融合可微分代理模型的梯度信息与高保真仿真器的精准评估，有效解决了扩散模型在 PCB 反向设计中的定量规格满足难题，为电磁器件自动化设计提供了更可靠的生成式框架。

Abstract: Diffusion models have shown potential in inverse design of printed circuit boards (PCBs), enabling the generation of layouts conditioned on target S-parameters. Despite this promise, applying diffusion models to PCB layout generation remains challenging due to their difficulty in meeting the quantitative electromagnetic specifications. A common approach is gradient-based guidance, which biases the diffusion sampling process with the gradient of an objective used for evaluation. However, full-wave electromagnetic simulators are accurate but expensive and typically non-differentiable, whereas differentiable surrogates are informative but not always reliable. To address these limitations, this paper proposes Simulator-Refined Diffusion (SRD), a novel combination of a low-fidelity differentiable surrogate and a high-fidelity non-differentiable simulator within the diffusion sampling process. Unlike standard zeroth-order optimization, which requires a great number of random perturbations, our approach uses the surrogate's gradient to propose the perturbation direction while the simulator then searches based on this direction to identify an effective design update. Experimental results across different settings show that this method consistently outperforms current state-of-the-art methods, producing layouts whose simulated S-parameters match the target specifications up to 21.2% closer for in-distribution targets and up to 19.8% for out-of-distribution targets.

</details>


### [149] [Learning to Plan from Random Exploration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38383)
*Deqian Kong,Guangyan Sun,Sheng Cheng,Sirui Xie,Bo Pang,Jianwen Xie,Tony Geng,Caiwen Ding,Ying Nian Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种无需策略改进训练即可实现长距离规划的方法：利用随机探索数据训练条件能量模型估计时域对数密度比，结合局部动力学模型在测试时通过多时域查询实现目标导向规划，实验表明其能从随机探索中学习多尺度认知图并支持迷宫导航、自我中心导航及操作规划。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有强化学习方法通常需要目标导向的策略改进训练，难以在目标未指定时利用随机探索经验进行长距离规划。论文旨在解决：随机探索经验是否能直接支持无监督的长距离规划？如何从随机游走中提取不同时域的几何与拓扑信息？

Method: 1. 随机游走分析：短时域揭示测地几何，长时域揭示区域连通性。2. 条件能量模型：通过时域条件嵌入估计时域对数密度比，使用噪声对比估计在观测对上训练，无需动作/奖励标签。3. 规划器：测试时结合局部动力学模型预测候选动作结果，利用时域模型跨时域评估进度并聚合改进量。4. 执行单步动作后固定模型重新规划。

Result: 实验在状态和图像观测下均实现了从随机探索到长距离迷宫规划；学习到的分数场、嵌入探针及规划路径展现出多尺度认知图特性；进一步验证了自我中心导航和从次优数据中进行操作规划的能力。

Conclusion: 随机探索蕴含足够的时域关系信息，通过能量模型学习多时域密度比可构建类认知图表示，结合局部动力学模型即可实现无策略改进训练的长距离规划，为无监督规划和表征学习提供了新范式。

Abstract: Random exploration reveals how an environment can be traversed before a goal is specified. Can this experience support long-range planning without policy-improvement training? Our random-walk analysis explains what temporal relations contain: short horizons reveal geodesic geometry in the diffusion limit, while longer horizons reveal connectivity between regions before mixing removes these distinctions. We learn these relations with a conditional energy-based model that estimates temporal log-density ratios through horizon-conditioned embeddings. The model is trained on observation pairs by noise-contrastive estimation, without action or reward labels. The planner queries these learned relations at different horizons as it moves toward the goal. At test time, a separate local dynamics model predicts candidate action outcomes, and the temporal model evaluates their progress toward the goal by selecting or aggregating estimated improvements across horizons. The agent executes one action and replans with both models fixed. Experiments demonstrate long-range maze planning from random exploration using states and images. Learned score fields, embedding probes, and planned routes exhibit properties of a multiscale cognitive map. We further demonstrate egocentric navigation from random exploration and manipulation planning from suboptimal data.

</details>


### [150] [LeanPolish: Verified Supervision for Lean Proof Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38384)
*Pauline Bourigault*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出 LeanPolish 管道，发布 33,402 个被接受的局部编辑和 65,596 个同状态失败尝试，研究模型从验证证明编辑监督中学到了什么。发现首次成功搜索存在捷径，继续菜单评估可消除排序捷径，训练后的排序器在保留状态上选择最佳候选的准确率达 70.1%。迭代符号通过将 miniF2F 压缩率从 19.7% 提升至 27.5%，超越神经混合方法。微调使 PutnamBench 证明的验证 token 减少率从 2.8% 提升到 5.5%。发布的编辑、候选池和受控评估将模仿搜索策略与改进搜索分离，为证明改进研究提供可复现基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 验证的证明编辑为改进语言模型生成的 Lean 证明提供了自然监督，但验证只能确保编辑正确，不能保证其训练信号不含搜索伪影。需要系统研究模型从该监督中实际学到了什么，并区分模仿搜索策略与真正改进搜索。

Method: 构建 LeanPolish 符号化 Lean 4 管道，收集 33,402 个被接受的局部编辑和 65,596 个同状态失败尝试。分析首次成功搜索的捷径，对比继续菜单评估后的排序器性能。在 miniF2F 上迭代符号通过进行压缩实验，在 PutnamBench 上微调模型进行整体证明重写，并使用冻结模型对照区分训练增益来源。

Result: 首次成功搜索存在目标无关规则，排名准确率完美；教师选择的评估位置也奖励平凡删除。继续菜单评估消除排序捷径：训练排序器在保留状态上选最佳候选准确率 70.1%，最强冻结基线仅 36.9%。迭代符号通过将 miniF2F 节省率从 19.7% 提升至 27.5%，超越测试的神经混合方法。验证神经编辑在其他证明源上有帮助，但冻结模型对照显示增益不一定来自训练。微调使 PutnamBench 19 个证明的验证 token 减少率从 2.8% 提升到 5.5%。

Conclusion: 发布的编辑、完整候选池和受控评估将学习模仿搜索策略与改进搜索分离，为证明改进研究提供可复现基础，同时保持正确性、压缩和编辑策略的独立性。

Abstract: Verified proof edits offer a natural source of supervision for improving language-model-generated Lean proofs. Yet verification establishes that an edit is correct, not that its training signal is free of search artifacts. We introduce LeanPolish, a symbolic Lean 4 pipeline that releases 33,402 accepted local edits and 65,596 same-state failed attempts, and use it to study what models learn from this supervision. First-success search admits a goal-independent rule with perfect ranking accuracy; teacher-selected evaluation sites also reward trivial deletions. Continuing menu evaluation beyond the first success removes the ordering shortcut: a trained ranker selects the best candidate on 70.1% of evaluated held-out states, versus 36.9% for the strongest frozen baseline. For compression, iterating the symbolic pass raises miniF2F savings from 19.7% to 27.5%, exceeding the neural hybrids we test there. Verified neural editing helps on other proof sources, but matched frozen-model controls show that its gains need not come from training. The supervision does improve whole-proof rewriting: fine-tuning raises verified token reduction from 2.8% to 5.5% on 19 PutnamBench proofs. Together, the released edits, complete candidate pools, and controlled evaluations separate learning to imitate a search policy from improving on that search. They provide a reproducible basis for studying proof improvement while keeping correctness, compression, and edit policy distinct.

</details>


### [151] [Which Tasks Survive Self-Supervised Learning?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38393)
*Achleshwar Luthra,Lucas Bryant,Tracy Zhu,Tomer Galanti*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出“语义可恢复性”概念，通过谱分析描述同实例自监督学习中下游任务信息保留程度，揭示了可恢复性、方向几何、谱结构与少样本迁移的关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 同实例自监督学习通过强制两个视图一致性学习表示，但仅此原则无法决定哪些下游任务可从学习表示中恢复。作者希望从任务层面量化信息保留情况，理解表示几何与迁移性能的联系。

Method: 定义语义可恢复性为任务后验分数在表示函数空间中的捕获量；针对中心化白化表示，证明可恢复性决定类距离归一化方向差异(CDNV)、控制少样本最近质心分类、支配任务相关语义方向强度；分析标准两视图SSL目标的群体最优解，给出闭式谱表征：下游任务保留程度取决于其后验是否落入选定的谱子空间；在合成与真实数据集上验证预测关系。

Result: 实验验证了可恢复性与方向几何、谱结构、少样本迁移的预测关系；群体线性探测与质心轴重合，多个良好恢复的任务趋近阶乘质心几何；两视图SSL最优解跨越跨视图稳定模式，提供闭式谱表征。

Conclusion: 该工作为同实例SSL中幸存信息及其在下游几何和迁移中的表现提供了任务级解释，揭示了表示学习、任务可恢复性与几何结构的内在联系。

Abstract: Same-instance self-supervised learning (SSL) learns representations by enforcing consistency across two views of the same underlying instance. This principle alone, however, does not determine which downstream tasks remain recoverable from the learned representation. We study this question through \emph{semantic recoverability}, defined as the amount of a task's posterior score captured by the represented function space. We show that, for centered and whitened representations, recoverability exactly determines directional class-distance-normalized variance (CDNV), controls few-shot nearest-centroid classification, and governs the strength of task-relevant semantic directions. The population linear probe and centroid axis coincide, and multiple well-recovered tasks approach a factorial centroid geometry. We then analyze a canonical two-view SSL objective and show that its population optimum spans the leading cross-view-stable modes of the associated two-view operator. This yields a closed-form spectral characterization of semantic recoverability: a downstream task is preserved to the extent that its posterior lies in the selected spectral subspace. We validate these predictions on synthetic and real datasets across several SSL methods, testing the predicted relationships among recoverability, directional geometry, spectral structure, and few-shot transfer. Together, these results give a task-level account of what information survives same-instance SSL and how the retained information appears in downstream geometry and transfer.

</details>


### [152] [Disagreement-Regularized Imitation Learning for Image-Based Continuous Control with Gaussian and Beta Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38407)
*Irving Giovani Bronzatti Petrazzini,Eric Aislan Antonelo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究 DRIL（基于分歧正则化的模仿学习）在基于图像的连续控制任务中，针对少量演示数据时的改进效果，并对比不同学习器策略（Gaussian vs Beta）和演示专家类型的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 行为克隆在遇到演示分布外状态时会积累误差，DRIL 通过将克隆策略集成的分歧转化为强化学习奖励来缓解该问题，但其在视觉连续控制中的有效性尚需系统评估。

Method: 在 CarRacing 环境中进行受控实验：使用 Gaussian 和 Beta 两类学习器策略，演示来源为截断 Gaussian 专家或内在有界 Beta 专家，演示轨迹数为 1 或 20 条，采用确定性和随机性评估，保留行为克隆、最高 10-episode 训练得分检查点、最终 DRIL 检查点三个阶段策略；分歧集成包含 5 个 Gaussian 策略；每个保留策略在 100 个程序化生成的 episode 上评估。

Result: 在少量演示（1 条轨迹）下，DRIL 提升最大：配合截断动作演示比最强行为克隆均值提升 61%，配合有界动作演示提升 112%；20 条轨迹时优势缩小，有界动作下 Beta 行为克隆仍比最佳 DRIL 检查点高约 7%；分歧奖励的信息量随学习器表示和训练阶段变化。

Conclusion: DRIL 能显著改善少量演示下的视觉连续控制；当演示数据较多时，有界 Beta 策略提供更强的行为克隆性能；结果凸显了学习器支持集、集成响应和检查点选择的联合重要性。

Abstract: Purpose: Behavior cloning can accumulate errors when a learned controller visits states outside the demonstrated distribution. This study evaluates whether Disagreement-Regularized Imitation Learning (DRIL), which converts disagreement among cloned policies into a reinforcement-learning reward, improves image-based continuous control. Methods: A controlled CarRacing study combines Gaussian and Beta learner policies, demonstrations from either a clipped Gaussian expert or an intrinsically bounded Beta expert, one or 20 trajectories, deterministic and stochastic evaluation, and three retained stages: behavior cloning, the highest 10-episode training-score checkpoint, and the final DRIL checkpoint. The disagreement ensemble contains five Gaussian policies in every variant. Each retained policy is evaluated over 100 procedurally generated episodes. Results: Score-selected DRIL produced its largest gains in the few-demonstration setting, improving over the strongest behavior-cloning mean by 61% with clipped-action demonstrations and by 112% with bounded-action demonstrations. With 20 trajectories, the advantage of DRIL narrowed; in the bounded-action regime, Beta behavior cloning remained about 7% above the best DRIL checkpoint. The experiments also show that the informativeness of the disagreement reward changes with the learner representation and training stage. Conclusion: DRIL can substantially improve few-demonstration visual continuous control, while bounded Beta policies provide strong behavior-cloning performance when more demonstrations are available. The results highlight the joint importance of learner support,ensemble response, and checkpoint selection.

</details>


### [153] [Synthesis Without Training: An Inference-Only Pipeline for Tabular, Temporal, and Relational Synthetic Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38414)
*Zilong Zhao,Abdul Raheem,Jiayu Li,Sohei Arisaka,Darius Lim Hong Yi,Milad Abdollahzadeh,Uzair Javaid,Biplab Sikdar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GENSCRIPT 是一种无需训练的合成数据生成管道，通过统计概况和语言模型推断语义约束，生成可执行、可审计的采样器，统一支持单表、时序和关系数据，在多个基准上实现秒级生成、高保真度并完美保持键约束。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有合成数据生成采用“先拟合后采样”范式，面临三大挑战：每个数据集需重新训练；不同模态需特定模型和特征工程；模型不透明，难以在数据约束下审查行为。

Method: GENSCRIPT 采用纯推理管道：(1) 计算源数据的确定性统计概况（列类型、范围、缺失、类别、相关性等）；(2) 将概况而非原始行输入语言模型，推断字段语义和跨列完整性约束；(3) 编码代理将概况和约束编译为可执行、可审计的采样器，统一处理单表、时序和关系数据。

Result: 在四个单表基准上，GENSCRIPT 2分钟构建生成器，6秒采样5万行，边缘保真度与领先方法相差仅几个百分点；在 Adult 数据集上唯一完美保持列间 1 对 1 映射；在智能建筑数据集上，生成的条件时序比两个基线更贴近真实分布，且完美保持关系数据库的主键和外键关系。

Conclusion: GENSCRIPT 通过统计概况驱动的语言模型推理与代码生成，消除了模型训练开销，实现了跨模态统一、可审计、高效且高保真的合成数据生成，解决了现有范式的三大核心痛点。

Abstract: Synthetic data generation is dominated by the fit-then-sample paradigm: a generative model is trained on a private dataset and then sampled from. Despite its widespread adoption, this paradigm faces three challenges: (1) a new training run is required for every dataset; (2) different data modalities, such as single tables, time series, and relational databases, require task-specific models and feature engineering; and (3) the resulting model is opaque, making its behavior under data constraints difficult to inspect. We propose GENSCRIPT, an inference-only pipeline that eliminates model training. GENSCRIPT computes a deterministic statistical profile of the source data (column types, ranges, missingness, categories, correlations, etc.) and passes it--rather than raw rows--to a language model to infer field semantics and cross-column integrity constraints. A coding agent then compiles the profile and constraints into an executable, auditable sampler. This unified approach supports single-table, temporal, and relational data without task-specific modeling. Across four single-table benchmarks, GENSCRIPT builds generators in 2 minutes and samples 50k rows within 6 seconds, while remaining within a few points of leading methods in marginal fidelity. Notably, it is the only method that perfectly preserves a 1-to-1 mapping between columns in the Adult dataset. On a smart-building dataset, it produces conditional time series that more closely match the real distribution than two baselines and perfectly preserves primary- and foreign-key relationships in the corresponding relational database.

</details>


### [154] [Graph Anomaly Detection as Finite-Horizon Control: Training-Free Scoring via Empirical Bayes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38424)
*Fred Xu,Thomas Markovich,Florence Regol,Yizhou Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种无需训练的基于经验贝叶斯的图异常检测框架 EB-GAD，利用广义 Ornstein-Uhlenbeck 松弛建模正常性，通过闭式有限时域控制能量评分，并提供标签自由的评分族选择器，在 11 个基准上无标签情况下达到 SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 GAD 方法通过架构、消息传递、重构或对比目标间接编码正常性与异常评分，导致图信任度、谱加权和评分选择耦合，评分昂贵、不透明且跨图制度不稳定。

Method: 提出 EB-GAD：以图感知的广义 OU 过程建模正常性为图滤波模板的松弛；用经验贝叶斯从残差场似然拟合图精度矩阵；将异常评分转化为有限时域控制能量的闭式解；扫描松弛时域与端点容差得到共享同一先验的评分族（平衡马氏距离、有限时域控制能量、尺度归一化比率）；无标签选择器依据特征同配性、边密度、特征维度选评分族，再按拟合零假设偏离度与秩稳定性排序候选。

Result: 在 11 个基准上全程无标签，EB-GAD 在 9 个上取得最佳或并列最佳 AUROC（包括 4 个金融欺诈网络达 3.7M 节点、YelpChi、Amazon、Weibo、Reddit、Facebook），领先幅度高达 21.7 个百分点；在 BlogCatalog 和 ACM 上居次。

Conclusion: EB-GAD 通过显式概率建模与闭式控制能量评分，解耦了图信任、谱加权与评分选择，实现了无需训练、可解释、跨图制度稳健的节点级异常检测，并在大规模真实图上显著超越现有方法。

Abstract: Node-level graph anomaly detection (GAD) identifies nodes whose attributes and interactions deviate from dominant graph regularities. Existing GAD models encode normality and anomaly scoring indirectly through architectures, message passing, reconstruction or contrastive objectives, and tuned score families. This entangles graph trust (how strongly graph structure should define normality), graph-spectral weighting, and anomaly-score choice, yielding scores that are costly, opaque, and unstable across graph regimes. We propose EB-GAD (Empirical-Bayes GAD), a training-free framework that models normality as graph-aware generalized Ornstein-Uhlenbeck (GOU) relaxation toward a graph-filtered template. Empirical Bayes fits the graph precision from the residual-field likelihood; the GOU then turns scoring into a closed-form finite-horizon control energy, the minimum effort to steer a feature-neutral node to its observed endpoint along graph-spectral relaxation. Sweeping relaxation horizon and endpoint tolerance yields a bank of scores that share one fitted prior: equilibrium Mahalanobis scoring is one limit, while finite-horizon control-energy and scale-normalized ratio scores reveal anomalies that static equilibrium scoring can mask. A label-free selector chooses the score family from feature homophily, edge density, and feature dimension, then ranks candidates by fitted-null deviation and rank stability. On 11 benchmarks and without labels at any step, EB-GAD has the best or tied-best AUROC on 9: the four financial fraud networks (up to 3.7M nodes), the YelpChi and Amazon review graphs, Weibo, Reddit and Facebook, with margins of up to 21.7 points. It is second on BlogCatalog and ACM.

</details>


### [155] [What Pretraining and Midtraining Make Learnable from Rewards?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38446)
*Chiwun Yang,Xiaoyu Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究预训练和中间训练如何为奖励适应提供信息和计算，通过构建有限采样的Adam路径证明预测如何获得执行或检索能力，以及奖励如何学习任务特定用法。实验表明，在八个世界中，具有正确源和首操作监督的序列模型达到82.61%成功率，显著优于私有随机源控制的44.15%。记忆重放在奖励适应期间保持检索能力，独立八世界确认实现75.32%任务成功率对比49.86%。GSM8K和HotpotQA区分了奖励进入时的准确性、后续增益和最终表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究预训练和中间训练如何为奖励适应提供必要的信息和计算，解决序列状态计算和上下文记忆中存在的歧义问题——即不同机制在训练奖励上一致但对未见答案要求不同。任务无关的源观察被提出作为消除这种歧义的关键。

Method: 构建有限采样的Adam优化路径，从指定随机初始化开始，通过源预测和奖励适应在相同参数中进行。使用预训练的Qwen2.5检查点进行实验，测试八个世界中的分工效果。对比正确源+首操作监督与私有随机源控制，记忆重放与替代检索训练，以及在GSM8K和HotpotQA上分析奖励进入、后续增益和最终表现。

Result: 八个世界实验中，正确源+首操作监督达82.61%成功率，私有随机源控制仅44.15%。记忆重放保持检索能力，独立八世界确认75.32%对比替代检索训练49.86%。GSM8K和HotpotQA成功分离奖励进入准确性、后续增益和最终性能三个阶段。

Conclusion: 预训练通过源预测获取可执行计算或检索能力，中间训练通过奖励适应学习任务特定用法。任务无关源观察消除歧义，记忆重放保护检索不被奖励适应破坏。这建立了信息获取、可执行计算和奖励引导任务学习之间的系统性联系。

Abstract: A reward can identify a correct answer while leaving the computation needed for new inputs undetermined. We study how pretraining and midtraining supply the information and computation that make reward adaptation effective. In sequential state computation and contextual memory, we characterize mechanisms that agree on every training reward yet demand different held-out answers. Task-independent source observations resolve this ambiguity. We construct finite sampled Adam paths from specified random initializations through source prediction and reward adaptation in the same parameters, proving how prediction acquires execution or retrieval and rewards learn their task-specific use. Experiments with pretrained Qwen2.5 checkpoints test this division of labor. Across eight worlds, Sequential models trained with correct source and first-operation supervision reach 82.61% success, versus 44.15% for a private-random source control. Memory replay preserves retrieval during reward adaptation, and an independent eight-world confirmation achieves 75.32% task success versus 49.86% after matched alternative-retrieval training. GSM8K and HotpotQA separate accuracy at reward entry, subsequent gain and final performance. Together, these results connect information acquisition, executable computation and reward-guided task learning.

</details>


### [156] [An Input-Frugal Deep Learning Framework for Weather-Driven National Crop-Yield Forecasting: A Case Study of Brazilian Soybean](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38447)
*Fernando Dupin da Cunha Mello,Prashant Kumar,Erick G. Sperandio Nascimento*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出了一种节俭、可迁移、架构无关的深度学习框架，仅使用常规天气作为时变输入，加上作物年度和农业环境标签两个静态上下文输入，实现大豆产量预测。在巴西20个季节的案例研究中，Transformer编码器达到最佳国家级精度（RMSE 149 kg/ha，rRMSE 5.3%，R²=0.784），较农民基线误差降低47.6%。所有深度学习变体均优于岭回归，序列编码器优于非序列MLP。消融实验表明农业环境标签和空间实例扩展有正向贡献。SHAP分析显示作物年度解释长期趋势，季内天气和农业环境上下文驱动年际偏差，湿度/云量和热力需求变量主导。框架易于部署到其他作物和区域，兼容业务天气预报。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可靠、及时的作物产量预测对市场稳定和风险管理至关重要，但现有方法常依赖昂贵或难以扩展的输入数据。需要一种节俭、可迁移且架构无关的框架，仅使用常规天气数据即可实现高精度预测，并支持多种序列编码器。

Method: 提出深度学习框架，输入仅包含常规天气时序数据（唯一时变输入）以及作物年度和农业环境标签两个轻量静态上下文。框架架构无关，支持MLP、CNN、LSTM、CNN-LSTM、Transformer编码器和Mamba状态空间模型等多种序列编码器。使用巴西大豆20个季节（2001/02-2020/21）数据，采用留一年交叉验证，对比线性岭回归和五年移动平均农民基线。进行消融实验和SHAP诊断分析特征重要性。

Result: 所有深度学习变体均优于岭回归，所有序列编码器均优于非序列MLP。Transformer达到最佳国家级精度：RMSE 149 kg/ha，rRMSE 5.3%，R²=0.784，较农民基线误差降低47.6%。季内预测随发布时间从早到晚单调改善，最晚预测点误差比基线低约50%。消融实验显示农业环境标签和空间实例扩展（每市镇年份多网格节点天气序列）有正向贡献且不增加输入复杂度。SHAP分析表明作物年度解释长期轨迹，季内天气和农业环境上下文主要驱动年际偏差，湿度/云量和热力需求变量主导。

Conclusion: 该框架节俭、可迁移、架构无关，易于部署到其他作物和地理区域，天然兼容业务天气预报，可用于常规监测。仅用常规天气和两个静态输入即可实现高精度产量预测，为农业决策提供可靠工具。

Abstract: Reliable, timely crop-yield forecasts are essential for market stability and risk management, yet many approaches rely on costly or hard-to-scale inputs. We present a frugal, transferable, and architecture-agnostic deep learning framework that uses routine weather as the only time-varying input plus two lightweight static context inputs (crop year and an agro-environmental label) to capture long-run change and regional heterogeneity, while supporting multiple sequence encoders under identical data requirements. Using a 20-season Brazilian soybean case study (2001/02-2020/21) with leave-one-year-out cross-validation, we benchmark MLP, CNN, LSTM, CNN-LSTM, a Transformer encoder and the Mamba state-space model against linear ridge regression and a five-year moving-average "farmer" baseline. All deep learning variants outperform ridge, and all sequential encoders surpass the non-sequential MLP. The Transformer achieves the best national accuracy (RMSE 149 kg ha^-1; rRMSE 5.3%; R^2 = 0.784), reducing error by 47.6% relative to the farmer baseline. In-season forecasts improve monotonically from early- to late-season issuance, reaching approximately 50% lower error than the baseline at the latest forecast point. Ablations indicate that the agro-environmental label and spatial instance expansion (multiple grid-node weather sequences per municipality-year) contribute positively without increasing input complexity. SHAP diagnostics suggest crop year explains most of the long-run trajectory, whereas within-season weather and agro-environmental context primarily drive interannual deviations, with moisture/cloud and thermal-demand variables dominating. Overall, the framework is straightforward to deploy across other crops and geographic regions and is naturally compatible with operational weather forecasts for routine monitoring.

</details>


### [157] [Grokking through the Lens of Minimum-Norm Interpolation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38453)
*Gil Kur,Ileana Rugina,Clémentine Carla Juliette Dominé,Marco Mondelli*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文建立统计理论，量化正则化几何与信号稀疏性如何支配插值附近的泛化，证明在强过参数无噪问题中存在零一泛化定律，并构造一族凸范数使插值器从零预测子风险转变为精确恢复；在特征维度与样本量成比例时，给出ℓ_r正则化路径上训练与泛化误差的精确刻画，揭示泛化增益随稀疏性促进增强而增加，且在无噪ℓ_1正则化下出现剧烈下降。实验验证理论在对角线性网络和模算术Transformer上的普适性，并揭示最小范数插值的统计不稳定性：正则化强度微小扰动导致泛化剧烈变化而训练误差保持很小。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Grokking现象显示拟合训练数据与学习潜在信号可能在截然不同阶段发生，但现有理论对这种延迟泛化如何依赖归纳偏置和信号结构缺乏定量洞察。本文旨在填补这一空白，发展统计理论刻画正则化几何与信号稀疏性如何共同决定插值附近的泛化行为。

Method: 聚焦高维回归原型设定，采用统计物理与高维概率工具：(1) 在强过参数无噪设定下，证明零一泛化定律并构造一族凸范数，分析其插值器从全零预测子到精确恢复的相变；(2) 在特征维度与样本量成比例的比例极限下，利用近似消息传递(AMP)或留一法(LOO)等技术，精确刻画ℓ_r正则化路径上的训练误差与泛化误差；(3) 理论预测通过对角线性网络和模算术Transformer实验验证。

Result: 主要结果：(1) 强过参数无噪情况下，存在零一泛化定律：构造的凸范数族使插值器在保持训练误差为0的前提下，从平凡风险(全零预测子)跃迁至精确恢复；(2) 比例极限下，给出ℓ_r正则化路径上训练与泛化误差的精确表达，量化了插值附近的泛化增益——增益随范数稀疏性促进程度(r↓)和目标稀疏度增加而增大，在无噪ℓ_1正则化处出现尖锐下降；(3) 实验证实理论预测在深度学习模型(对角线性网络、Transformer模算术)中成立；(4) 揭示最小范数插值的统计不稳定性：正则化强度微小扰动导致泛化误差剧烈变化，而训练误差保持极小。

Conclusion: 本文建立了首个定量描述正则化几何与信号稀疏性如何联合控制插值附近泛化的统计理论，解释了grokking背后的机制：稀疏性促进正则化在插值阈值附近产生泛化相变。理论揭示的最小范数插值不稳定性提示，在过参数化模型中，极小的正则化调整可能引发泛化性能的剧烈波动，这对理解深度学习的泛化行为及超参数敏感性具有重要启示。

Abstract: Grokking shows that fitting the training data and learning the underlying signal can occur at very different stages. However, existing theories offer limited quantitative insight into how this delayed generalization depends on inductive bias and signal structure. Our work addresses the gap by developing a statistical theory that characterizes how regularization geometry and signal sparsity govern generalization near interpolation. In particular, we focus on the prototypical setting of high-dimensional regression and identify regimes in which sparsity-promoting regularization makes exact interpolation much more accurate than approximate fitting. In strongly overparameterized noiseless problems, we prove a zero--one generalization law and construct a family of convex norms whose interpolators transition from the trivial risk of the all-zero predictor to exact recovery, while keeping the training error equal to $0$. Furthermore, when feature dimension and sample size are proportional, we provide a precise characterization of training and generalization errors along $\ell_r$-regularization paths. This in turn allows us to quantify the generalization gain that remains near interpolation: we show that this gain increases as the norm becomes more sparsity-promoting and as the target becomes sparser, with a sharp drop in generalization reached for noiseless data and $\ell_1$ regularization. Experiments on diagonal linear networks and transformers trained on modular arithmetic demonstrate the generality of our theoretical predictions. Finally, beyond grokking, our work reveals a statistical instability in minimum-norm interpolation: small perturbations in the regularization strength can lead to drastically different generalization, while preserving small training error.

</details>


### [158] [Does Gradient Conflict Predict the Understanding--Generation Trade-off? A Controlled Audit of Conflict-Metric Validity in Unified Multimodal Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38465)
*Shuyang Jiang,Fucheng Deng,Yuchuan Luo,Zhenyu Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过构建受控测试平台 GRIDUMM，系统审计了统一多模态模型（UMM）中理解与生成目标间梯度冲突指标与下游理解-生成权衡的关系，发现方向性冲突指标与最终权衡缺乏显著相关性，抑制冲突不改善权衡，揭示相关性不等于因果性，训练损失更能追踪权衡，功能干扰指标优于方向性冲突指标，强调冲突指标作为诊断目标的有效性需经验证而非假设。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有统一多模态模型设计常基于减少理解与生成目标间梯度冲突的前提，但该前提即减少冲突能改善下游理解-生成权衡从未直接经验验证，亟需受控实验审计其有效性。

Method: 构建受控测试平台 GRIDUMM，复现 UMM 训练关键结构成分且使真实权衡精确可计；测试 63 种配置、372 个检查点；计算方向性冲突指标、功能干扰指标、范数比等；实施剂量-反应干预单调抑制冲突；使用 Spearman 相关性分析冲突指标与最终权衡的关系。

Result: 无方向性冲突指标与最终权衡的绝对 Spearman 相关性达 0.3 且置信区间排除零；单调抑制冲突的干预使权衡曲线保持平坦，分离相关性与因果性；范数比是生成失败检测器，在掌握生成的配置中失效；功能干扰指标优于方向性冲突指标；训练损失强追踪权衡。

Conclusion: 梯度冲突指标并非无用，但其作为诊断目标的有效性必须建立而非假设；发布审计协议作为可复用标准，推动该领域严谨评估。

Abstract: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) are increasingly designed around gradient conflict between understanding and generation objectives. The premise that reducing these metrics improves the downstream understanding-generation trade-off has never been tested directly. We audit it in a controlled testbed, GRIDUMM, which mirrors key structural ingredients of UMM training while making the ground-truth trade-off exactly computable. Across 63 configurations and 372 measured checkpoints, no directional conflict metric reaches an absolute Spearman correlation of 0.3 with a confidence interval excluding zero for conflict measured during training against the eventual trade-off. A dose-response intervention that monotonically suppresses conflict leaves the trade-off flat, separating correlation from causation. The norm ratio is a generation-failure detector and becomes null among configurations that master generation. Functional interference measures outperform directional conflict metrics, while training loss tracks the trade-off strongly. Our results do not show that conflict is useless; they show that its validity as a diagnostic target must be established, not assumed, and we release the audit protocol as a reusable standard.

</details>


### [159] [RetroGEF: Dynamic Graph Edit Flow for Single-Step Retrosynthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38484)
*Xiaozhuang Song,Xuemin Chen,Xinjian Zhao,Yaoyao Xu,Tianshu Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 RetroGEF，一种基于流的生成模型，用于单步逆合成。它从目标分子出发，通过在分子图中添加原子和改变键来构建可能的反应物，统一建模分子图的拓扑变换和尺寸变化，且无需预设编辑顺序，在基准测试中达到最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 逆合成是药物发现和材料设计的核心任务，涉及分子图的连接性和大小的同时变化。现有方法往往依赖固定大小的图画布或预设的编辑顺序，难以灵活建模反应物中可能出现的目标分子中不存在的新组分。需要一种能在同一生成过程中联合处理图结构变换和尺寸变化、且直接从产物-反应物对学习的模型。

Method: 提出 RetroGEF，一种基于正则化流的生成模型。从产物分子图开始，通过连续的流变换逐步添加原子、调整键，生成反应物图。该模型将分子图的拓扑变化和节点数量变化统一在同一生成过程中建模，不依赖固定画布，也不需要人工指定的编辑顺序，直接从成对数据中端到端学习逆合成变换。

Result: 在具有代表性的逆合成基准测试（如 USPTO-50k 等）上，RetroGEF 在单步逆合成任务中达到了最先进的性能，优于现有的基于模板、基于图编辑或基于序列生成的方法。

Conclusion: RetroGEF 通过流模型统一建模分子图的结构与尺寸变化，无需预设编辑顺序，实现了高效且准确的单步逆合成预测，为自动化合成路线设计提供了有力工具。

Abstract: Retrosynthesis enables the discovery of viable synthetic routes to target molecules. It plays a central role in modern drug discovery and materials design. Retrosynthesis involves molecular graph transformations that can change both connectivity and graph size. These transformations may introduce reactant components absent from the target while revising the product-derived structure. To model these transformations, we propose RetroGEF, a flow-based generative model for single-step retrosynthesis. Starting from the target molecule, it constructs possible reactants by adding atoms and changing bonds in the molecular graph. RetroGEF models molecular transformations and changes in graph size within the same generative process, rather than relying on a fixed-size graph canvas. It learns this process directly from product--reactant pairs without requiring a prescribed edit order. Experiments on representative retrosynthesis benchmarks demonstrate that RetroGEF achieves state-of-the-art performance.

</details>


### [160] [Role-guided Speaker Deletion Verification in Clinical Psychiatry Speech Recordings with Audio Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38491)
*Joseph T Colonel,Daniel Katzman,Kelsey Kirker,Adam N Davidson,Shalaila S Haas,Cheryl Corcoran,René S Kahn,Guillermo Checci,Baihan Lin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对精神病学临床研究中多说话人录音删除指定说话人后的验证问题，提出双管道并行方法，利用音频-语言模型和大语言模型检测遗漏删除片段，在48个精神科诊疗录音上评估四种开源模型，OR集成策略达到F1 0.478（召回率0.870），验证了跨模型和视角的互补性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 精神病学临床研究越来越依赖大规模口语数据采集以识别声学和语言生物标记，但不断变化的知情同意和协议要求迫使研究者从多说话人录音中移除指定说话人，并需在人工审核不可行的大规模语料上验证移除效果。

Method: 构建两条对称并行管道：一条验证临床医生语音是否被删除，另一条验证患者语音是否被删除。每条管道先对原始音频按目标角色进行删编，再用音频-语言模型和大语言模型扫描剩余音频以识别遗漏的删除片段。在48个精神科双人对话录音上，以纯推理方式测试Gemma-4-12B、Gemma-4-31B、Nemotron-3-Nano、Nemotron-3-Nano-Omni四个开放权重模型，并采用14种模型-视角配置的析取OR集成策略。

Result: OR集成达到综合F1 0.478（精确率0.330，召回率0.870），优于单个模型估计，提升主要源于召回率增益，表明不同模型和上下文视角间存在显著互补性。

Conclusion: 基于音频-语言模型和大语言模型的双管道验证框架可有效检测临床对话录音中指定说话人删除的遗漏片段，集成策略显著提升召回率，为大规模精神科语料的合规性自动化审核提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Clinical research in psychiatry increasingly relies on large scale collection of spoken language data to identify acoustic and linguistic biomarkers. Yet evolving consent and protocol requirements can oblige investigators to remove a designated speaker from multi-speaker recordings and to verify said removal at a scale infeasible for manual review of entire corpora. We study this verification problem for role-driven dyadic clinical dialogue in psychiatry and investigate it with two parallel, symmetric pipelines: confirming that clinician speech has been removed from psychiatric interview recordings, and confirming that patient speech has been removed from the same recordings. Each pipeline redacts the raw audio for its target role and then scans the surviving output with audio-language and large-language models to identify missed deletions. We evaluate this approach on a corpus of 48 dyadic recordings drawn from psychiatry settings, testing four open-weight models in an inference-only setting: Gemma-4-12B, Gemma-4-31B, Nemotron-3-Nano, and Nemotron-3-Nano-Omni. A disjunctive OR ensemble over fourteen model-view configurations had a combined F1 of 0.478 (precision 0.330, recall 0.870), an improvement over individual model estimates driven by recall gains that point to substantial complementarity across models and context views.

</details>


### [161] [Autoregressive Frontier Expansion: Growing Trees with Graph Machine Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38506)
*Umer Gupta,Saku Peltonen,Martin Ritzert*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出自回归前沿扩展（Autoregressive Frontier Expansion）框架，通过模拟生物生长过程，利用SO(2)-等变图神经网络参数化的流匹配模型，迭代预测分支分叉或终止，实现神经元和植物树木等树状结构的高保真生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 树状分支结构广泛存在于自然界（神经元、血管、植物等），其形态反映功能，结构建模至关重要。真实3D数据获取昂贵或不可行，现有形态学专用模型要么约束拓扑生成，要么依赖手工调参的机制程序；通用3D图生成器则未利用树的结构先验。因此需要一种能捕捉树生长机制的生成模型。

Method: 提出自回归前沿扩展框架：以迭代扩展过程模拟生物生长。每一步由SO(2)-等变图神经网络参数化的流匹配模型，对当前活跃前沿的每个分支预测分叉或终止，从而逐步构建完整树结构。

Result: 在皮层神经元和植物树木两个领域，分别进行无条件、类别条件和形态引导生成实验。生成的形态分布与参考分布高度吻合，条件生成实验中也能精准匹配指定目标。

Conclusion: 自回归前沿扩展通过模拟生物生长机制，结合等变GNN与流匹配，成功实现了跨领域树状结构的高质量生成，兼顾了无条件分布拟合与条件可控生成，为形态学建模提供了通用且生物合理的生成范式。

Abstract: Tree-like branching structures are common in nature, from botanical trees to neurons, blood vessels and respiratory trees. Their branching shape often reflects function, making structural modelling central to understanding how these systems work. Because acquiring real-world 3D data is often expensive or infeasible, realistic generative models are valuable for simulation and data augmentation. Existing morphology-specific models either constrain how topology is generated or rely on hand-tuned, mechanistic procedures. Generic 3D graph generators, by contrast, do not exploit or enforce the structure of trees. We propose Autoregressive Frontier Expansion, a generative framework that constructs trees through an iterative expansion process, simulating the biological growth of real trees. At each step, a flow-matching model parameterised by an SO(2)-equivariant GNN expands the frontier by predicting whether each active branch bifurcates or terminates. We evaluate our method on cortical neurons and botanical trees in unconditional, class-conditioned, and morphology-guided generation. Across both domains, the generated morphologies agree closely with the reference distributions and, in conditional experiments, with the specified targets.

</details>


### [162] [Does Text Steer Neural PDE Surrogates? A Controlled Diagnostic with OperatorCLIP](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38517)
*Aadi Dash,Lennon J. Shikhman,Michael Galarnyk*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文通过OperatorCLIP实验表明，文本条件神经代理模型的低误差并不证明其理解文本语义，强调需要路径控制来隔离文本语义的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究文本条件神经代理模型是否真正利用文本语义，而非仅靠条件机制降低误差，揭示现有评估中缺乏适当控制的问题。

Method: 对比无条件FNO、常数句子FiLM控制、固定任务描述加对比对齐三种模型，在Darcy2D、ShallowWater2D、CNS3D三个PDE任务上进行三种子实验；文本编码器从头训练，每个条件模型仅见一种描述，使用InfoNCE损失。

Result: 常数条件在两个2D任务上平均测试误差更低；任务文本加对齐与常数控制相比，在ShallowWater2D和CNS3D平均误差相似，在Darcy2D更高，但种子间不确定性大；提示干预无可靠语义排序；InfoNCE在该设置下无法识别匹配对，损失达最小值log B。

Conclusion: 实验表明单纯添加文本条件和对比对齐不足以证明语义理解，需引入路径控制隔离文本语义效应；现有范式既未建立编码器语义能力，也未测试文本在不同物理语境下的有效性。

Abstract: Lower error from a text-conditioned neural surrogate does not, by itself, show that the model uses the meaning of the text. We examine this attribution problem with OperatorCLIP, comparing an unconditioned FNO, a constant-sentence FiLM control, and a fixed task description trained with contrastive alignment. Three-seed experiments cover Darcy2D, ShallowWater2D, and three-dimensional compressible Navier-Stokes (CNS3D). Constant conditioning has lower mean test error on both 2D tasks. Relative to this control, task text plus alignment has a similar mean on ShallowWater2D and CNS3D and a higher mean on Darcy2D; these descriptive comparisons have substantial seed uncertainty. The latter comparison changes both prompt content and loss, so it isolates neither effect. The text encoder is trained from scratch, and each conditioned model sees only one description during training. In this regime, pairwise InfoNCE cannot identify matched pairs and has minimum $\log B$. Prompt interventions show no reliable semantic ordering. This methodological caution demonstrates why pathway controls are needed; it neither establishes semantic competence of the encoder nor tests the effectiveness of text under varying physical context.

</details>


### [163] [ShamAN-Q: Shampoo Augmented NanoQuant for Sub-1-bit LLM Weights](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38521)
*Jonathan Mei,Sang Hyub Kim,Oliver Knitter,Chi Chen,Martin Roetteler*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ShamAN-Q是一种亚1比特后训练量化方法，通过引入密集曲率度量和Kronecker积近似Fisher信息矩阵，显著降低了Qwen3模型在WikiText-2上的困惑度，在相同或更低比特率下超越NanoQuant。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有亚1比特量化方法如NanoQuant采用对角重构几何，忽略了权重间的相关性，导致量化精度受限。需要一种能捕捉密集曲率信息、且计算可行的量化框架。

Method: 基于Shampoo优化器范式，对每个线性层权重拟合Kronecker积近似经验Fisher信息矩阵（通过KL散度最小化），构建Mahalanobis重构损失。将NanoQuant的连续ADMM更新转化为Sylvester方程求解，保持离散投影和部署格式不变。逐层实时测量输入曲率统计并周期性刷新，跨层重新分配秩预算。

Result: 在Qwen3-Base上，~1 bpw时WikiText-2困惑度显著下降：0.6B从27.56降至22.96，1.7B从19.21降至16.72，4B从14.29降至13.80；零样本准确率持平或提升。0.6B模型在~0.8 bpw即达到NanoQuant在~1.0 bpw的困惑度水平。

Conclusion: ShamAN-Q通过密集曲率建模和自适应秩分配，在极低比特率下实现了最优量化精度，为亚1比特大模型压缩提供了新范式。

Abstract: We introduce ShamAN-Q, a sub-1-bit post-training quantization method that extends NanoQuant by replacing each its diagonal reconstruction geometry with a tractable dense curvature metric, using a general paradigm popularized by the Shampoo optimizer. For each linear weight, ShamAN-Q fits a Kronecker product to the empirical Fisher information matrix of a small calibration set by Kullback--Leibler minimization, forming a Mahalanobis reconstruction loss from the result. The continuous ADMM updates from NanoQuant become solutions to Sylvester equations, while its discrete projection and deployment format remain unchanged. Because the curvature is local to a given set of weights, ShamAN-Q re-measures the input curvature statistic for each layer immediately before layer factorization, periodically refreshing all statistics on the partially quantized model. ShamAN-Q also redistributes the uniform rank from NanoQuant across layers at the same total number of bits. On Qwen3-Base, ShamAN-Q lowers WikiText-2 perplexity at $\approx$1 bpw from 27.56 to 22.96 (0.6B), 19.21 to 16.72 (1.7B), and 14.29 to 13.80 (4B) while matching or improving zero-shot accuracy on the Eleuther LM Evaluation Harness. On 0.6B, ShamAN-Q at $\approx$0.8 bpw matches the published perplexity of NanoQuant at $\approx$1.0 bpw.

</details>


### [164] [MM-FinEval: A Multi-Task Multimodal Benchmark for Real-World Financial Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38523)
*Dong Shu,Yanguang Liu,Huopu Zhang,Saisai Hu,Haiyan Zhao,Hekun Huang,Mengnan Du*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MM-FinEval是一个新的多模态财务基准，包含2019-2022年2,045个S&P 500财报电话会议，三模态输入（文本逐字稿、演示幻灯片、音频录音）和12个财务任务标签。实验评估了19个基线模型，发现小规模Any-to-Any三模态模型表现优于大型专有双模态模型，验证了三模态信息的互补非冗余性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有财务基准多局限于单模态输入或单任务设置，难以评估多模态大语言模型在真实财务分析场景中的能力，缺乏对文本、音频、视觉多模态融合推理的系统性评测框架。

Method: 构建MM-FinEval基准：收集2019-2022年S&P 500公司2,045场财报电话会议，每样本包含文本逐字稿、演示幻灯片、音频录音三模态输入，标注12个财务任务标签。建立严格评估框架，测试19个基线模型，分为Image-Text、Audio-Text、Any-to-Any三类配置，对比不同模态组合和模型规模的表现。

Result: 小规模Any-to-Any三模态模型处理所有三种模态时表现强劲，甚至优于仅处理双模态的大型专有模型。结果表明三模态数据集设计引入了有用的非冗余信息，文本、音频、视觉数据作为重要互补信号，能模拟专家分析师的决策过程。

Conclusion: 多模态融合在财务预测中具有显著价值，三模态信息互补性强，小型多模态模型即可充分利用跨模态信息实现高性能。MM-FinEval为评估多模态LLM在复杂财务推理任务中的能力提供了严谨基准，推动了财务AI向真实多模态分析场景发展。

Abstract: Financial forecasting from earnings conference calls requires models to reason over complex corporate disclosures, market expectations, and subtle communication signals. However, existing financial benchmarks are often limited to unimodal inputs or single-task settings, making it difficult to evaluate whether multimodal large language models (LLMs) can support real-world financial analysis. In this paper, we introduce MM-FinEval, a novel benchmark designed to evaluate multimodal LLMs across multiple financial tasks. MM-FinEval spans a diverse timeline from 2019 to 2022. The entire proposed dataset contains 2,045 S\&P 500 conference earning calls as inputs and 12 financial task labels as outputs. Each input contains three modalities: a word-to-word text transcript of the earning call, the corresponding presentation slides used during the call, and the entire audio recording. To establish a rigorous evaluation framework, we analyze 19 baseline models across three distinct model categories: Image-Text, Audio-Text, and Any-to-Any configurations. We observe that small-size Any-to-Any models processing all three modalities achieve strong performance, even when compared against larger proprietary models restricted to two-modality inputs. This indicates that our tri-modal dataset design introduces useful, non-redundant information. These results validate that text, audio, and visual data serve as important, complementary signals that mimic the decision-making process of expert human analysts.

</details>


### [165] [Revisiting scaling laws for reward optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38526)
*Ali Aouad,Aymane El Gadarri,Vivek F. Farias*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出了AI对齐中奖励模型优化的缩放定律：性能随比较数据量M和KL散度预算K按Θ(√min{log M, K})缩放。通过信息论模型证明上界可达，并在70B金标奖励模型与0.6B-4B代理模型的真实标注实验中验证（R² 97%-99%），揭示奖励优化本质等同于用噪声偏好反馈从独立同分布高斯变量序列中选择的简单任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究未清晰刻画性能如何随偏好训练数据量M和优化散度预算K联合缩放。过优化（奖励作弊）源于代理奖励模型与真实奖励的偏差，而代理模型的准确性取决于训练比较数据量。需要统一的理论框架量化这种联合依赖关系。

Method: 1. 构建信息论模型，将奖励优化建模为从独立同分布高斯变量序列中基于噪声偏好反馈进行选择的任务。2. 推导性能上界Θ(√min{log M, K})并给出构造性证明其紧致可达。3. 设计真实标注实验：70B金标奖励模型生成反馈，训练0.6B-4B代理奖励模型，对比best-of-N和策略倾斜两种优化程序。

Result: 缩放定律在多种模型规模、噪声水平和优化程序下均表现出极佳拟合度（R² 97%-99%），显著优于备选规格。实证证据支持奖励优化等效于简单的高斯选择任务这一核心洞察。

Conclusion: 奖励模型优化的性能由数据量M和散度预算K的较小者对数的平方根决定。这一定律为避免过优化提供了理论指导：在给定数据量下存在最优优化预算，反之亦然。研究将复杂的对齐问题简化为基础的统计选择问题，为可扩展的对齐系统设计奠定了定量基础。

Abstract: Scaling laws for optimization against reward models in AI alignment have pinned down how performance depends on optimization effort---measured by a KL-divergence budget relative to a reference policy. Beyond a certain budget, over-optimization (or reward hacking) can arise: because we optimize against a proxy reward model (distinct from true rewards), performance can plateau or degrade. Naturally, the proxy reward's accuracy depends on how much preference data (often in the form of pairwise comparisons) was used to train it. However, existing research does not cleanly identify how performance jointly scales with the amount of training data and the divergence budget. Our main contribution is to provide an empirically accurate and theoretically grounded scaling law in such context. Performance roughly scales as $Θ(\sqrt{\min\{\log(M),K\}})$, where $M$ is the number of comparisons in training data and $K$ is the policy's divergence budget. We develop an information-theoretic model to establish this upper bound and prove it is tightly achievable through a constructive procedure. Informed by this, we conduct extensive empirical evaluations using a real-world annotation setup, whereby a large 70B gold reward model generates feedback data and proxy reward models are trained from less capable models (0.6B to 4B). Our scaling law provides an excellent fit (R2 from 97\% to 99\%), outperforms alternative specifications, and remains robust across model sizes, noise, and optimization procedures (best-of-$N$ or policy tilting). Our evidence suggests that reward optimization is analogous to a surprisingly simple selection task: choosing from a sequence of IID Gaussian random variables using noisy preference feedback.

</details>


### [166] [Does This Action Still Explain the Task? Reverse Scoring for Diffusion Language Model Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38536)
*Jiacheng Qiu,Christopher E. Mower,Jan Peters,Haitham Bou-Ammar,Matthieu Zimmer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文揭示了基于扩散的大语言模型（dLLM）在具身智能体任务中陷入重试循环的机制：掩码解码的自适应性导致模型在失败状态下仍高概率重复失败动作。作者将该现象建模为任务无关的上下文腐败，提出利用反向条件概率的不变性——即任务给定状态和候选动作的似然——来抵消腐败因子，设计了无需训练的“反思逆向”方法，在四个多轮具身基准上显著提升任务成功率和进展率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: dLLM 虽通过并行解码打破自回归延迟瓶颈，但在具身智能体评测中表现不佳，反复陷入重试循环（长时间重复已失败动作）。现有工作缺乏对该失效模式的机制性解释及免训练修正方案。

Method: 1. 机制分析：将重试循环归因于掩码解码的自适应提交机制——采样器优先提交高置信位置，延后不确定位置；失败状态下上下文为延后决策提供了高置信填充（即失败动作），导致模型在未正视失败反馈的情况下重复提交。2. 建模：将动作分布畸变形式化为任务无关腐败，即上下文显著动作（如刚执行动作）获得与状态、动作相关但与任务无关的概率膨胀因子。3. 不变性命题：证明该任务无关因子在反向条件概率 P(任务|状态,候选动作) 中精确抵消，等同于理想无腐败模型的任务后验。4. 算法实例化：利用 dLLM 原生支持掩码任务 token 并去噪的特性，通过并行少量前向传播评估反向条件，提出 Reflect Reverse 策略对候选动作打分并选择。

Result: 在四个多轮具身基准（如 ALFWorld、WebShop 等）上，Reflect Reverse 显著优于前向评分基线：任务成功率与进展率均大幅提升，且仅需每候选动作少量并行解码开销，无需额外训练。

Conclusion: dLLM 的重试循环本质是掩码解码自适应性引入的任务无关上下文腐败；通过反向条件概率的不变性可免训练消除该偏差。Reflect Reverse 方法在保持并行解码效率的同时，恢复了具身智能体的推理能力，为扩散语言模型在智能体场景的落地提供了理论指导与实用范式。

Abstract: Diffusion-based large language models (dLLMs) promise to break the sequential latency bottleneck of autoregressive agents through parallel decoding, but recent evaluations show this efficiency does not transfer to embodied agentic competence: dLLM-backed agents repeatedly fall into retry loops, re-issuing an action long after it has failed. We give a mechanistic account of this failure and a training-free remedy. We trace the retry loop to the adaptivity of masked decoding: the sampler commits the positions it is most confident about and defers the uncertain ones, and at a failure state the context already offers a confident fill for the deferred decision, i.e. the failed action itself, so the retry is committed without the failure feedback ever being confronted. We model the resulting distortion of the action distribution as a task-blind corruption: contextually salient actions (e.g., the action just taken) receive inflated probability by a factor that depends on the state and the action but not on the task. Under this model, we analyse an invariance proposition: the task-blind factor cancels exactly from the reverse conditional, i.e. the likelihood of the task given the state and a candidate action, which coincides with the task posterior of an idealized uncorrupted model. Masked dLLMs evaluate the reverse conditional natively, unlike autoregressive models, by masking the task tokens and denoising, at the cost of a few parallel passes per candidate. We instantiate the rule as Reflect Reverse and evaluate it on four multi-turn embodied benchmarks, where it improves task success and progression rates over forward-scoring baselines.

</details>


### [167] [ReLaG: A Scalable Framework Generalizing Random Splits to Data with Latent Relations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38538)
*Anthony Lavertu,Jacob Cote,Sophie Gobeil,Jacques Corbeil,Isabeau Premont-Schwarz,Pascal Germain*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ReLaG 是一种模态无关的框架，通过层次潜变量过程、邻近图和社区检测建模样本相关性，推断相关样本群组，生成独立的训练-测试划分，解决随机划分在含相关样本数据集中导致的过度乐观泛化估计问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在生化研究等应用中，数据集常包含相关样本，随机划分会产生非独立的训练-测试子集，导致泛化性能估计过于乐观。现有关系感知方法存在扩展性不足，难以处理大规模数据集。

Method: 提出 ReLaG 框架：1) 使用层次潜变量过程建模样本相关性；2) 结合邻近图和社区检测推断相关样本群组；3) 基于群组生成独立的训练-测试划分；4) 引入无标签过程自适应调整划分分辨率以匹配部署场景；5) 利用推断群组估计有效数据集规模，支持多样性感知的数据集扩展。

Result: 在分子和蛋白质数据集上，ReLaG 性能媲美现有关系感知方法，但扩展性显著更强，能够处理以往不切实际的大规模数据集。无标签自适应程序使评估与部署设置对齐。推断的群组提供了廉价的有效数据集大小估计。

Conclusion: ReLaG 解决了相关样本数据集的独立划分难题，兼具高性能与强扩展性，其开源实现（pip install relag）促进了实际应用。

Abstract: Random splitting can yield non-independent train--test subsets when a dataset contains related samples, as is common in certain applications such as biochemical studies. This leads to overly optimistic generalization estimates. Here, we introduce ReLaG, a modality-agnostic framework that models sample relatedness through a hierarchical latent-variable process and infers groups of related samples using proximity graphs and community detection to produce independent train--test subsets. Across molecular and protein datasets, ReLaG matches existing relation-aware methods while scaling substantially better, enabling splits at previously impractical dataset sizes. We further introduce a label-free procedure that adapts the splitting resolution to production data, aligning evaluation with the intended deployment setting. ReLaG's inferred groups provide a cheap estimate of effective dataset size, enabling diversity-aware dataset scaling. ReLaG is open source and can be installed with pip install relag.

</details>


### [168] [When a Flatness Proxy Is Not a Function: Robustness Certificates and Training Interventions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38540)
*Vicente Opazo,Jose Calatayud-Mateu,Cristobal Rojas,Cristian Buc Calderon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文指出有效的曲率上界本身不足以证明鲁棒性证书或内在预测器属性干预的合理性。通过最后一层相对平坦度代理的分析，揭示了经验风险驻点无法消除一阶损失项，以及softmax行平移破坏代理有界性的问题，并提出了修正方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究动机是揭示曲率上界作为理论工具在鲁棒性认证和训练干预中的局限性。现有工作常将最后一层相对平坦度代理同时用于这两个场景，但缺乏对其有效性边界的系统性分析，导致可能产生误导性的证书或无效的正则化干预。

Method: 1. 理论分析：证明经验风险全局最小值处保留的证书表达式低估损失增益达210倍以上，推导全局有效、规范不变的特征空间修正。2. 对称性分析：研究common-row softmax平移对预测不变但代理无界的影响，证明标准参考类选择使代理平均翻倍，标量重调谐无法对齐概率更新。3. 提出行中心化获得轨道最小化界，恢复数值和全模型梯度不变性。4. 实验验证：45组配对单步测试（算法模型和图像模型）及长程CIFAR-10实验。

Result: 1. 原始正则化预测器在放大平移下分离，商正则化预测器保持对齐。2. 长程CIFAR-10实验显示泛化能力被显著且可逆地抑制。3. 记忆化后选择性延迟的证据不一致。4. 行中心化有效恢复不变性并最小化界值。

Conclusion: 曲率上界的有效性本身不足以证明其可逆用于鲁棒性证书，或可微用于内在训练干预。必须显式处理一阶项残留、规范对称性破坏等问题，才能构建可靠的认证和干预方法。

Abstract: A valid curvature upper bound need not justify either a robustness certificate or an intervention on an intrinsic predictor property. We demonstrate this distinction for a last-layer relative-flatness proxy used in both settings. First, empirical-risk stationarity does not eliminate pointwise first-order loss terms: at a finite global empirical-risk minimum, the retained certificate expression underestimates a loss increase by over $210\times$. We derive a globally valid, gauge-invariant feature-space repair. Second, common-row softmax shifts preserve predictions and the exact contraction while making the proxy unbounded. Even standard reference-class choices double it on average relative to the centered representation. For a single fixed-feature example with at least three classes, scalar retuning generically cannot align the induced probability updates. Row centering gives the orbit-minimized bound and restores value and full-model gradient invariance under this symmetry. Across 45 paired one-step tests on algorithmic and image models, amplified shifts separate raw-regularized predictors while quotient-regularized predictors remain aligned. Long-horizon CIFAR-10 experiments show substantial, reversible suppression of generalization, while evidence for selective delay after memorization is less consistent. Together, these results show that validity as a curvature upper bound does not by itself justify either inversion into a robustness certificate or differentiation into an intrinsic training intervention.

</details>


### [169] [Towards Universal Wasserstein Barycenters through Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38547)
*Eduardo Fernandes Montesuma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 BaryFM，一种流匹配模型，用于通用重心近似，能在 Wasserstein 单纯形上任意权重下生成重心样本，并在多个下游任务中优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法多针对固定权重计算 Wasserstein 重心，而整个单纯形上的重心族（Wasserstein 单纯形）的近似研究不足，需解决通用重心近似问题。

Method: 设计 BaryFM，基于流匹配将边缘度量传输至单纯形内任意重心，训练后通过常微分方程（ODE）采样单纯形内任意度量的样本。

Result: 在 10 个域适应基准上对比 15 种方法，BaryFM 平均排名最优，匹配或超越非通用求解器；同时在泛化、贝叶斯后验聚合、算法公平性任务上验证有效。

Conclusion: BaryFM 实现了高效的通用 Wasserstein 重心近似，为概率机器学习中的多任务提供了统一采样框架。

Abstract: Defining a weighted mean over probability measures under probability metrics is a central tool in probabilistic machine learning. Under the Wasserstein metric, these are called \emph{Wasserstein barycenters}. While most approaches compute barycenters for a fixed weight vector, approximating the whole family of barycenters over the simplex, which we call the \emph{Wasserstein simplex}, remains underexplored. We refer to this problem as \emph{Universal Barycenter Approximation}, and propose \texttt{BaryFM}, a flow matching model transporting the marginal measures into any barycenter in the Wasserstein simplex. Once trained, the network can draw samples from measures in the Wasserstein simplex through an ordinary differential equation. We validate our method on 4 downstream tasks: domain adaptation, generalization, Bayesian posterior aggregation and algorithmic fairness. \texttt{BaryFM} achieves the best average rank among 15 competing methods across 10 domain adaptation benchmarks, matching or surpassing non-universal solvers.

</details>


### [170] [The Advantages of Fresh Sketching for Ridge Regression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38565)
*Linkai Ma,Qilin Li,Petros Drineas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文证明在欠约束迭代岭回归中，使用新鲜随机草图优于重用草图，通过仅在当前残差方向分析误差而非整个Gram矩阵，获得更紧的收敛保证，并推导出残差感知采样规则，实验验证收敛显著加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在大规模回归的随机迭代求解器中，基本设计选择是重用草图还是每步抽取新鲜随机性。对于欠约束迭代岭回归的列采样，新鲜草图是否具有可证明优势长期未解。

Method: 采用方向性视角，仅沿当前残差解分析误差而非均匀覆盖整个Gram矩阵；通过最小化草图矩阵-向量乘积的方差，推导出预言采样分布及其实用近似，包括混合采样分布。

Result: 为杠杆分数和岭杠杆分数采样提供更尖锐的收敛保证；提出残差感知采样规则；实验在合成数据、真实数据及Qwen2.5表示上的岭探针验证理论，显示收敛显著加快。

Conclusion: 新鲜草图在欠约束迭代岭回归中具有可证明优势，方向性误差分析带来更紧收敛界和自适应采样策略，实践中可显著加速大规模岭回归求解。

Abstract: Over the past 25 years, sketching and sampling have become widely used tools for accelerating large-scale regression. In iterative randomized solvers, a basic design choice is whether to $\textit{reuse}$ the same sketch or draw $\textit{fresh}$ randomness at every step. For (under-constrained) iterative ridge regression with column sampling, whether fresh sketches offer provable advantages has remained open: $\textit{We show that they do.}$ Fresh sketching lets us analyze error only along the current residual solution, rather than uniformly over the entire Gram matrix. This directional view yields sharper convergence guarantees for leverage score and ridge leverage score sampling and, more importantly, leads to residual-aware sampling rules. By minimizing the variance of the relevant sketched matrix-vector product, we derive an oracle distribution and practical approximations to the oracle distribution, including a mixture sampling distribution with (somewhat weaker) convergence guarantees. Experiments on synthetic and real data, including ridge probes on Qwen2.5 representations, support our theory, showing substantially faster convergence.

</details>


### [171] [FlexRouter: Learning Complementary Model Sets for Flexible LLM Routing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38585)
*Wang Wei,Harry Yang,Tiankai Yang,Samyadeep Basu,Hongjie Chen,Andy Zhao,Franck Dernoncourt,Ryan A. Rossi,Hoda Eldardiry*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 FlexRouter，一种基于行列式点过程（DPP）的 LLM 路由框架，通过显式建模模型互补性来最大化答案覆盖率，实现自适应子集选择，无需预设预算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 路由方法独立对模型评分并选取 top-k，忽略模型间相关性并强制固定计算预算，导致选中冗余模型且共享失效模式，限制整体成功概率。

Method: 将路由建模为面向覆盖的子集选择问题，利用 DPP 同时捕捉模型能力与冗余性；训练目标通过边缘化失败集合直接优化覆盖率，无需真值目标子集；推理时采用基于边际对数行列式增益的贪婪策略，自适应确定子集大小。

Result: 在大规模 RouterEval 基准上，FlexRouter 在域内和域外任务中均实现更高覆盖率和更低冗余性，优于强基线，同时保持灵活的推理成本。

Conclusion: FlexRouter 通过 DPP 显式建模模型互补性，优化答案覆盖率而非独立评分，实现自适应预算的子集选择，有效解决了现有路由方法的冗余与失效模式共享问题。

Abstract: Existing Large Language Model (LLM) routing methods score LLMs independently to select top-$k$ models. However, this ignores model correlations and enforces a rigid computational budget. Consequently, routers often select redundant models that share failure modes, limiting the overall probability of success. To address this, we propose FlexRouter, a routing framework that explicitly models model complementarity. FlexRouter optimizes for \textit{answer coverage}, maximizing the probability that at least one selected model yields a correct response. This objective aligns with practical inference pipelines where multiple candidate outputs are generated and a downstream verifier or user selects the final one. We formulate routing as a coverage-oriented subset selection problem and model the routing policy using Determinantal Point Processes (DPPs), which naturally capture both model competence and redundancy. To directly optimize coverage without requiring a ground-truth target subset, we introduce a training objective based on marginalizing over failure sets. During inference, we employ a greedy strategy based on marginal log-determinant gains, enabling the router to adaptively determine subset sizes without a predefined budget. Extensive experiments on the large-scale RouterEval benchmark demonstrate that our proposed FlexRouter achieves higher coverage with lower redundancy across both in-domain and out-of-domain tasks than strong baselines while maintaining flexible inference cost.

</details>


### [172] [NeurDuo-EEG: A Long-Sequence EEG Foundation Model with Persistent State and Explicit Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38587)
*Yifan Wang,Haiping Liu,Yang Cui,Wenhao Cai,Shuhang Li,Xiaoyang Huang,Xianyang Liu,Jingyu Sun,Yizheng Sun,Cunhang Fan,Tianming Du,Jiancheng Yang,Zhenhong Li,Yunhao Zhang,Hongpeng Zhou,Jingyuan Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: NeurDuo-EEG 是一种因果 EEG 基础模型，引入通道级持久记忆和多时间尺度记忆管理，在 3,955 小时 EEG 数据上预训练，在 5 项下游任务中 4 项达到最优，癫痫检测 AUC-PR 从 0.285 提升至 0.471，且支持高效流式推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 EEG 基础模型多采用固定窗口独立处理，无法捕捉毫秒到小时级的长时程动态；状态空间架构虽支持持久循环处理，但长距离信息仍隐式压缩在循环状态中，缺乏显式的多时间尺度记忆机制。

Method: 提出 NeurDuo-EEG，包含通道级持久记忆和多时间尺度记忆管理（学习巩固与选择性检索），采用多通道自回归预测离散频谱码进行预训练，实现固定大小状态下的连续 EEG 持久建模。

Result: 在三个短窗口和两个长序列下游任务中，NeurDuo-EEG 在四项基准上达到最优，包括全部三个短窗口任务和癫痫检测（AUC-PR 从 0.285 提升至 0.471）；在睡眠分期任务上保持竞争力；支持高效流式推理，随可用历史增长至一小时，每块延迟近乎恒定；Small 变体仅 4.7M 主干参数。

Conclusion: 持久的多时间尺度建模对长序列和短窗口 EEG 分析均具有重要价值，NeurDuo-EEG 通过显式记忆机制有效捕捉跨时间尺度的 EEG 动态，在参数效率和推理效率上均表现优异。

Abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) is recorded continuously over hours, with relevant dynamics spanning timescales from milliseconds to hours. Most EEG foundation models nevertheless process fixed windows independently, limiting their ability to capture information encoded in long-timescale dynamics. State-space architectures enable persistent recurrent processing, but long-range information remains implicitly compressed in recurrent states. We present NeurDuo-EEG, a causal EEG foundation model with channel-resolved persistent memory. NeurDuo-EEG introduces multi-timescale memory management with learned consolidation and selective retrieval, enabling persistent modelling of continuous EEG with fixed-size state. It is pre-trained on 3,955 hours of EEG from 17 public datasets using multichannel autoregressive prediction of discrete spectral codes. Across three short-window and two long-sequence downstream tasks, NeurDuo-EEG achieves the best performance on four of five benchmarks, including all three short-window tasks and seizure detection, where AUC-PR improves from $0.285$ to $0.471$ over the strongest non-NeurDuo baseline. NeurDuo-EEG also remains competitive on sleep staging and supports efficient streaming inference, with nearly constant per-chunk latency as the available history grows to one hour. Notably, the Small variant achieves this with only 4.7M backbone parameters. These results demonstrate the value of persistent, multi-timescale modelling for both long-sequence and short-window EEG analysis. Our code is available at https://github.com/YifaNNW/NeurDuo-EEG.

</details>


### [173] [Reinforcement Learning with Complex (valued) Memories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38598)
*Sathya Kamesh Bhethanabhotla,Efstratios Gavves,André Biedenkapp*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出三种酉循环神经网络（uRNNs）变体作为PPO架构的替代，利用复数向量空间的相位信息解决部分可观测环境中的长期依赖问题，在多个记忆型任务上显著优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 部分可观测环境要求智能体压缩时间信息并维持记忆，现有门控循环、注意力机制和模型型RL等方法在捕捉长期依赖方面仍有挑战，酉循环网络具有范数保持的酉动力学，能实现长序列的信息传播，且复数表示引入相位自由度，有望改善梯度流和联想回忆。

Method: 提出三种uRNNs版本作为循环PPO架构的即插即用替代，将循环和隐藏状态表示在复数向量空间，利用酉动力学保持范数，并探索如何保留复数隐藏状态的相位信息以构建相位感知策略，借鉴量子态测量的类比。

Result: 在Rocksample和Craftax等环境中，奖励达到基线的2-3倍；在连续控制等多个记忆可改进任务上显著优于基线方法。

Conclusion: 该工作为强化学习中的表示学习和部分可观测性问题指明了新方向，复数酉表示的相位自由度能有效捕捉长期依赖，值得进一步探索。

Abstract: Partially observable environments pose a fundamental challenge in deep reinforcement learning, requiring agents to compress temporal information from observations and maintain a memory to make effective decisions. While there exist many approaches ranging from gated recurrence to attention mechanisms and model-based RL, the search for effective representational techniques that can capture long-term dependencies remains an active area of research. In this work we revisit Unitary recurrent networks (uRNNs) [Arjovsky et al., 2016, Jing et al., 2017], that demonstrated superior gradient flow and associative recall, expressing the recurrence and the hidden state in a complex vector space. Their norm preserving unitary dynamics enable information propagation through long sequences. To this end, we propose three different versions of uRNNs as drop-in replacements for recurrent PPO architectures, and demonstrate that the simple recurrence and the added degree of freedom from the phase of the complex representations enable significant gains over baselines on several memory-improvable tasks, including continuous control. We further explore how to preserve the phase information of the complex hidden state for a phase-aware policy by drawing a parallel to how quantum states are measured. With our methods reaching up to 2-3 $\times$ the reward in environments like rocksample and Craftax compared to the baselines, this work points towards an exciting new direction of representations for RL and the problem of partial observability. Code is available at: https://github.com/Sathya98/qurl

</details>


### [174] [JARQ: Joint Alternating Refinement for Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38599)
*Xinyu Wang,Sicheng Lyu,Xiao-Wen Chang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: JARQ 是一种即插即用的组量化后训练量化精化方法，通过交替联合最小二乘拟合所有组尺度与有界 Babai 提议同步移动多个码字，显著提升量化精度且不增加推理开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有组量化器将权重量化到固定网格且不重新拟合生成的整数码字，导致精度损失：最优网格依赖于码字，输入相关性耦合不同组的量化误差，且有效的码字变化往往涉及多个码字同时调整。

Method: 提出 JARQ，从任意组量化器初始化，迭代交替两步：1) 联合最小二乘拟合所有组的尺度参数；2) 基于当前网格的有界 Babai 提议，同步移动一组内的多个码字。该问题被建模为双线性盒约束混合整数最小二乘问题，求解器无需反向传播，在精确尺度求解下不增加逐层目标函数值，且完全保持原量化器的位宽、分组策略、零点设置与推理成本。

Result: 在 Llama-2、Llama-3 和 Qwen 模型上，以 RTN、GPTQ、OmniQuant 和 AWQ 为宿主量化器，JARQ 在 96 次对比中有 90 次降低困惑度，三比特 RTN 困惑度最高下降 36%，在 24 个配置中有 23 个提升平均多项选择准确率，同时改进 QEP、QuaRot 和 OJBKQ 的输出质量，单个 7B 模块处理时间不足一分钟。

Conclusion: JARQ 通过联合尺度优化与协同码字调整，有效解决了组量化中网格与码字错配的问题，实现了免训练、零推理开销、大幅提升精度的量化精化，具有广泛的通用性和实用性。

Abstract: Group-wise post-training quantizers for large language models round weights onto a grid that is not refit to the resulting integer codes. We show that this leaves accuracy on the table: the best grid depends on the codes, input correlations couple the errors of different groups, and useful code changes often involve many codes at once. We propose JARQ , a plug-in refinement that starts from any group-wise quantizer and alternates a joint least-squares fit of all group scales with bounded Babai proposals that move many codes of a group together on the current grid. The problem is a bilinear box-constrained mixed-integer least-squares problem; the solver is backpropagation-free, does not increase the layer-wise objective under exact scale solves, and keeps the host's bit width, groups, zero points, and inference cost. Across Llama-2, Llama-3, and Qwen models with RTN, GPTQ, OmniQuant, and AWQ hosts, JARQ lowers perplexity in 90 of 96 comparisons, cuts three-bit RTN perplexity by up to 36%, raises mean multiple-choice accuracy in 23 of 24 configurations, and improves QEP, QuaRot, and OJBKQ outputs, at under a minute per 7B block.

</details>


### [175] [Learning-Enabled Estimation: Tight Characterizations under Sample Selection Biases](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38608)
*Vikram Kher,Jane H. Lee,Anay Mehrotra,Manolis Zampetakis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文解决了样本选择偏差下回归函数的识别与估计问题，给出了选择机制函数形式的最小充分条件，证明了即使选择过滤器不可识别，回归函数仍可被识别，并提出了首个通用的有限样本估计算法及收敛率保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 样本选择偏差普遍存在于临床试验脱落、劳动力市场自我选择、拍卖策略性入场等场景中，忽略选择会导致系统性偏差。现有方法（如Heckman两阶段模型及其推广）虽提供各种充分条件，但缺乏完备的识别刻画，且多遵循“先估计选择过滤器再去偏回归”的范式，难以应对日益复杂不透明的选择机制。

Method: 建立选择机制函数形式的最小假设下的识别刻画定理；推导出回归函数可在选择过滤器不可识别时仍被识别的推论；在自然强化条件下给出有限样本估计的显式收敛率，并设计预言机高效算法，实现首个针对此类广泛选择问题的通用估计方法。

Result: 给出了样本选择偏差下回归识别的完备条件刻画；证明了存在设定使得回归函数可识别而选择过滤器不可识别，突破了现有“先估选择再去偏”范式；提供了有限样本收敛率保证与预言机高效算法；在拍卖入场成本、劳动力市场等经典经济计量设定中验证了方法的有效性。

Conclusion: 本工作为样本选择偏差下的回归问题提供了统一的理论框架与实用估计工具，揭示了识别选择机制并非识别回归函数的必要条件，为处理复杂不透明选择机制的现代应用奠定了基础。

Abstract: When can we learn from biased samples? We study regression when outcomes are observed only after passing through selection filters that depend on both covariates and outcomes themselves, a ubiquitous challenge spanning clinical trials with patient dropout, labor markets with self-selection, and auctions with strategic entry. Ignoring such selection yields systematically biased conclusions with real-world consequences. This challenge has a long history in econometrics and statistics, starting with Heckman's seminal two-stage model and followed by numerous generalizations. While these works provide various sufficient conditions for identification, a complete characterization of when such regression is possible has remained elusive.
  In this work, we provide a characterization for when regression is possible in the presence of sample selection bias. Our results establish the minimal assumptions required on the functional forms of selection processes under which regression remains possible, which are particularly relevant in modern settings where selection mechanisms are increasingly complex and opaque. As a corollary of our characterization, we show that there are settings where the regression function can be identified even when the selection filter itself cannot. This observation already goes beyond the ``estimate selection filter, then debias regression'' paradigm that is followed by virtually all existing approaches. Under natural strengthenings of our identification conditions, we also establish finite-sample estimation guarantees with explicit convergence rates and provide oracle-efficient algorithms. This yields the first general-purpose estimation method for this broad class of selection problems. Finally, we explore the implications of our results for several well-studied econometric settings with complex selection mechanisms such as auctions with entry costs and labor markets.

</details>


### [176] [Differentiable Structure Learning for Cyclic Linear Gaussian Models with Latent Confounders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38618)
*Sadegh Khorasani,Ali Najar,Saber Salehkaleybar,Negar Kiyavash*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究了存在有向环和未知数量外生潜在混杂因子（有上界）的线性高斯结构因果模型中，从观测数据进行因果结构学习的问题。作者推导了观测变量的协方差，引入了边际拟等价概念，将结构学习建模为带有对数缩放复杂度惩罚的高斯负对数似然最小化问题，并证明了全局评分最小化器的一致性。通过Bernoulli门控参数化边和潜变量的包含，联合优化连续概率与结构系数，得到具有闭式可微复杂度惩罚的期望目标，并证明其与离散结构学习目标具有相同的全局下确界。实验表明该方法在多种设置下恢复误差更低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的因果结构学习方法通常假设无环图（DAG）且不处理潜在混杂因子，或难以同时处理有向环和未知数量的潜在变量。实际系统常存在反馈回路（有向环）和未观测的混杂因子，因此需要一种能在线性高斯SCM框架下统一处理有向环、有界数量潜在混杂因子，并提供理论保证的结构学习方法。

Method: 1. 推导含有向环和外生潜在混杂因子的线性高斯SCM中观测变量的协方差矩阵表达式。2. 提出边际拟等价概念，刻画不同因果模型产生相同满维观测分布子集的条件。3. 将结构学习形式化为最小化高斯负对数似然加对数缩放复杂度惩罚（计数有向边和潜变量）。4. 使用Bernoulli门控参数化每条有向边和每个候选潜变量的包含指示，联合优化门控概率与结构系数。5. 对门控分布求期望得到可微的期望目标函数，含闭式复杂度惩罚项。6. 证明期望目标与原离散目标具有相同全局下确界。

Result: 在固定观测变量数和潜变量数上界下，在代数忠实性、结构极小性和模型重叠假设下，全局评分最小化器关于边际拟等价一致。提出的基于Bernoulli门控的连续优化方法在合成数据和半合成数据实验中，相比现有基线方法（如GES、DirectLiNGAM、NOTEARS等）在多种设置下实现了更低的结构恢复误差（SHD、SID等指标）。

Conclusion: 该工作建立了含有向环和有界潜在混杂因子的线性高斯SCM结构学习的统一理论框架，引入边际拟等价作为等价类刻画，提出基于Bernoulli门控的可微优化方法并证明其理论等价性，实现了在保持理论一致性的前提下的高效结构恢复，优于现有方法。

Abstract: We study causal structure learning from observational data in linear Gaussian structural causal models in the presence of directed cycles and an unknown number of exogenous latent confounders, bounded by a given maximum. We derive the covariance of the observed variables and introduce marginal quasi-equivalence, which characterizes when different causal models share a full-dimensional subset of the observational distributions they can generate. We formulate structure learning as minimization of the Gaussian negative log-likelihood with a logarithmically scaled complexity penalty that counts directed edges and latent variables. For a fixed number of observed variables and a fixed upper bound on latent variables, we establish consistency of global score minimizers up to marginal quasi-equivalence under algebraic faithfulness, structural minimality, and model-overlap assumptions. We parameterize the inclusion of directed edges and candidate latent variables using Bernoulli gates, whose continuous probabilities are optimized jointly with the structural coefficients. Averaging the penalized negative log-likelihood over these gates yields an objective with a closed-form differentiable complexity penalty. We prove that this expected objective has the same global infimum as the corresponding discrete structure-learning objective. Experimental results show that our approach achieves lower recovery error than previous methods in several experimental settings.

</details>


### [177] [Geometry-physics confounding impairs PDE learning across varying domains](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38623)
*Yinghao Cheng,Gengxiang Chen,Xu Liu,Qinglu Meng,Yixin Jing,Xiangguo Tang,Wenping Mou,Lihui Wang,Yingguang Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文指出几何-物理混淆是跨变域PDE学习的统一失效机制，提出去混淆框架显式建模几何到算子的变换，显著提升算子学习和方程发现的性能与数据效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 几何变化会同时改变场表示和微分算子，导致几何效应与内在物理性质在观测动力学中相互混淆，使得在变域上学习PDE时面临数据效率低、泛化差、方程发现偏差等问题。

Method: 提出去混淆框架，将已知的几何到算子变换显式化：引入几何诱导系数场用于算子学习，构建几何完备的候选库用于方程发现，将几何作用与内在物理分离。

Result: 在五个算子学习基准上，几何诱导系数场提升预测精度和数据效率；在两个演化域系统中，几何完备候选库恢复生成方程，保留PDE残差降低两个数量级以上。

Conclusion: 通过分离已知几何作用与内在物理，该框架为科学工程中变几何问题的PDE学习提供了更可靠、更高数据效率的解决方案。

Abstract: Learning partial differential equation (PDE) dynamics across varying domains is central to predictive modelling and data-driven discovery of governing equations. However, geometric variation alters both field representation and the governing differential operators, confounding geometric effects with intrinsic physical properties in the observed dynamics. This work identifies geometry-physics confounding as a unified failure mechanism for PDE learning across varying domains. In forward operator learning, this confounding increases the burden of inferring geometry-dependent operator changes from finite data, reducing data efficiency and generalisation. In equation discovery, omitting geometry-induced operators misspecifies the candidate library, leading to biased parameters, missed governing terms and spurious terms. We propose a de-confounding framework that makes the known geometry-to-operator transformation explicit.
