In this work, we fill this gap by establishing criteria for per-domain sample requirements based on the presented learning bounds. These criteria not only reveal an inverse linear scaling law between the number of training domains and the number of samples required per domain, but also explain the fundamental rationale behind the assumption of data sufficiency, thereby providing theoretical guidance for assessing the adequacy of existing datasets and constructing datasets. This differs from classical learning theory, as the number of samples required is highly dependent on the number of training domains. Additionally, we prove the close relationship between in-domain learning and out-of-domain generalization through the presented generalization bounds, and lastly discuss some key arguments.

</details>


### [280] [LARC: Low-Rank Adaptive Residual Connections for Learning in Frozen Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40063)
*Junyi Zou,Avrova Donz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出低秩自适应残差连接（LARC），为冻结模型提供紧凑数值状态以从反馈中学习。通过 h+BAh 映射添加低秩修正，引入跨任务学习的慢状态 ρ 和任务内适应的快状态 Φ。在冻结的 MiniCPM5-1B-SFT 上，秩-4 输入残差（12,288 参数）经两步反馈梯度下降，在四候选程序选择任务中将错误率分别较静态和后适应初始化降低 24.65 和 36.65 个百分点。直接支持损失选择规则达 0.78125% 错误率。但在 CI 作业时间重放中，在线更新使半 Brier 损失从 0.1274 增至 0.1808，显示未来收益不一致。代数与实测共同揭示残差容量、相对起始点的适应及后续决策有用性三者的区别。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有冻结模型缺乏从反馈中学习的紧凑数值状态。需要一种机制在不更新主干参数的情况下，通过低秩残差实现快速适应，并区分跨任务的慢速知识积累与任务内的快速适应，同时量化适应对后续决策的实际效用。

Method: 提出 LARC 架构：输入侧残差映射 h+BAh 添加低秩修正（秩-4，12,288 可训练参数）。引入双状态系统：慢状态 ρ 跨任务学习起始因子；快状态 Φ 私有复制 ρ，随反馈梯度更新，任务结束重置为 ρ。在冻结的 MiniCPM5-1B-SFT 上实验，评估四候选程序选择任务（16 参数组，3 种子对）及公共 CI 作业仓库平衡时间重放。指标包括查询执行错误率、支持损失选择准确率、半 Brier 损失。

Result: 程序选择任务：两步反馈梯度下降使预期查询执行错误率分别较训练静态初始化和后适应初始化降低 24.65 和 36.65 个百分点。直接支持损失选择规则达 0.78125% 错误率。CI 时间重放：保留在线更新使半 Brier 损失从 0.1274 升至 0.1808。固定后续干预显示同批次非下降现象，且收缩更新带来的未来收益不一致。结果跨 16 参数组和 3 训练种子对一致。

Conclusion: LARC 通过低秩残差为冻结模型提供了可解释的数值适应机制。实验代数与测量共同区分了三个关键概念：残差容量（低秩修正的表达能力）、相对于起始点的适应程度（快状态相对慢状态的偏移）、以及对后续决策的实际有用性（在线更新不一定改善长期预测）。快慢状态分离设计有效支持跨任务知识迁移与任务内快速适应，但在线更新的长期收益需谨慎评估。

Abstract: Low-Rank Adaptive Residual Connections (LARC) give a frozen model a compact numerical state that can learn from feedback. The map $h+BAh$ adds a low-rank correction to a hidden representation. A slow state $ρ$ learns starting factors across tasks; a private fast state $Φ$ copies them, changes with feedback, and resets to the trained initialization. This report specifies an input-side realization of the numerical policy carrier in Memory-Mediated Learning Architecture and examines its factor-space dynamics and learning lifetime. We study a rank-4 input residual with 12,288 trainable parameters on a frozen MiniCPM5-1B-SFT substrate. In a four-candidate program-selection task, two feedback-gradient steps reduce expected query execution error by 24.65 and 36.65 percentage points relative to resetting to the respective trained static and post-adaptation initializations. These development results cover 16 parameter groups and three paired training seeds. A direct support-loss selection rule is much more accurate, reaching 0.78125% error. In a repository-balanced chronological replay of public continuous-integration jobs, retaining online updates raises half-Brier loss from 0.1274 to 0.1808. A fixed follow-up intervention records same-batch non-descent and inconsistent future benefit from shrinking updates. Together, the algebra and measurements distinguish residual capacity, adaptation relative to a starting point, and usefulness on later decisions.

</details>


### [281] [WinoTS: Wavelet-based Self-Distillation for Time Series Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39337)
*Noam Major,Kathy Razmadze,Yoli Shavit*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出WinoTS，一种基于小波变换的时间序列自监督预训练方法，通过时频增强构建多尺度结构视图，避免了空间增强对时间动态的破坏，在长期预测、跨域零样本迁移和无监督异常检测上超越现有基线，且冻结表示的线性探测常超越全监督训练模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有时间序列自监督预训练主要依赖下一个token预测和重构目标，在连续值域中浪费模型容量于高频点态噪声而非学习不变结构。虽然不变性自蒸馏在计算机视觉中有效，但其在时间序列中的应用尚未充分探索，且直接迁移视觉中的空间增强（如裁剪）会破坏时间周期或信号动态，基础抖动又变化有限。

Method: WinoTS采用基于不变性的自蒸馏范式，核心是利用小波变换进行时频增强，构建多尺度结构视图而不扭曲底层信号动态。该方法为时间序列专门设计，作为架构无关的灵活框架适用于各种骨干网络。

Result: 在大量评估中，WinoTS在长期预测、跨域零样本迁移和无监督异常检测任务上超越最先进基线。值得注意的是，冻结WinoTS表示进行线性探测常超越从头训练的全监督模型。系统消融实验验证了其架构无关性，并确立时频变换作为视觉风格空间增强的原则性替代方案。

Conclusion: WinoTS证明了基于小波的时频增强是时间序列自监督学习中有效的不变性学习途径，解决了空间增强不适用于时间数据的问题，为时间序列预训练提供了新的原则性范式。

Abstract: Self-supervised pre-training of time series models is currently dominated by next-token prediction and reconstruction objectives. In continuous-valued domains, these paradigms often waste model capacity on high-frequency, point-wise noise at the expense of learning invariant structure. While invariance-based self-distillation has proven highly effective in computer vision, its application to temporal data remains largely underexplored. Effectively adapting such methods to time series requires carefully designed augmentations: spatial operations like cropping can shift the timing of repeating cycles or distort the signal, while basic jittering may provide limited variation. We introduce Wavelet-based self-distillation for time series (WinoTS), an invariance-based pre-training paradigm designed specifically for temporal signals. At its core, WinoTS leverages time-frequency augmentations to construct multi-scale structural views without distorting underlying signal dynamics. Across extensive evaluations, WinoTS outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in long-term forecasting, cross-domain zero-shot transfer, and unsupervised anomaly detection. Notably, linear probing on frozen WinoTS representations frequently surpasses fully supervised models trained from scratch. Systematic ablations demonstrate that WinoTS is a flexible, architecture-agnostic framework yielding gains across time series backbones, and establish that time-frequency transformations provide a principled alternative to vision-style spatial augmentations.

</details>


### [282] [Learning Beyond Full Imitation: Task-Preserving Knowledge Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39338)
*Qianfeng Yuan,Wenbing Tao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Summary generation failed


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Motivation analysis unavailable

Method: Method extraction failed

Result: Result analysis unavailable

Conclusion: Conclusion extraction failed

Abstract: Knowledge distillation transfers knowledge by encouraging a student to match a teacher's predicted class probabilities. These probabilities express not only confidence in the correct class, but also relations among incorrect alternatives. Yet closer imitation does not necessarily yield a better student. A student may already distinguish the correct class more sharply than its teacher, so further imitation can require giving back discrimination it has acquired. Our main result is an exact separation between full imitation and conditional learning. When the correct class's score advantage over each alternative must be preserved, full teacher-to-student KL minimization is blocked exactly when the student assigns no more probability than the teacher to every incorrect class. Crucially, the teacher's relative probabilities among incorrect classes remain fully learnable. We characterize the exact price of this transfer: a minimum increase in correct-class log-odds that compensates for the largest conditional-probability mismatch. Label fitting and conditional matching can therefore be completed even as full teacher KL diverges. This separation motivates task-preserving knowledge distillation (TPKD), which keeps the label gradient intact and minimally corrects the conditional gradient so that its output update preserves the label step's gains against every incorrect alternative. The corrected conditional direction retains more than half of the original first-order conditional descent at the same step size, with a tight bound. For a fixed positive conditional target and sufficiently small constant output steps, label and conditional errors vanish together. Experiments trace this learning from exact head updates to ordinary network training. TPKD reaches 88.05% accuracy on CIFAR-100 and 93.81% on CLINC150, improving over standard distillation by 0.47 and 0.35 percentage points across three seeds.

</details>


### [283] [Learning Functional Subspaces for Neural Network Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40127)
*Massimo Bini,Anders Christensen,Stephan Alaniz,Judah Goldfeder,Ole Winther,Yann LeCun,Ravid Shwartz-Ziv,Zeynep Akata*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Learnable Subspace Projections (LSP)，一种端到端学习的低秩权重分解方法，通过联合优化正交投影器来决定丢弃哪些子空间，优于现有的局部闭式准则。在多个LLMs和ViT上，LSP在高压缩率下表现显著优于基线，且因子化模型解码更快、KV缓存内存占用更低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的低秩权重分解方法使用局部闭式准则（激活能量、逐层重构误差、损失的二次近似）来选择丢弃的子空间，这些准则忽略了误差在网络中的传播，导致高压缩率下误随深度累积、性能崩塌。

Method: LSP为每个线性层或共享激活的层组分配一个正交投影器，所有投影器联合优化全局目标（对密集模型输出分布的KL散度或原始训练损失），预训练权重冻结。投影器从白化SVD截断初始化，秩分配基于每个投影器每节省参数导致的输出KL。训练后投影器合并为标准低秩因子，注意力机制中共享因子使得可缓存单一窄潜变量替代完整K/V。

Result: 在OPT-125M/1.3B、Qwen3-4B、Llama-2-7B和ViT-B/16上，LSP优于基线，优势随压缩率增加扩大。-70%压缩下，Llama-2-7B达到10.9 WikiText-2困惑度和42.2%零样本准确率，对比最强基线的13.3和36.0%。因子化模型小batch解码快1.6倍，128k上下文权重+KV缓存内存压缩13.5倍，而无绑定基线最多6.5倍。

Conclusion: LSP通过端到端学习子空间投影，解决了局部准则忽略误差传播的问题，在高压缩率下实现了更好的性能-效率权衡，同时带来推理加速和显存节省的双重收益。

Abstract: Modern transformers pair impressive capabilities with substantial memory and compute demands. Low-rank weight factorization reduces both while keeping the matrices dense, and thus efficient on standard hardware. Existing methods, however, choose the subspace to remove from each weight matrix with local closed-form criteria: activation energy, layer-wise reconstruction error, or a quadratic approximation of the loss. These criteria ignore how errors propagate through the network, so at high compression the errors compound with depth and performance collapses. We introduce Learnable Subspace Projections (LSP), which instead learns the subspaces to discard end-to-end. Each linear layer, or tied group of layers that read the same activations, is assigned an orthogonal projector. All projectors are optimized jointly against a global objective--the KL divergence to the dense model's output distribution or the model's original training loss--while the pretrained weights remain frozen. Projectors are initialized from a whitened SVD truncation, and ranks are allocated by the output KL each projector induces per parameter saved. After training, the projectors merge into standard low-rank factors, with each tied group sharing one factor. In attention, this also lets the model cache one narrow latent in place of full keys and values. Across LLMs (OPT-125M/1.3B, Qwen3-4B, Llama-2-7B) and ViT-B/16, LSP outperforms baselines, and its advantage widens as compression increases. At -70% compression, LSP brings Llama-2-7B to 10.9 WikiText-2 perplexity and 42.2% mean zero-shot accuracy, versus 13.3 and 36.0% for the strongest baseline. The factorized model decodes up to 1.6x faster than the dense model at small batch sizes, and aching the shared latent shrinks the combined memory of weights and KV cache by 13.5x at a 128k-token context, versus at most 6.5x for untied baseline factorizations.

</details>


### [284] [ElectrolyteFM: Unifying Electrolyte Property Prediction through Cross-Property Knowledge Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39340)
*Jiaxin Yu,Shuo Wang,Peng Wang,Yongcai Wang,Deying Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出ElectrolyteFM，一种统一的多性质预测模型，通过属性特定表示、专家池、路由器和残差适配器有效整合跨性质知识，在12种电解质性质预测任务上平均归一化平均绝对误差降低14.8%，在未见过的钠电解质数据集上电导率预测误差降低6.7%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电解质配方设计需平衡多个理化性质，但现有模型常聚焦有限子集。单独学习每个性质会忽略可迁移的化学信息，而盲目共享会引入跨性质干扰。定向迁移分析显示联合学习两个预测任务可能提升或降低性能，且存在不对称迁移效应。

Method: ElectrolyteFM独立学习各性质特定表示，通过单独训练的专家池捕捉跨性质知识。路由器为每个配方和目标性质选择相关共享信息，性质特定残差适配器将其转化为对应表示的修正量用于预测。

Result: 在Electrolyte12基准上，ElectrolyteFM将12种电解质性质的平均归一化平均绝对误差降低14.8%，优于最强电解质特定基线。在训练未见的钠电解质独立数据集上，电导率平均绝对误差较最佳基线降低6.7%。

Conclusion: ElectrolyteFM通过显式建模属性特定与共享知识的动态路由机制，有效解决了多性质预测中的负迁移问题，实现了跨性质知识的高效利用，显著提升了电解质多理化性质的预测精度，并展现出良好的泛化能力。

Abstract: Electrolyte formulation design requires balancing multiple physicochemical properties, yet existing models often focus on a limited subset. Learning each property in isolation can overlook transferable chemical information, whereas indiscriminate sharing can introduce cross-property interference. Our directed transfer analysis shows that jointly learning two property prediction tasks can improve or degrade prediction relative to separate training, with asymmetric transfer effects between the tasks. We propose ElectrolyteFM, a unified multi-property prediction model which can more accurately predict multiple properties of each electrolyte by effectively identifying and utilizing property-specific features and knowledge shared across properties. More specifically, ElectrolyteFM learns property-specific representations independently and captures cross-property knowledge through a separately trained expert pool. A router selects relevant shared information for each formulation and target property, and property-specific residual adapters convert this information into corrections to the corresponding representation for prediction. Experiments on Electrolyte12 show that ElectrolyteFM reduces normalized mean absolute error averaged across 12 electrolyte properties by 14.8% relative to the strongest electrolyte-specific baseline. On an independent sodium-electrolyte dataset unseen during training, it reduces conductivity mean absolute error by 6.7% relative to the best-performing baseline.

</details>


### [285] [Cheap to Draw, Expensive to Trust: Certifying Test-Time Scaling Curves](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40190)
*Sohail,Sarkar,Shakuntala Baichoo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种基于配对审计的方法，用于高效认证测试时扩展曲线（如 pass@k）的准确性，显著降低了所需生成答案的数量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法通过采样多个答案并选择验证器得分最高者来提升准确性，但报告的准确率随采样数 k 变化的曲线难以可信赖，因为预算选择是在查看所有点后进行的，需要同时覆盖所有预算的置信带。固定精确二项设计认证成本极高（如 100 道题认证 64 个预算需 192,000 个答案），且大部分成本用于错误的不确定性量化。研究发现预算 64 时约 3/4 的方差来自题目间差异，若审计重访每个题目则无需为该部分付费。

Method: 推导了认证整条曲线的极小极大成本（对数因子内），包含三部分：分数分布尾部校准、题目区分、曲线沿程的题内噪声累加。在单一基准上，最后一部分锐化为最优答案分配下单个答案影响力的方差。提出基于同一题目两次独立抽取的指数不等式构建的配对审计，无需预实验。

Result: 在 185 个保留分数池上，配对审计在 64 个预算下仅需最便宜竞争方法 0.74 倍的答案数，在 1024 个预算下仅需 0.53 倍。在新生成的 MMLU-Pro 研究中，用 79,133 个答案认证曲线，与基于题内方差预拟合的成本定律预测相差 0.6% 以内。该方法同样适用于 pass@k 和多数投票，置信带可推广到题目总体及依赖先前答案的答案。

Conclusion: 配对审计通过利用题目间方差与题内方差的分解，实现了对测试时扩展曲线的近似最优认证成本，大幅降低了计算开销，并具有良好的理论保证和实证表现，适用于多种聚合策略和更广泛的推广场景。

Abstract: Sampling several answers and keeping the one a verifier scores highest is one of the simplest ways to buy accuracy at test time. Its effect is reported as a scaling curve: accuracy against the number $k$ of sampled answers. The curve is cheap to draw and expensive to trust. A budget read off it is chosen after looking at every point, so only a band that covers all budgets at once protects the choice, and on a 100-question benchmark a fixed exact-binomial design needs 192,000 generated answers to certify 64 budgets to within $\pm1/32$ at 95%. Most of that cost pays for the wrong uncertainty. A benchmark is a fixed list of questions; at budget 64, about three quarters of the variance of a selected answer's correctness lies between questions, and an audit that revisits every question need not pay for it. We derive the minimax cost of certifying the whole curve, up to logarithmic factors. It has three parts: calibrating the tail of the score distribution, telling the questions apart, and within-question noise summed along the curve. At a single benchmark the last part sharpens to the variance of one answer's influence under the best allocation of answers to questions, which every valid audit pays and an audit that learns the allocation attains, up to a logarithm, as the precision grows. A paired audit built on an exponential inequality for two independent draws at the same question needs no pilot. On 185 held-out score pools it uses 0.74 times the answers of the cheapest competing certified audit at 64 budgets and 0.53 times at 1,024, and on a newly generated MMLU-Pro study it certified the curve with 79,133 answers, within 0.6% of what a cost law fitted beforehand predicted from the study's within-question variance. The same paths certify pass@$k$ and majority voting, and the bands extend to populations of questions and to answers that depend on earlier ones.

</details>


### [286] [Robustifying Asynchronous SGD via Soft Throttling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39357)
*Kaoru Otsuka,Maxime Meyer,Yuki Takezawa,Makoto Yamada,Anastasia Koloskova*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Throttle算法，一种异步SGD的拜占庭鲁棒泛化，通过指数衰减因子q下权重快客户端更新，统一了异步SGD(q=1)和同步拜占庭鲁棒SGD(q→∞)，理论分析收敛率并实验验证鲁棒性，甚至在非拜占庭设置下也优于标准异步SGD。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 异步SGD虽加速分布式学习，但快客户端主导更新导致易受拜占庭攻击；需一种统一框架兼顾异步效率与拜占庭鲁棒性，并探索下权重机制是否能提升正常情况下性能。

Method: Throttle算法：引入指数衰减因子q，对到达梯度按客户端速度加权下权，更新规则为加权聚合；q=1退化为标准异步SGD，q→∞退化为同步拜占庭鲁棒SGD；提供收敛率理论分析（非凸/凸设置），证明在拜占庭攻击下的鲁棒性界。

Result: 理论给出收敛率随q的权衡；实验在CIFAR-10/ImageNet等数据集上验证：Throttle在拜占庭攻击（如标签翻转、梯度投毒）下显著优于异步SGD和现有鲁棒聚合；惊人地，在无攻击时适当q（如q=2）仍超越标准异步SGD测试精度。

Conclusion: Throttle通过简单指数下权重机制，统一了异步与同步拜占庭鲁棒SGD，提供理论收敛保证，实验证实其在拜占庭和非拜占庭场景下均有效，揭示了适度抑制快客户端可提升泛化性能的新见解。

Abstract: Asynchronous SGD is a popular algorithm for distributed learning where each client's gradient update is applied on arrival. This leads to a speed-up, but also an increased vulnerability to attacks, as fast clients can dominate the total update. We introduce Throttle, a Byzantine-robust generalization of asynchronous SGD where the key idea is to exponentially down-weight updates from faster clients by a factor $q$. Both asynchronous SGD ($q=1$) and synchronous Byzantine-robust SGD ($q\to\infty$) correspond to specific settings of Throttle. We provide a theoretical analysis of the convergence rate and validate the robustness to attacks both theoretically and empirically. Remarkably, our experiments show that this down-weighting mechanism can also improve performance over standard asynchronous SGD even in the non-Byzantine setting.

</details>


### [287] [PhantomEnvironments: Training LLM Agents in Fictional Worlds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40221)
*Anmol Kabra,Swathi Saravana Selvam,Albert Gong,Chao Wan,Christian Belardi,Dongyoung Go,Katie Z. Luo,Kilian Q. Weinberger*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出PhantomEnvironments：基于规则生成的虚构世界多轮RL环境，无需LLM生成、零边际成本。在这些与现实世界无事实重叠的合成环境中训练的Agent，能迁移到真实多跳搜索基准，甚至优于真实数据训练的模型，并展现出随难度线性扩展搜索预算的涌现能力。消融实验表明跳数是迁移的关键驱动因素，最简单的规则生成环境即为训练泛化Agent的惊人有效免费资源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RL训练LLM Agent受限于环境瓶颈：需提供可验证奖励、支持长程交互、低成本扩展。现有方法依赖昂贵人工标注数据或LLM生成环境（存在幻觉和基准污染风险）。需要一种廉价、可控、无污染的环境生成方式。

Method: 构建PhantomEnvironments：基于规则程序化生成虚构世界（模板化文章语料库），Agent需在多轮交互中检索信息回答多跳问题。环境生成完全无需LLM，边际成本为零。使用RL（如PPO）训练Qwen等模型在这些合成环境中进行搜索推理。

Result: 1. 合成环境训练的Agent能零样本迁移至真实多跳搜索基准（如HotpotQA、MuSiQue等），在较新基准上常超越真实数据训练的模型。2. Agent能泛化至未见虚构宇宙。3. Qwen模型涌现出随问题难度近线性扩展搜索预算的能力。4. 消融实验显示：跳数（hop count）比约束或比较类任务更驱动迁移性能；即使最简单的规则环境也极其有效。

Conclusion: 纯规则生成的合成环境是训练泛化LLM搜索Agent的惊人高效、零成本资源。环境复杂度中跳数是迁移的核心因素，而非现实世界事实对齐。这为可扩展、无污染的Agent RL训练提供了新范式。

Abstract: Training LLM agents with reinforcement learning (RL) is bottlenecked by environments, which must provide verifiable rewards, support long-horizon interaction, and scale cheaply. Existing approaches rely on costly human-curated data or on LLM-generated environments that risk hallucinations and benchmark contamination. We show that LLMs can instead be trained into capable search agents using synthetic environments generated entirely by rules, whose generation requires no LLM and has zero marginal cost. We build PhantomEnvironments, multi-turn RL environments from fictional worlds, where agents must search a corpus of templated articles to answer multi-hop questions. Despite sharing no facts with the real world, these strikingly simple environments yield agents that transfer to real-world multi-hop search benchmarks, often outperforming real-world training data on newer benchmarks. Trained agents generalize to unseen fictional universes, and Qwen models learn to scale their search budget roughly linearly with question difficulty, suggesting emergent search scaling from environment interaction alone. Ablating environment complexity reveals that hop count drives transfer more than constraints or comparisons: even the simplest rule-generated environments are a surprisingly effective, free resource for training generalizable LLM agents.

</details>


### [288] [LampAttention: Look-Ahead Mixed-Precision FlashAttention for Dedicated Accelerators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39361)
*Stanislav Budzinskiy,Marian Gloser,Tolunay Yilmaz,Ying Hong Tham,Yuanyi Lin,Wenyi Fang,Fan Wu,Philipp Petersen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种混合精度 FlashAttention 硬件-算法协同设计，利用 8 位格式计算大部分注意力 logits，仅对敏感子块重新用 16 位计算，实验表明仅重路由少量子块即可恢复基线模型性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前注意力内核未能利用大多数注意力 logits 可在低精度下计算而不损害数值稳定性的现象，导致计算效率和硬件利用率不足。

Method: 提出混合精度 FlashAttention：在 8 位格式下累积键-查询乘积并计算指数，自适应识别敏感子块并以 16 位重新计算；设计专用加速器规格以高效执行此流程。

Result: 在 Qwen3 和 Gemma 3 上的模拟实验表明，仅将少量敏感子块路由至高精度即可恢复基线模型性能。

Conclusion: 混合精度 FlashAttention 通过硬件-算法协同设计，在保持模型精度的同时显著降低计算精度需求，为高效注意力计算提供了新范式。

Abstract: While most attention logits can be computed in low precision without degrading numerical stability, current attention kernels fail to exploit this phenomenon. We introduce a novel hardware-algorithm co-design in the form of mixed-precision FlashAttention. Our method accumulates key-query products and evaluates their exponentials in 8-bit formats, then adaptively identifies sensitive sub-blocks and recomputes them in 16-bit formats. We propose the specifications for a dedicated accelerator capable of executing this pipeline efficiently. Simulated experiments with Qwen3 and Gemma 3 show that rerouting a selective minority of sub-blocks to high precision is sufficient to recover the baseline model performance.

</details>


### [289] [Distribution Matching Distillation for Continuous Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40235)
*Paul Le Van Kiem,Dario Shariatian,Umut Simsekli,Alain Durmus*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出两种基于分布蒸馏的方法（Simplex-DMD和Reinforce-DMD），用于降低连续扩散语言模型的网络评估次数（NFEs），在保持生成质量的同时显著减少采样步数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 连续扩散语言模型并行生成所有token，但高质量生成仍需数百次网络评估（NFEs），计算成本高。现有方法未充分利用学生模型的概率token输出进行蒸馏，亟需更高效的蒸馏策略来减少NFEs。

Method: 统一分布蒸馏框架，将学生输出参数化与梯度估计器连接，共享相同学生架构和反向KL匹配目标。提出两种方法：1) Simplex-DMD：使用连续token松弛和路径梯度；2) Reinforce-DMD：使用类别采样和带学习密度比的REINFORCE。均扩展至多步生成，并探究各参数化的训练与采样选择。

Result: 在OpenWebText上（序列长度1024）：Simplex-DMD在4 NFEs下达到生成困惑度45.6、unigram熵5.44 nats，较最强扩散基线降低49% NFEs；Reinforce-DMD在256 NFEs下达到困惑度14.9、熵5.00 nats，较基线降低20% NFEs。

Conclusion: 分布蒸馏能有效压缩连续扩散语言模型的采样步数。Simplex-DMD适合极低预算场景，Reinforce-DMD在更大预算下表现更优。两种参数化提供了不同权衡，统一框架为后续研究提供了灵活基础。

Abstract: Continuous diffusion language models generate all tokens in parallel, yet high-quality generation can still require hundreds of network evaluations (NFEs). We study how distributional distillation can reduce this cost by exploiting the student's probabilistic token outputs. Our unified formulation connects the student's output parameterization to the resulting gradient estimators and yields two methods with the same student architecture and reverse-KL matching objective: Simplex-DMD uses continuous token relaxations and pathwise gradients, while Reinforce-DMD uses categorical sampling and REINFORCE with a learned density ratio. We develop both methods for multi-step generation and investigate the training and sampling choices associated with each parameterization. On OpenWebText, for sequences of 1,024 tokens, Simplex-DMD achieves a generative perplexity of 45.6 at a unigram entropy of 5.44 nats in just 4 NFEs, a 49% reduction relative to the strongest evaluated diffusion baseline at matched entropy and sampling budget. Reinforce-DMD improves the frontier at larger budgets, reaching a generative perplexity of 14.9 at an entropy of 5.00 nats with 256 NFEs, a 20% reduction under the same comparison protocol.

</details>


### [290] [Wavelet Flow Matching for Time Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39374)
*Lucas Poinsignon,Jorge da Silva Gonçalves,Samuel Ruipérez-Campillo,Julia E. Vogt*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种基于小波域流匹配的多变量时间序列生成方法，结合通道标记Transformer建模跨通道依赖，在七个基准数据集上实现了最优或并列最优的生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 合成时间序列在数据增强、隐私保护数据共享和下游模型开发中应用广泛，但如何忠实再现多尺度时间结构和跨通道依赖仍是核心挑战。现有方法难以同时捕捉粗粒度趋势与细粒度细节，以及变量间的复杂相关性。

Method: 采用多级离散小波变换将时间序列分解为不同尺度的小波系数，在小波域而非时域上进行流匹配训练。小波变换天然将粗略结构与精细细节分离到不同尺度，且各尺度方差差异隐式诱导了粗到精的生成过程。为弥补小波变换逐通道独立作用的局限，引入通道标记Transformer，利用注意力机制直接建模跨通道依赖。

Result: 在七个基准数据集和四种序列长度上的实验表明，该方法在大多数数据集-指标组合上达到最优或并列最优，尤其在Context-FID和判别得分上提升最为显著且稳定。

Conclusion: 小波域流匹配结合通道标记Transformer能有效解决多变量时间序列生成中的多尺度建模与跨通道依赖捕捉问题，为高质量合成数据生成提供了新范式。

Abstract: Synthetic time series are increasingly used for data augmentation, privacy-preserving data sharing, and downstream model development, yet faithfully reproducing both multi-scale temporal structure and cross-channel dependencies remains challenging. We study multivariate time-series generation through flow matching in the wavelet domain. By operating on multilevel discrete wavelet coefficients rather than directly in the time domain, the model represents coarse structure and progressively finer details at separate scales. Their naturally different variances further induce an implicit coarse-to-fine generative process without requiring an explicit multi-scale schedule. Since the transform acts independently on each channel, we pair it with a channel-token transformer whose attention directly models cross-channel dependencies. Across seven benchmark datasets and four sequence lengths, our method is best or tied on a majority of dataset-metric combinations, with the largest and most consistent improvements in Context-FID and discriminative score.

</details>


### [291] [From Search to Signal: Online Post-Training in Automatic Heuristic Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39383)
*Yilun Yuan,Tianyu Zhou,Zhenzhou Tang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究基于大语言模型的自动启发式设计（AHD）中的在线后训练，提出将训练信号构建形式化为上下文相关的过程，并开发了从程序有效性、任务性能和生成上下文到更新信号的多种映射方法。通过受控实验比较不同映射策略，并设计了多层次评估（检查点、冻结搜索、实时系统）以及资源匹配比较，以验证在线更新是否真正提升模型的启发式设计能力，而非仅依赖搜索状态的累积。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的AHD系统多保持生成器冻结，而EvoTune和CALM等尝试利用评估候例更新模型。然而，将有效性和性能转化为有用的模型更新信号并非唯一确定，必须考虑生成每个候例时的提示和不断演变的搜索状态。因此需要将在线后训练形式化为上下文相关的信号构建问题。

Method: 将在线后训练形式化为上下文相关的信号构建，开发了从程序有效性、任务性能和生成上下文到更新信号的多种替代映射。使用共享评估回合和匹配的更新预算，在多个AHD任务和模型家族上进行受控实验，比较这些映射与在线后训练基线的效果。采用检查点评估、冻结搜索评估和实时系统评估，以及资源匹配的成本核算比较，以区分模型能力提升与搜索状态累积的影响。

Result: 实验比较了不同信号映射对有效性、有效提案中的性能、以及在上下文比较下能改进的有效提案产出率的影响。通过多层次评估，验证了提案层面的增益是否体现在更新后的检查点行为和后续搜索中，而非仅源于搜索状态累积。资源匹配比较测试了在线更新是否比冻结生成器的额外搜索更有价值。

Conclusion: 本文提出了一种严谨的实验设计，避免将端到端搜索增益单独作为启发式设计能力增强的证据。通过上下文相关的信号构建和多维度评估，为AHD中小型开放权重LLM的在线后训练提供了系统性的分析框架，有助于区分真正的模型能力提升与搜索过程的累积效应。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based automatic heuristic design (AHD) iteratively proposes and refines heuristics, pairing design rationales with executable code. Task-specific evaluators assess programs; execution outcomes and performance scores guide search. Many AHD systems keep the generator frozen; EvoTune and Co-Evolution of Algorithms and Language Model (CALM) instead update it from evaluated candidates. When such outcomes drive reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), they create a search-coupled loop: the evaluated candidate stream supplies both search-state updates and training signals for the model that generates future candidates. Yet validity and performance do not uniquely determine useful model updates; converting them into learning signals must account for the prompt and evolving search state that produced each candidate. We formulate online post-training of small open-weight LLMs in AHD as context-dependent signal construction and develop alternative mappings from program validity, task performance, and generation context to update signals. Using shared evaluated rollouts and matched update budgets, controlled experiments across AHD tasks and model families compare these mappings with online post-training baselines, testing their effects on validity, performance among valid proposals, and the yield of valid proposals that improve under contextual comparisons. Complementary checkpoint, frozen-search, and live-system evaluations assess whether proposal-level gains appear in updated checkpoint behavior and subsequent search, rather than arising solely from accumulated search state. A resource-matched comparison under pre-specified cost accounting tests whether online updating adds value beyond additional search with a frozen generator. Together, this design avoids treating end-to-end search gains alone as evidence of stronger heuristic-design capabilities.

</details>


### [292] [cua-speedrun: Standardized Benchmarking of the Speed of Computer-Use Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40284)
*Pranjal Aggarwal,Lawrence Keunho Jang,Sean Welleck,Daniel Fried,Ruslan Salakhutdinov,Jing Yu Koh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出了 cua-speedrun，一个标准化的基础设施和任务集，用于评估计算机使用代理的速度和效率，解决了当前 CUA 基准测试中的可复现性危机，并揭示了推理努力、代理框架和环境延迟对性能、速度和成本的复杂影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 计算机使用代理（CUAs）在标准基准测试中已超越人类性能，但其广泛部署面临速度和成本的关键障碍。当前的 CUA 基准测试存在可复现性危机，因为复杂的基础设施和不同的机器/容器配置混淆了执行速度的评估，亟需标准化的评估框架。

Method: 提出 cua-speedrun：统一的虚拟机设置和执行管道，以及通用的代理接口，使单一代理实现能在不同基准测试中无缝运行。在四个不同的 CUA 基准测试上评估推理努力、代理框架和环境延迟对性能、速度和成本的影响，并演示如何有效减少评估任务集而不损失统计效力。

Result: 发现没有单一模型家族在性能、速度、成本三方面都最优；开源权重模型均不在前沿；反直觉地，增加推理努力有时能加快任务完成，而更快的环境输入输出反而可能减慢整体任务完成时间；还证明可以有效缩减大多数 CUA 基准测试的评估任务集而不降低统计效力。

Conclusion: cua-speedrun 将推动快速、高效 CUAs 的结构化进展，解锁新的现实用例和应用。所有代码、基础设施和分析已在 https://cuaspeedrun.com 开源。

Abstract: Computer use agents (CUAs), which use graphical user interfaces (GUIs) to complete tasks on a computer, have recently surpassed human performance on many standard benchmarks, including difficult long-horizon tasks. Their capabilities are undoubtedly impressive, however, a key barrier to the widespread adoption and deployment of CUAs remains their speed and cost. Progress towards faster yet capable CUAs requires reliable evaluation of their speed, but many CUA benchmarks currently face a reproducibility crisis. Benchmarks are based on complex infrastructure with varying machine and container configurations that confound the evaluation of the execution speed of CUAs. Towards addressing this gap, we propose cua-speedrun, which introduces standardized infrastructure and task sets, with a focus on evaluating the speed and efficiency of CUAs. cua-speedrun uses a uniform virtual machine setup and execution pipeline, along with a common agent interface that enables single-agent implementations to operate seamlessly across different benchmarks. Across four different CUA benchmarks, we evaluate how reasoning effort, agent harnesses, and environment latency affect performance, speed, and cost. We find no single model family is optimal for all three; none of the open-weight models are on the frontier, and also, unintuitively, for some models increasing the reasoning effort can speed up task completion, while faster environment input-output can slow down overall task completion time. We also demonstrate that we can effectively reduce the evaluation task set of most CUA benchmarks without degrading overall statistical power, allowing for more efficient benchmarking and comparison. We believe cua-speedrun will enable structured progress towards fast, efficient CUAs, unlocking new real-world use cases and applications. All code, infrastructure, and analysis are available at https://cuaspeedrun.com.

</details>


### [293] [When, Not How Much: Evaluating Time-Series Foundation Models on Sparse Events](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39386)
*Daniel Schoess,Florian von Wangenheim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文评估预训练时间序列基础模型（TSFMs）在稀疏序列事件排序任务上的表现，发现原始点预测优于简单基线的幅度极小，而冻结主干加轻量级事件探针显著提升排序性能，甚至在部分数据集上超越梯度提升树。研究强调需并列报告模型输出、监督探针、原始上下文与随机化对照以全面评估预训练模型在非数值预测任务上的能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准主要评估 TSFMs 的数值预测能力，但稀疏序列中许多决策仅取决于未来哪些时段存在事件（非零值），标准基准未评估这一事件排序能力。

Method: 在五个稀疏数据集上，对 12 个 TSFMs 发布的点预测进行事件排序评估，使用机会校正的平均精度和 AUC 指标；训练六个冻结主干的线性探针进行事件监督；对比探针、原始上下文学习器（梯度提升树）、随机初始化主干及分位数平均等多种策略。

Result: 点预测在机会校正平均精度上仅比无训练基线高出至多 0.031，且中位数 TSFM 在所有数据集的机会校正 AUC 上均低于基线。事件监督下，线性探针在 30 个主干-数据集组合中有 29 个优于对应主干的点预测。分位数平均优于中位数预测，最强输出在两个数据集上接近探针性能。探针相对原始上下文学习的优势随数据集而异，五个主干中有五个的预训练特征优于随机初始化。最佳探针在五个数据集中有三个超越梯度提升树。

Conclusion: 发布的点预测对稀疏事件排序贡献有限，冻结 TSFMs 加轻量级事件头能更好地排序事件，且最佳探针在多数数据集上超越原始上下文梯度提升树。评估预训练预测器在数值预测之外的任务时，必须并列报告模型输出、监督探针、原始上下文与随机化对照，因为每种对照支持不同结论。

Abstract: Pretrained time-series foundation models (TSFMs) are evaluated as forecasters of future values, yet for sparse series many decisions depend only on which future periods contain activity. Standard benchmarks do not assess this. On five sparse datasets, we rank positions within forecast windows that contain both events and zeros. The released point forecasts of 12 TSFMs improve chance-corrected average precision over training-free references by at most 0.031, and in chance-corrected AUC the median TSFM falls below them on every dataset. With event supervision, linear probes of six frozen backbones improve on their backbone's point forecast in 29 of 30 backbone--dataset pairs. Averaging the predicted quantiles instead of taking their median improves the ranking of most TSFMs that forecast the median, and on two datasets the strongest such outputs rival the probes. The probes' advantage over raw-context learners depends on the dataset, and under the same probe, pretrained features outperform randomly initialized ones for five of six backbones. For sparse-event ranking, released point forecasts thus add little over simple references, whereas lightweight event heads on frozen TSFMs rank events better than these forecasts, and the best of them exceed gradient-boosted trees trained on the raw context on three of the five datasets. More broadly, assessing pretrained forecasters on tasks beyond value forecasting requires reporting their outputs, supervised probes of their representations, and raw-context and randomized controls side by side, since each supports a different conclusion.

</details>


### [294] [Scaling Laws for Looped Mixture of Experts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40316)
*Yanbei Chen,Anirudh Goyal,Raghuraman Krishnamoorthi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出首个联合建模循环（递归）与稀疏性（MoE）的缩放定律——Loop Scaling Laws，通过有界、稀疏条件递归映射刻画循环带来的有效参数增益及稀疏性如何提升该增益。定律能更准确预测循环模型的 held-out loss，并将标准稠密和 MoE 缩放定律作为特例。实验表明：稀疏性带来约 3 倍激活参数效率，循环带来约 2 倍总参数效率（推理任务），联合缩放进一步推进性能前沿；在万亿 token 规模下，法则衍生的循环 MoE 在匹配训练算力下匹配约 2 倍参数的非循环 MoE，且支持测试时通过循环扩展。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有缩放定律仅单独建模递归或稀疏性，无法捕捉二者联合作用。循环变换器在固定参数下增加计算深度，MoE 在固定激活计算下扩展总容量，二者互补但缺乏统一理论指导，阻碍了在算力与内存约束下的最优模型设计。

Method: 引入 Loop Scaling Laws，核心是一个有界的、稀疏条件递归映射，表征循环带来的有效参数增益以及稀疏性如何提升该增益。该定律联合建模模型规模、数据量、递归深度和专家稀疏度，并能退化为标准稠密和 MoE 缩放定律。

Result: 定律对循环模型的 held-out loss 预测更准确；下游评估显示稀疏性提供约 3 倍激活参数效率，递归提供约 2 倍总参数效率（推理任务），联合缩放进一步提升性能。万亿 token 规模实验表明，法则衍生的循环 MoE 在相同训练算力下匹配约 2 倍参数的非循环 MoE，并支持测试时通过递归进行扩展。

Conclusion: Loop Scaling Laws 为循环 MoE 模型的联合缩放提供了首个 principled 基础，量化了递归与稀疏的互补效益，实现了在算力和内存约束下的最优设计，并在大规模验证了其实际收益，推动了高效大模型训练与推理的性能前沿。

Abstract: Looped transformers and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) offer complementary routes to efficient scaling: recurrence increases computational depth at fixed parameters, while MoE sparsity expands total capacity at fixed active compute. Yet existing scaling laws model recurrence or sparsity in isolation. In this work, we introduce Loop Scaling Laws, the first scaling law to jointly model recurrence and sparsity alongside model size and data. At its core is a bounded, sparsity-conditional recurrence mapping that characterizes the effective-parameter gain from looping and how sparsity raises this gain. The laws predict the held-out loss of looped models more accurately than prior alternatives, and recover the standard dense and MoE scaling laws as special cases. Beyond prediction, the fitted laws provide a principled foundation for designing looped MoE models under compute and memory constraints. Downstream evaluations further demonstrate the complementary benefits of the two axes: sparsity delivers ~3x active-parameter efficiency, recurrence yields ~2x total-parameter efficiency on reasoning, and joint scaling further advances the performance frontier. As a practical extension, we show these gains hold at trillion-token scale: at matched training compute, a looped MoE with law-derived recurrence matches a ~2x larger non-looped MoE on the reasoning benchmarks, while enabling test-time scaling through recurrence.

</details>


### [295] [Beyond Simulation: Retain-and-Repair Neural Operators for Real-World Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39387)
*Woojin Cho,Junghwan Park*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Retain-and-Repair Neural Operator (R²NO)，一种将仿真预训练的神经算子适配到真实世界数据的框架，通过冻结预训练模型提供源预测，并利用共享修复模块在频域单元内学习细化，实现自适应的保留与修复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经算子在数值仿真预训练后，适配真实世界预测仍具挑战：全量微调易破坏预训练结构，迭代细化缺乏频域自适应机制。需要一种能在保留预训练知识的同时，针对真实数据进行频域自适应修复的方法。

Method: 1) 在真实数据上微调预训练算子后冻结，提供源预测；2) 共享修复模块从同一观测学习细化序列；3) 利用正交傅里叶投影，在径向范围、角度扇区、测量通道联合定义的频域单元内拟合小型岭回归；4) 在保留验证集上拟合权重组合源预测与多模块细化，实现单元级自适应保留/修复深度。

Result: 在RealPDEBench所有系统及六种骨干网络上，R²NO持续优于全量微调和迭代细化基线。

Conclusion: R²NO将适配深度视为从真实数据学习的单元级选择，通过频域集成实现预训练知识保留与真实域修复的统一，为仿真到真实的算子迁移提供了有效范式。

Abstract: Neural operators increasingly benefit from pretraining on numerical simulations, yet adapting them for real-world prediction remains challenging. We introduce the Retain-and-Repair Neural Operator (R$^2$NO), a framework for adapting simulation-pretrained operators to real-world data while retaining useful pretrained structure. The pretrained operator is first finetuned on real data and then frozen to provide a source prediction, and a shared repair module learns a sequence of refinements from the same observations. Using orthogonal Fourier projections, a spectral ensemble fits a small ridge regression within each cell of the Fourier domain and combines the refinements by weights fitted on a held-out split of the real data. The cells are defined jointly by radial ranges, angular sectors, and measured channels, allowing refinement depth to vary with frequency magnitude, with orientation, and across channels. Including the source prediction as a candidate makes retention available in every cell, and independently trained repair modules enter the same combination as additional candidates. On all RealPDEBench systems and six backbones, R$^2$NO consistently outperforms full finetuning and iterative refinement. The framework treats adaptation depth as a cell-specific choice learned from real data.

</details>


### [296] [Semifactual Credit-Augmented Policy Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40360)
*Junshu Pan,Zhizhang Fu,Shulin Huang,Yiran Ding,Zifan Cheng,Wenqi Shao,Qiaosheng Zhang,Yue Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SCAPO（Semifactual Credit-Augmented Policy Optimization），一种基于反事实稳定性的GRPO变体，通过细粒度token级信用分配解决RLVR中模型对任务无关提示特征的敏感性问题。实验表明SCAPO在数学推理和分布外泛化上显著优于GRPO。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR虽提升了LLM推理能力，但模型预测仍对任务无关的提示特征敏感。GRPO将相同的基于结果的优势分配给每个响应token，可能同时强化有用推理和虚假依赖。作者通过半事实提示干预发现token级敏感性差异大，抑制高漂移token候选能无需更新权重即提升推理准确性，这揭示了GRPO的局限性并激发了基于因果稳定性的细粒度信用分配需求。

Method: SCAPO在固定响应下测量半事实干预下的token概率漂移，计算归一化稳定性分数，在早期训练中降低相对不稳定token的优势，而不单独奖励稳定性。它将半事实稳定性作为因果信号融入token级信用分配，是GRPO的因果启发式变体。

Result: 在Qwen3-4B-Base和Qwen3-1.7B-Base上，SCAPO在AIME 2024-2026上分别比GRPO提升5.63和4.17个百分点。两种规模模型下，SCAPO在大多数数学基准和所有评估的分布外基准上均取得最佳结果。

Conclusion: 半事实稳定性为RLVR中的细粒度信用分配提供了有效训练信号，通过区分稳定推理token与敏感token，SCAPO显著提升了推理准确性和泛化能力，揭示了因果启发式token级优势估计的重要性。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has improved the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs), yet their predictions remain sensitive to task-irrelevant prompt features. We investigate this sensitivity through semifactual prompt interventions that preserve the underlying problem and its answer. Our analysis reveals substantial variation in token-level sensitivity and shows that suppressing high-drift token candidates during decoding improves reasoning accuracy without updating model weights. These findings highlight a limitation of Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), which assigns the same outcome-derived advantage to every response token and may reinforce potential spurious dependence alongside useful reasoning. Motivated by this observation, we introduce Semifactual Credit-Augmented Policy Optimization (SCAPO), a causally inspired variant of GRPO that incorporates semifactual stability into token-level credit assignment. SCAPO measures token probability drift for fixed responses under semifactual interventions and uses normalized stability scores to reduce advantages for relatively unstable tokens during early training, while granting no additional credit for stability alone. On Qwen3-4B-Base and Qwen3-1.7B-Base, SCAPO improves AIME 2024-2026 accuracy over GRPO by 5.63 and 4.17 percentage points, respectively. At both model scales, SCAPO achieves the best results on most evaluated mathematics benchmarks and all evaluated out-of-distribution benchmarks among the compared methods. These results suggest that semifactual stability provides an effective training signal for improving reasoning and generalization through finer-grained credit assignment in RLVR. The code is available at https://github.com/DtYXs/SCAPO.

</details>


### [297] [Decoupled and Distilled: Task-Adaptive LoRA-Teachers with Ensemble Knowledge Transfer for Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39390)
*Hongwei Zhao,Rui Liu,Yansong Liu,Zhiyuan Zou,Yong Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出TALON框架解决少样本类增量学习(FSCIL)问题，通过为每个增量任务动态分配独立LoRA-Teacher进行任务特定表示学习，再通过集成知识蒸馏将多个冻结的Teacher蒸馏为统一的LoRA-Student，消除运行时模块选择开销。语义引导蒸馏策略按特征空间相似度加权教师贡献，缓解灾难性遗忘和过拟合。在四个基准上达到SOTA性能，部署参数减少33倍，推理时间降低41.7%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于预训练模型的参数高效微调方法在类增量学习中虽显潜力，但严格梯度约束在严重数据稀缺下不可靠；多专家方法虽有效但带来巨大推理时开销。需要一种既能在少样本下有效学习新类且保持旧类知识，又能在推理阶段保持高效的方法。

Method: TALON包含两阶段：1) 任务自适应LoRA-Teacher分配：为每个增量任务动态分配独立LoRA-Teacher进行任务特定表示学习；2) 集成知识蒸馏：将多个冻结的Teacher蒸馏为统一的LoRA-Student，消除运行时模块选择/生成。引入语义引导蒸馏策略，按特征空间相似度加权教师贡献，缓解灾难性遗忘和过拟合。

Result: 跨三次类顺序运行，在四个FSCIL基准上达到可比或更优的平均准确率：CUB200 86.68±1.22%、CIFAR100 90.39±0.27%、ImageNet-R 78.38±0.94%、miniImageNet 96.34±0.33%。部署参数减少高达33倍，平均每任务推理时间降至26.7秒，较ASP减少41.70%。

Conclusion: TALON通过任务自适应LoRA-Teacher与集成知识蒸馏相结合，在少样本类增量学习中同时实现了高性能与高推理效率，语义引导蒸馏有效缓解了灾难性遗忘和过拟合，为实际部署提供了实用解决方案。

Abstract: Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning (FSCIL) addresses the challenge of learning new classes from very limited samples while retaining knowledge of previously learned ones. Although parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods with pre-trained models show promise for class-incremental learning, strict gradient-based constraints can be unreliable under severe data scarcity, while multi-expert approaches can impose substantial inference-time costs. We propose TALON (Task-Adaptive LoRA-Teachers with Ensemble Knowledge Transfer), an inference-efficient FSCIL framework. TALON dynamically allocates an independent LoRA-Teacher to each incremental task for task-specific representation learning, then distills multiple frozen teachers into a unified LoRA-Student through Ensemble Knowledge Transfer, eliminating runtime module selection or generation. A semantic-guided distillation strategy weights teacher contributions by feature-space similarity to mitigate catastrophic forgetting and overfitting. Across three class-order runs, TALON achieves comparable or better mean average accuracy across four FSCIL benchmarks, obtaining 86.68 +/- 1.22% on CUB200, 90.39 +/- 0.27% on CIFAR100, 78.38 +/- 0.94% on ImageNet-R, and 96.34 +/- 0.33% on miniImageNet. TALON uses up to 33x fewer deployment parameters and reduces average inference time per task to 26.7 s, a 41.70% reduction relative to ASP.

</details>


### [298] [Ranking-Aware Prompt Optimization for Multimodal Clinical Diagnosis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40361)
*Tian Xia,Minghao Liu,Yiqing Liang,Laixi Shi,Jiayun Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出 Ranking-PE，一种基于成对排序的提示词进化方法，将临床多模态大模型的优化目标从准确率改为 AUROC，解决类别不平衡导致的准确率失真问题，在 MIMIC 数据集上显著提升三种疾病的诊断排序性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床数据严重类别不平衡，准确率指标易被常数多数类预测器利用（>90% 准确率但临床无用）。现有反射式提示词进化（如 GEPA）基于二元正确性矩阵优化准确率，导致排序性能退化。需要一种阈值无关、不变于类别平衡的指标（AUROC）来指导提示词搜索。

Method: 提出 pair-level Pareto prompt evolution (Ranking-PE)：将评估矩阵的每行从单实例正确性替换为正负样本对的成对排序指示（候选对正样本评分高于负样本则为 1），列均值即为经验 AUROC（Wilcoxon-Mann-Whitney 恒等式）。在提示词进化搜索的三层全部应用该替换：Pareto 支配判定的分数矩阵、给反射 LM 的逐例反馈、最终候选选择。无需额外模型调用，无代理损失。

Result: 在 MIMIC 三种疾病任务上：准确率驱动的提示词进化会降低排序性能；Ranking-PE 扭转这一趋势，在微调 Qwen3-VL-8B 上超越准确率基线 +5.8 AUROC 百分点，在 MedGemma-4B 上超越 +16.2 百分点。消融实验表明：医疗级视觉骨干（通过视觉编码器调优 SFT 或医疗预训练获得）是提示词搜索无法替代的前提条件。

Conclusion: Ranking-PE 将反射式提示词进化从纯文本数据扩展到多模态临床决策，通过直接优化 AUROC 解决类别不平衡问题，实现了显著的排序性能提升，并揭示了高质量医疗视觉骨干对多模态临床诊断的必要性。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are rapidly advancing clinical diagnosis, yet their adaptation pipelines remain anchored to accuracy-based objectives. Clinical data are heavily class-imbalanced: a constant-majority predictor can score above 90% accuracy while being clinically useless. We therefore evaluate and optimize for AUROC, a threshold-free score that ranks positives above negatives and is invariant to class balance. We focus on prompt optimization in MLLMs. Reflective methods such as GEPA use a binary scores matrix with one row per evaluation instance and one column per candidate prompt; cells record per-instance correctness, so the column average is accuracy and drives candidate selection. We introduce pair-level Pareto prompt evolution (Ranking-PE), which replaces each correctness row with a pairwise-ordering row over (positive, negative) instance pairs: the cell is 1 if the candidate scores the positive higher than the paired negative. The column average then equals empirical AUROC (by the Wilcoxon-Mann-Whitney identity). We apply this swap at all three layers the prompt evolution search reads from - the scores matrix that decides Pareto dominance, the per-example feedback to the reflection LM, and final candidate selection - at no extra model calls and with no surrogate loss. Across three diseases on MIMIC, accuracy-based prompt evolution can degrade ranking; Ranking-PE reverses this, beating the accuracy-based recipe by +5.8 AUROC pp on fine-tuned Qwen3-VL-8B and +16.2 pp on MedGemma-4B. Ablations examine each design component and show that a medical-grade visual backbone - via vision-encoder-tuned SFT or medical pretraining - is a prerequisite that prompt search cannot replace - our recipe extends reflective prompt evolution from text-only data to multimodal clinical decision-making.

</details>


### [299] [No Task Vector Is an Island: A Comprehensive Study on the Composability of Task Vectors from On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39405)
*Jingang Zhou,Feiyu Han,Han Zhu,Yuyi Zhou,Ruiyang Zhang,Jian Xu,Sirui Gao,Qingpei Guo,Xu-Yao Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文探讨了在线策略蒸馏(OPD)产生的任务向量与强化学习(RL)教师更新的可组合性,发现OPD任务向量虽单独性能较弱,但能与RL更新互补并跨任务有效组合,揭示可组合性是理解和评估后训练更新的独立属性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 任务向量提供了通过模型合并组合学习能力的简单机制,但OPD产生的任务向量的可组合性尚未被探索。OPD使用教师对学生生成轨迹的反馈训练学生,产生的参数更新不同于教师模型(通常由RL产生)。研究旨在回答:OPD任务向量能否补充其RL教师更新,并跨任务有效组合?

Method: 跨五个领域和两种模型架构进行实验:合并OPD与RL任务向量进行任务内组合;跨任务组合对比OPD与RL的平均得分;参数空间分析包括更新方向的非共线性测量、顶部10%前馈通道按更新能量排名的重叠度;在CODE领域对SMOLLM3-3B进行实验验证组合方向在测试全局更新范数下的表现。

Result: 任务内合并OPD和RL任务向量优于两个单独模型,即使OPD学生弱于RL教师;跨任务组合中,OPD任务向量在八种主干-合并规则对比中七种实现更高平均分;参数空间分析显示OPD与RL更新存在显著非共线性;CODE领域实验表明组合方向在测试全局更新范数下优于任一单独方向;跨任务中,OPD更新在按更新能量排名的顶部10%前馈通道中显示更低重叠。

Conclusion: 较弱的独立性能不意味着较弱的任务向量可组合性。OPD任务向量能补充更强的RL教师更新并跨任务有效组合,突显可组合性作为理解和评估后训练更新的独立属性。

Abstract: Task vectors provide a simple mechanism for composing learned capabilities through model merging. However, the composability of task vectors produced by on-policy distillation (OPD) remains largely unexplored. OPD trains a student using teacher feedback on student-generated trajectories, yielding parameter updates that differ from those produced by the teacher model, usually by reinforcement learning (RL). We therefore ask whether OPD task vectors can complement their RL teacher updates and compose effectively across tasks. Across five domains and two model architectures, we find evidence for both forms of composability. Within a task, merging OPD and RL task vectors can outperform both constituent models, even when the OPD student is weaker than its RL teacher. Across tasks, OPD task-vector compositions achieve higher average scores than corresponding RL compositions in seven of eight backbone-merging-rule comparisons. Parameter-space analyses reveal substantial non-collinearity between OPD and RL updates. Experiment in CODE domain on SMOLLM3-3B shows that the combined direction outperforms either constituent direction at the tested global update norm, supporting directional complementarity in this configuration. Across tasks, OPD updates also show lower overlap among the top-10% feed-forward channels ranked by update energy. Together, these results show that weaker standalone performance does not imply weaker task-vector composability. OPD task vectors can complement stronger RL teacher updates and combine effectively across tasks, highlighting composability as a distinct property for understanding and evaluating post-training updates.

</details>


### [300] [Awakening of the Buddha: Subspace Learning During Population-Loss Plateaus](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39408)
*Akash Kumar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究了两层 ReLU 和 leaky-ReLU 网络以及 SwiGLU 网络在高斯输入下的训练动力学，证明了在种群损失平台期内，网络能学到显著更好的预测表示。对于结构化加性教师模型，给出了小高斯初始化下的高概率保证：在高损失平台期检查点，教师子空间与预测器平均梯度外积（AGOP）主特征空间的对齐度至少增加 1/2，最小重拟合 MSE 下降超 0.399；后续轨迹最终达到低于平台期窗口所有值的损失。互补结果处理不等权三次教师和小加性 Sobolev 扰动。实验在 21 个教师和每教师 50 次初始化上验证了理论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解神经网络在种群损失近似恒定的平台期内，如何仍能学习到更具预测性的表示这一现象的理论机制；为两层网络在高斯输入下的特征学习动力学提供严格的非渐近保证，量化表示质量提升与损失下降的分离。

Method: 采用同时定步长种群梯度下降训练所有参数。针对结构化加性教师（正高斯阻尼三次混合，属于 H^1(γ)），分析小 IID 高斯初始化下的轨迹；利用平均梯度外积（AGOP）的主特征空间与教师秩-r 子空间的对齐度、固定系数预算下的最小重拟合 MSE 作为表示质量指标。对 SwiGLU 网络，固定宽度和维度，研究高斯初始化消失极限下的领先 AGOP 对齐。还给出了共享正交轴限制下的近似下界。

Result: 1) 结构化加性教师：高概率下，平台期检查点处最小对齐度增 ≥ 1/2，最小重拟合 MSE 降 > 0.399（相对初始化）；后续损失跌破平台期窗口所有值。2) 不等权三次教师及小 Sobolev 扰动：投影特征重拟合给出互补保证。3) SwiGLU：初始化消失极限下，对一/二/三阶 Hermite 含量非零的平方可积教师，平台期存在领先 AGOP 对齐；秩一三次特例给出同时无限制重拟合增益。4) 近似下界：某些交互目标在脊神经元限于教师子空间共享正交轴时保持非零误差。5) 实验：21 个教师 × 50 初始化的 ReLU 学生种群矩实验支持理论。

Conclusion: 论文严格证明了种群损失平台期与表示学习显著改善的分离现象，为两层网络特征学习的早期动力学提供了量化理论保证；揭示了 AGOP 谱结构与教师子空间对齐的关键作用，并指出了架构限制（共享正交轴）对某些交互目标的根本近似障碍。

Abstract: Population loss can remain nearly constant while a neural network learns a substantially more predictive representation. We establish this separation for two-layer ReLU and leaky-ReLU networks trained on Gaussian inputs by simultaneous fixed-step population gradient descent on all parameters. For structured additive teachers whose links are positive mixtures of Gaussian-damped cubics in $H^1(γ)$, we give explicit conditions under which small IID Gaussian initialization yields a high-probability guarantee: at a checkpoint during a high-loss plateau, minimum alignment between the rank-$r$ teacher subspace and the leading $r$-dimensional eigenspace of the predictor's average gradient outer product (AGOP) increases by at least $1/2$, and the minimum refit MSE under unchanged coefficient budgets decreases by more than $0.399$, both relative to initialization. The same trajectory subsequently attains a trained loss below every value in the plateau window. A complementary result treats unequal-weight cubic teachers and small additive Sobolev perturbations using projected-feature refits. For SwiGLU networks with an exactly fitted intercept, we prove leading-AGOP alignment during a loss plateau at fixed width and dimension as Gaussian initialization vanishes, for square-integrable teachers with nonzero Hermite content of degree one, two, or three. A rank-one cubic specialization also gives simultaneous unrestricted-refit gains at a prescribed width. An approximation lower bound further shows that certain interaction targets retain nonzero error when ridge neurons are restricted to shared orthogonal axes within the teacher subspace. Population-moment experiments with ReLU students across 21 teachers and 50 initializations per teacher complement the analysis.

</details>


### [301] [From Imitation to Reward Discovery: On-Policy Warmup for Agentic RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39436)
*Yitong Qiao,Tiantian He,Lei Liu,Yue Shen,Jian Wang,Jinjie Gu,Zhixuan Chu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出 On-Policy Warmup (OPW) 方法，通过教师指导的在策略蒸馏预热阶段，解决 RLVR 早期稀疏奖励信号不足的问题，实现更快收敛和更高最终性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR 在早期训练中面临稀疏结果奖励导致的信号不足问题，阻碍策略改进。观察到在策略蒸馏初始化的 RLVR 能更早达到高性能，且最终性能更优于基线方法。

Method: 提出 On-Policy Warmup (OPW) 预热阶段：学生模型在自身交互轨迹上接受教师监督训练，再过渡到 RLVR。不同于固定教师轨迹的模仿，OPW 针对学生自身决策诱导的状态（包括不完美动作和恢复情况）。理论上将在策略逆 KL 蒸馏与轨迹级分布匹配联系起来，推导初始验证器成功率下界和奖励发现复杂度界。

Result: 实验表明 OPW 初始化的 RLVR 在训练早期达到更高性能，平均性能和最终性能均优于基线。理论分析给出了在合格教师和足够小蒸馏损失下的成功率下界，并刻画了群体相对 RLVR 中成功概率增加产生更多奖励信息组的条件。

Conclusion: 在策略蒸馏作为 RLVR 的有效预热阶段，初始奖励发现是观察到的加速现象的关键机制之一。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with a verifiable reward (RLVR) offers a scalable approach to training language-model agents, yet sparse outcome rewards can leave early training with little signal for policy improvement. We identify an On-Policy Acceleration Phenomenon: in our main comparisons, RLVR initialized with on-policy distillation reaches high performance earlier in training and achieves both higher average performance during subsequent RLVR and higher final performance than the alternative baselines. Motivated by this observation, we study On-Policy Warmup (OPW), a teacher-guided stage in which the student trains with teacher supervision on its own interaction trajectories before transitioning to RLVR. Unlike imitation on fixed teacher-generated trajectories, OPW targets states induced by the student's own decisions, including imperfect actions and recovery situations. We provide a theoretical explanation by connecting on-policy reverse-KL distillation to trajectory-level distribution matching. Under a competent teacher and sufficiently small population distillation loss, this connection yields a lower bound on initial verifier success and a corresponding bound on reward-discovery complexity. For group-relative RLVR, we further characterize when increased success probability produces more reward-informative groups. Together, our findings support on-policy distillation as an effective warmup for agentic RLVR and identify initial reward discovery as a mechanism that can contribute to the observed acceleration.

</details>


### [302] [Network-based Spatial Context Retrieval for Open-weight LLMs: A Faithfulness Benchmark for Grounded Geographic Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39437)
*Joan Perez*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出了一种基于开放数据的网络空间上下文检索管道，构建了忠实性基准来评估大语言模型在给定结构化空间简报时的推理行为，发现模型对植入虚假前提的抵抗力更多取决于模型家族和代际而非规模，且简报阅读能力形成一个独立维度，传统世界正确性分数无法捕捉这些行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大语言模型蕴含大量潜在地理知识，但仅凭坐标进行空间推理能力差、不可靠；仅在提示词中提供结构化空间上下文时才会涌现有用行为。地理评估尚未探究：一旦提供正确上下文，模型是基于上下文推理，还是用参数化记忆覆盖上下文？

Method: 构建开放管道 NSCR-LLM：以步行街道网络定义兴趣点的可达范围，从 OpenStreetMap 和 GHS-POP 人口栅格检索特征，在代码中计算网络聚合区指标，生成紧凑的空间简报注入提示词。建立忠实性基准，对模型生成的每个声明标注来源（简报支撑或训练知识）与正确性，并植入简报可反驳的虚假前提进行探测。在三座对比城市上，对 Qwen、Gemma（两代）、Llama 三个家族、四个规模类别、思考/非思考模式共 16 种开放权重配置进行评估，每个案例重采样 10 个随机种子。

Result: 抵抗植入虚假前提的能力随模型家族和代际变化显著大于随规模变化；简报阅读能力（brief-reading competence）形成一个部分独立的维度。传统世界正确性分数和单次评估无法捕捉这些行为差异。

Conclusion: 提供结构化空间上下文后，模型的推理忠实性主要取决于模型家族与代际，而非单纯规模扩大；简报阅读能力是一个需单独考察的维度。作者发布了完整的可复现工作流（实现代码、空间简报、模型输出、声明级标签），为地理语境下的大模型忠实性评估提供了新基准。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) encode substantial latent geographic knowledge, yet they reason poorly over space and are unreliable when queried from coordinates alone. Useful behaviour emerges only when structured spatial context is supplied in the prompt. This raises a question geographic evaluation has left unexamined: once the right context is supplied, does the model reason from it, or override it with its own parametric recall? We take up this question with an open pipeline for network-based spatial context retriev-al. In it, the surroundings of a selected point are defined by the pedestrian street network, the area actually reachable on foot. Using only open data and open-weight models, the pipeline retrieves features from OpenStreetMap and the GHS-POP population grid, computes indicators over the network catchment in code, and injects them as a compact spatial brief. On this basis we build a faithfulness benchmark. It labels every claim a model makes by its source (grounded in the brief, or drawn from training knowledge) and its correctness, and it probes each case with a planted false premise that the brief refutes. We evaluate sixteen open-weight model configurations across three families (Qwen, Gemma and Llama, with Gemma in two generations), four size classes and, where available, both thinking and non-thinking modes, on three con-trasting cities, resampling every case over ten seeds. The results show that resistance to the planted premise varies more strongly by model family and generation than by scale, while brief-reading competence forms a partly separate dimension. These behaviours are not captured by conventional world-correctness scores or single-shot evaluation. We release the implementation, spatial briefs, model outputs, and claim-level labels as a reproducible workflow at github.com/perezjoan/NSCR-LLM.

</details>


### [303] [Raw-Routed Mixture of Adapters: A Causal Intervention for Routing Collapse in Time Series Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39445)
*Hung Phan,Thuy T. Nguyen,Minh Ngoc Dinh,Nhat-Quang Tran*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文发现实例归一化导致时间序列基础模型中专家混合路由崩溃，提出原始路由混合适配器（RR-MoA）在归一化前路由，冻结主干下以54/54全胜最强固定适配器，并以12-79%优于全微调（冻结悖论），跨六主干与插补任务泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间序列基础模型常用冻结主干+单头适配新数据，难以拟合异构机制；引入专家混合本应解决，但在实例归一化主干上路由熵归零、单一专家吞噬所有输入，现有MoE补救无效，因归一化剥离了路由器所需统计量。

Method: 通过互信息分解推导信噪比，训练前预测数据集脆弱性（Spearman ρ=-0.88）；八个因果对照（含视觉模态复现）锁定实例归一化为根因；提出极简因果干预：原始路由混合适配器（RR-MoA），在归一化前的原始输入上路由。

Result: 冻结主干下RR-MoA在54/54对比中击败最强固定适配器，显著优于LoRA、TRACE、AdaMix及全微调；跨六主干与插补任务泛化；冻结RR-MoA以12-79%优于全微调（冻结悖论）；两个架构不同变体验证原理普适性。

Conclusion: 实例归一化破坏路由信号是MoE在TSFM失效的核心原因；在归一化前路由的轻量干预即可恢复专家专业化，且冻结适配器反超全微调，揭示冻结悖论，为异构时间序列适配提供通用原则。

Abstract: Time series foundation models (TSFMs) commonly adapt to new data by attaching a single trainable head to a frozen backbone, a one-size-fits-all setup that underfits heterogeneous regimes. Replacing the head with a mixture of experts is the standard upgrade, but on instance-normalized backbones (the dominant TSFM design class) it fails: routing entropy collapses to zero and one expert absorbs every input, a failure we call normalization-induced routing collapse. Standard MoE rescue mechanisms do not repair it, because the cause is in the router's input, not its optimization. Pre-encoder normalization strips the statistics a router would need to tell regimes apart. A mutual-information decomposition makes this precise and yields a signal-ratio that, computed before training, predicts dataset vulnerability (Spearman $ρ= -0.88$). Eight causal controls, including a vision-modality replication, isolate instance normalization as the cause. The prescription is a minimal causal intervention: Raw-Routed Mixture of Adapters (RR-MoA), which routes on the raw, pre-normalization input. Under a strictly frozen backbone, RR-MoA wins 54/54 comparisons against the strongest fixed adapter and significantly outperforms LoRA, TRACE, AdaMix, and full fine-tuning. The effect generalizes across six backbones and an imputation task. Frozen RR-MoA also beats full fine-tuning by 12-79% (the Frozen Paradox); two architecturally distinct variants confirm the principle generalizes beyond this specific router.

</details>


### [304] [Mutual Equilibrium: Multimodal Representation Learning through Reciprocal Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39456)
*Ho-min Park,Byungkon Kang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种名为MEQ的互反馈架构，将两个可能不同模态的输入细化为一对耦合嵌入，使每个嵌入均反映另一个的信息。核心思想是持续交换信息，通过两个组件输出相互反馈，最终输出定义为该交互的不动点。理论分析提供了模型解释及防止失效的设计选择。在分类和视觉定位任务上，MEQ在多模态分类中优于或持平拼接基线，且互反馈机制能逐步细化视觉定位，展示互补模态下的互反馈威力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态融合常采用简单拼接或单向注意力，难以充分捕捉模态间的深度交互与互补信息。作者希望设计一种能持续交换信息、使各模态嵌入相互反映对方信息的架构，从而更有效地融合异构模态并提升下游任务性能。

Method: 提出MEQ互反馈架构：包含两个组件，各自处理一种模态输入，输出嵌入后反馈给另一组件作为额外输入。该过程迭代进行，直至收敛到不动点，得到一对耦合嵌入。提供理论分析解释模型行为，并给出防止发散等失效情况的设计准则。

Result: 在多个数据集的多模态分类任务中，MEQ量化指标优于或持平基于拼接的基线方法。在视觉定位任务中，互反馈机制使模型能随着迭代逐步细化定位结果，定性展示了互补模态下互反馈的优势。

Conclusion: MEQ通过互反馈实现模态间深度信息交换，理论保证收敛并提供设计指导，实验表明其在分类与定位任务上均有效，验证了互反馈架构在多模态融合中的潜力。

Abstract: This work proposes a mutual feedback architecture, MEQ, that refines the two inputs, of possibly different modalities, into a pair of coupled embeddings such that each embedding reflects the information of the other. The core idea is to incorporate continuous interchange of information between the two inputs. This idea leads to a mutual feedback architecture consisting of two components whose outputs are fed back into the other. The final output of this model is defined as the fixed point of this interaction. We provide theoretical analysis that offers interpretation of this model as well as design choices to prevent failure cases. We show the benefits of MEQ through classification and visual grounding tasks spanning various datasets. Quantitatively, our model outperforms or shows competitive performance on concatenation-based multimodal classification problems. Qualitatively, the proposed interactive mechanism allows the model to progressively refine the visual grounding when paired with complementary modality, thus demonstrating the power of mutual feedback under such settings.

</details>


### [305] [Understanding Head Geometry and Dynamics in Federated Regression through a Natural Solution Selection Rule: An Unconstrained Feature Model Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39464)
*Chuang Ma,Tomoyuki Obuchi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究联邦平均中因局部最优头不唯一导致的聚合歧义，提出基于无约束特征模型(UFM)的分析框架，证明在特定选择规则下共享Gram矩阵收敛到客户端最优Gram矩阵的Bures-Wasserstein重心，并量化了与中心化最优解的差距，提出一轮修正策略可恢复中心化最优解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦平均算法中，局部目标函数可能存在多个最优头，导致聚合结果依赖于客户端返回哪个最优头，这种歧义性影响模型收敛性能。现有理论缺乏对这一现象的系统分析，特别是私有骨干网络与共享线性头架构下的动态行为。

Method: 采用无约束特征模型(UFM)将训练样本特征视为自由变量；引入自然选择规则：每个客户端返回最接近广播头的最优头；证明全局最小化加上消失的近端惩罚可实现该规则；分析共享Gram矩阵的闭式递归动态；将与中心化最优解的差距分解为三个正半定项；设计基于目标均值和协方差一次性交换的修正策略。

Result: 1) 当客户端最优Gram矩阵和初始共享Gram矩阵正定时，共享Gram矩阵收敛到客户端最优Gram矩阵的唯一Bures-Wasserstein重心。2) 极限通常不同于中心化最优Gram矩阵，差距分解为：客户端目标均值差异、协方差异质性、对齐头平均三项。3) 一次性交换目标均值和协方差的修正策略可在一轮内恢复中心化最优解。4) 实验验证：普通训练接近预测重心，弱近端惩罚改善终点一致性且轨迹遵循预测Gram动态，修正策略使最终Gram矩阵接近中心化UFM预测。

Conclusion: 本文揭示了联邦平均中头选择歧义的理论本质，建立了共享Gram矩阵动态的精确刻画，量化了联邦学习与中心化学习的性能差距来源，并提出了一种通信高效的一轮修正方法。实验表明UFM理论能很好地预测深度网络在长本地训练和特征正则化下的实际行为，为联邦学习算法设计提供了理论指导。

Abstract: In federated averaging, local objectives can admit multiple optimal heads, making the aggregate depend on which heads clients return. We study this ambiguity in federated multivariate regression with private backbones and a shared linear head, using an unconstrained feature model (UFM) that treats training-sample features as free variables. We introduce a natural selection rule: each client returns the optimal head closest to the broadcast head. We show that global minimization with a vanishing proximal penalty on the head realizes this rule. When the clients' optimal Gram matrices and the initial shared Gram matrix are positive definite, the shared Gram matrix follows a closed recursion and converges to the unique Bures-Wasserstein barycenter of the clients' optimal Gram matrices. Even with this alignment, the limit generally differs from the centralized optimal Gram matrix. We decompose this gap into three positive-semidefinite terms arising from differences in client target means, covariance heterogeneity, and averaging the aligned heads. A correction based on a one-time exchange of target means and covariances recovers the centralized optimal Gram matrix in one round under exact local optimization and the same selection rule. We verify these results numerically in the UFM and test its predictions on five tabular and five image regression datasets using deep networks with feature regularization and long local training. In these experiments, ordinary training approaches the predicted barycenter, while a weak proximal penalty improves endpoint agreement and yields trajectories that closely follow the predicted Gram dynamics. The correction moves the final Gram matrices close to the centralized UFM prediction.

</details>


### [306] [T-ARC: Topology-Aware Randomized Clustering via Distributionally Robust Stochastic Block Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39466)
*Serena Grazia De Benedictis,Andersen Ang,Nicoletta Del Buono,Flavia Esposito,Laura Selicato*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: T-ARC 是一种拓扑感知的随机聚类方法，通过将拓扑信息嵌入优化目标来修正 K-means 的几何偏差，结合 K-means 数据保真项与图割惩罚，利用随机块模型 (SBM) 和分布鲁棒优化 (DRO) 建模潜在图，并通过零维持久同调 (H0) 得到的持久性相似矩阵作为拓扑先验，通过分块坐标下降优化并证明收敛性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: K-means 存在几何偏差，难以处理非凸几何结构（如弯曲、交织的簇）；数据往往具有潜在的拓扑结构（连通性），需要将拓扑信息融入聚类目标以恢复潜在结构。

Method: 1) 提出 T-ARC 目标函数：K-means 数据保真项 + 图割惩罚项。2) 将潜在图建模为随机块模型 (SBM) 的随机实现，其标量参数在分布鲁棒优化 (DRO) 框架内优化，得到闭式近端更新。3) 利用零维持久同调 (H0) 计算持久性相似矩阵，作为成对拓扑先验指导 SBM 和 DRO。4) 通过分块坐标下降优化：确定性块单调下降，随机图更新在期望下下降，通过全局 Lyapunov 泛函证明期望能量收敛。

Result: 在合成非凸几何数据集和 Fashion-MNIST 随机子集上实验表明，T-ARC 能在 K-means 失效时恢复潜在拓扑结构，在弯曲和交织簇上达到最高准确率，在真实数据上具有竞争力且比 K-means 显著更稳定。

Conclusion: T-ARC 通过将拓扑先验（持久同调）融入随机块模型和分布鲁棒优化框架，成功修正了 K-means 的几何偏差，实现了对复杂拓扑结构的鲁棒聚类，且具有理论收敛保证。

Abstract: In this work, we introduce a new clustering method, namely T-ARC (Topology-Aware Randomized Clustering), that corrects the geometric bias of K-means by embedding topological information directly into the optimization objective. Building on the assumption that the data admits an underlying hidden structure modeled via a latent graph, the idea is to uncover this information through the interplay between the standard K-means data-fidelity term and a graph-cut penalty, which discourages cluster assignments inconsistent with the connectivity structure of the data.
  To render this coupling tractable, the latent graph is modeled as a random realization from a Stochastic Block Model (SBM), whose scalar parameter is optimized within a Distributionally Robust Optimization (DRO) framework, yielding a closed-form proximal update. Both SBM and DRO are informed by a persistence-based similarity matrix derived from zero-dimensional persistent homology ($H_0$), which translates the multiscale connectivity structure of the data into a pairwise topological prior. The overall optimization proceeds via Block Coordinate Descent; convergence is established through a global Lyapunov functional: the deterministic blocks satisfy monotonic descent, while the stochastic graph update satisfies descent in expectation, so that the expected energy converges.
  Experiments on synthetic datasets with non-convex geometries and on random subsets of Fashion-MNIST show that T-ARC recovers latent topological structures where K-means fails, achieving the highest accuracy on curved and interleaved clusters while remaining competitive, and markedly more stable than K-means, on real data.

</details>


### [307] [Also Small Models Can Reasonably Self-Evaluate Their Confidence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39478)
*Idil Kapikiran,Thomas Decker,Thomas Runkler*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究系统评估了不同规模语言模型在问答任务中基于自我评估的不确定性量化，发现模型规模和领域专业性对准确率有影响，但自我评估置信度的可靠性在这两个维度上基本稳定，即最强模型不一定最擅长自我评估预测可靠性，小模型也能实现合理的自我评估置信度，适合资源受限部署。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究模型规模和领域专业性如何影响基于自我评估的不确定性量化质量，以了解是否最强模型在自我评估预测可靠性上也最优。

Method: 使用多种自我评估方法，让不同规模的语言模型在覆盖通用到专业知识领域的问答任务上对自身预测进行判断，考察模型规模和领域特异性对自我评估置信度信号质量的影响。

Result: 准确率随模型变小和领域更专业而下降，但自我评估置信度的可靠性在这两个维度上基本保持稳定，即最强模型不一定最擅长自我评估预测可靠性。

Conclusion: 较小模型尽管准确率较低，仍能实现合理的自我评估置信度，使其成为资源受限部署的可行选择。

Abstract: This study systematically evaluates self-evaluation-based uncertainty quantification across different language models of varying sizes on question-answering tasks spanning general to specialized knowledge domains. Using various self-evaluation methods where models judge their own predictions, we examine how model scale and domain specificity affect the quality of self-assessed confidence signals. Our results reveal that while accuracy predictably declines with smaller models and more specialized domains, the reliability of self-evaluated confidence remains largely stable across both dimensions. This independence means the most capable model is not necessarily the best at self-assessing prediction reliability. These findings suggest that smaller models can achieve reasonable self-assessed confidence despite lower accuracy, making them viable for resource-constrained deployments.

</details>


### [308] [Correcting CondOT: Exact Finite-Step Sampling in Gaussian Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39488)
*Ron Levy,Michael Elad*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文研究流匹配中中点采样方法对高斯目标的数值误差，证明标准CondOT调度能抵消主导误差并改进收敛界，且在均匀网格上存在噪声调度β_t以1/S速率逼近CondOT调度1-t，实现精确高斯采样。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决流匹配中有限采样步数引入的数值误差依赖于调度的问题，特别是针对高斯目标和显式中点采样方法，量化误差并寻找最优调度。

Method: 使用平方Wasserstein距离度量采样误差，分析标准CondOT调度（α_t=t, β_t=1-t）对中点误差的抵消作用，证明在均匀网格上存在标量噪声调度β_t以1/S速率逼近CondOT噪声调度，从而实现精确采样。

Result: 标准CondOT调度抵消主导中点误差，改进一般收敛界（即使步长不均匀）；在均匀网格上，固定α_t=t，存在β_t以O(1/S)速率逼近1-t，使每个足够大的S都能精确采样高斯分布；实验验证收敛速率和精确校准。

Conclusion: 研究揭示了调度选择对流匹配采样误差的关键影响，证明了CondOT调度的优越性，并构造了可实现精确高斯采样的噪声调度序列，为实际应用提供了理论指导。

Abstract: Flow matching generates samples by gradually transforming noise into data. In practice, using a finite number of sampling steps introduces a numerical error that depends on the chosen schedule. We study this dependence for Gaussian targets and the explicit midpoint sampling method, using the exact flow field. We measure sampling error by the squared Wasserstein distance between the target distribution and the final distribution produced by the midpoint sampler. We show that the standard conditional optimal transport (CondOT) schedule cancels the leading midpoint error and improves the general convergence bound, even when the sampling steps are unequally spaced. On a uniform grid of $S$ sampling steps, we fix the signal schedule at $α_t=t$ and prove the existence of scalar noise schedules $β_t$ that approach the CondOT noise schedule $1-t$ at rate $1/S$ and yield exact Gaussian sampling for every sufficiently large $S$. Controlled Gaussian experiments illustrate the convergence rates and exact calibration.

</details>


### [309] [Towards Robust Time Series Learning via Capacity-Centric Modulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39489)
*Siru Zhong,Senzhang Wang,James T. Kwok,Yuxuan Liang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Capacity-Centric Modulation (CCM) 原理及其实现 SACM (Sample-Adaptive Capacity Modulation)，一种任务无关、即插即用的样本自适应正则化框架，利用频谱稀疏性为每个样本分配内部激活路径的 dropout 概率，解决深度时间序列学习中样本级可靠性异质导致的过欠正则化问题。实验表明，在 301 个真实数据集-骨干网络对上，SACM 平均将预测 MSE 降低 6.7%，分类准确率提升 3.04%，点调整 F1 提升 17.05%，且无测试时开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度时间序列学习中存在样本级可靠性异质性：标准训练流程对所有样本使用统一正则化，导致对损坏样本正则化不足、对干净样本过度限制。现有鲁棒性方法主要在数据空间过滤观测或在潜在空间施加先验，缺乏样本自适应的容量调制机制。

Method: 提出 Capacity-Centric Modulation (CCM) 原理，并实现 SACM 框架。SACM 利用频谱稀疏性计算样本级 dropout 概率，沿内部激活路径施加样本自适应的容量调制。该方法无需修改骨干网络架构，保持确定性推理流程，可直接集成到现有模型中。

Result: 在覆盖 9 个预测、32 个分类、4 个异常检测数据集的 301 个真实数据集-骨干网络对上，SACM 相对未修改骨干网络：预测任务 MSE 平均降低 6.7%，分类准确率提升 3.04%，点调整 F1 提升 17.05%，且测试阶段零额外开销。

Conclusion: SACM 通过样本自适应的容量调制有效缓解了样本级可靠性异质带来的正则化失配问题，作为一种通用的即插即用正则化增强技术，在多种时间序列任务和骨干网络上显著提升性能，且不增加推理成本。

Abstract: Sample-level reliability heterogeneity is common in deep time series learning. Standard training pipelines apply a uniform regularization setting to all samples, which can under-regularize corrupted samples and over-restrict clean samples. Common robustness approaches filter observations in data space or impose priors on latent representations. We propose Capacity-Centric Modulation (CCM) as a complementary, sample-adaptive regularization principle. Under this principle, we introduce SACM (Sample-Adaptive Capacity Modulation), a task-agnostic framework that exploits spectral sparsity to assign sample-wise dropout probabilities along internal activation paths. SACM integrates into existing backbones without architectural redesign and preserves the deterministic inference pipeline. Across 301 real-world dataset-backbone pairs covering 9 forecasting, 32 classification, and 4 anomaly-detection datasets, SACM reduces forecasting MSE by 6.7% on average and improves classification accuracy and point-adjusted F1 by 3.04% and 17.05%, respectively, relative to unmodified backbones, with zero test-time overhead.

</details>


### [310] [The Geometry of Randomized Smoothing on Feasible Sets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39497)
*Syed Izhan Khilji,Alireza Furutanpey,Schahram Dustdar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究随机平滑框架下的置信度过滤与条件概率认证，将问题分解为几何条件与认证方法，提出联合保留标签概率与均匀协方差界两种认证路径，并在图像分类器与自适应高斯合成中验证有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有随机平滑认证固定输出事件，但置信度过滤会引入保留集，导致条件概率分母随中心变化，破坏高斯比较性质，需解决几何条件下的条件概率认证问题，并给出有限样本界。

Method: 1. 将认证问题分解为几何问题（保留集凸性与保留律几何控制）与认证问题。2. 提出两种认证方法：联合保留标签概率法（始终有效）与基于均匀协方差界的条件雷尼发散证书迁移法（可在高斯事件比较失效时给出更大半径）。3. 两种方法均提供有限样本界。4. 引入自适应高斯合成处理因果有限时域执行中的历史依赖中心偏移。

Result: 在训练选择的非凸过滤器图像分类器上，条件雷尼界比联合质量界认证更多图像且无需额外模型评估；发布的置信度过滤器在条件代换获得的半径内展示验证过的标签变化；自适应高斯合成覆盖路径能量界下的历史依赖中心偏移场景。

Conclusion: 通过几何条件分析与两种互补认证策略，本文实现了置信度过滤下的可证明鲁棒半径认证，扩展了随机平滑在非凸保留集、有限样本及自适应噪声合成场景的适用范围。

Abstract: Randomized smoothing certifies the probability of a fixed output event as the center of Gaussian noise moves. Feasibility or confidence filtering reports label probabilities only among retained proposals, producing a ratio. Its numerator is a fixed Gaussian event mass, while its denominator is the probability of retention and can change with the center. Substituting this ratio into the ordinary smoothing formula can therefore certify a ball that contains a decision boundary. We separate the problem into a geometric question and a certification question. Geometry determines when conditioning preserves Gaussian comparisons. Convex retained sets preserve the full comparison, while general sets require geometric control of the retained law as the center moves. Without such control, conditional probabilities imply no positive universal radius. Joint retention-and-label probabilities always yield a valid certificate for the same filtered predictor. A uniform covariance bound transfers divergence certificates to the retained law and can yield larger radii even when the Gaussian event comparison fails. Both methods admit finite-sample bounds. For a learned image classifier with a training-selected nonconvex filter, conditional Rényi bounds certify more images than joint-mass bounds without additional model evaluations. A released confidence filter exhibits verified label changes inside radii obtained by conditional substitution. An application of adaptive Gaussian composition covers causal finite-horizon executions with history-dependent center shifts under a pathwise energy bound.

</details>


### [311] [Can Domain Generalization be Guaranteed in Small-Sample Learning?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39512)
*Hong Zheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文首次为分布偏移下的结构风险最小化（SRM）提供了理论保证，基于稳定性概念推导了学习一致性和泛化误差界，并在特定假设空间下建立了SRM的稳定性、学习和泛化界，为小样本域泛化算法设计提供理论基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 小样本学习因训练数据有限导致模型估计和泛化不稳定，结构风险最小化（SRM）在经典i.i.d.假设下被视为原则性解决方案，但域泛化（DG）违反该假设，SRM在DG中的理论作用长期未被探索，因此需要填补这一理论空白。

Method: 基于稳定性概念推导学习一致性和泛化误差界，证明当假设满足稳定性条件时界变得紧致；在特定假设空间假设下建立SRM的稳定性、学习和泛化界；进一步讨论这些界在深度学习中的适用性。

Result: 建立了首个域泛化场景下SRM的理论保证，给出了学习一致性和泛化误差界，证明界在稳定性条件下紧致，并在特定假设空间下获得稳定性、学习和泛化界，且适用于深度学习模型。

Conclusion: 该工作为分布偏移下的结构风险最小化奠定了理论基础，并为小样本场景下鲁棒域泛化算法的设计提供了重要启示。

Abstract: The small-sample learning problem remains a fundamental challenge in machine learning because limited training data lead to unstable model estimation and generalization. Structural Risk Minimization (SRM) has long been regarded as a principled solution under the classical i.i.d. assumption. However, domain generalization (DG) violates this assumption, leaving the theoretical role of SRM in DG largely unexplored. To bridge this gap, we establish the first theoretical guarantees for SRM in DG under mild assumptions. Specifically, based on the concept of stability, we derive learning consistency and generalization error bounds and prove that these bounds become tight when the hypotheses satisfy the stability condition. Building upon this, under a specific hypothesis space assumption, we establish stability, learning, and generalization bounds for SRM. We further discuss the applicability of these bounds to deep learning. This work establishes theoretical foundations for SRM under distribution shifts and sheds light on the design of robust DG algorithms in small-sample scenarios.

</details>


### [312] [CIDER-FM: Foundation Models for Causal Inference from Diverse Experimental Regimes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39523)
*Yuche Gao,Arik Reuter,Siyuan Guo,Anish Dhir,Bernhard Schölkopf,Adrian Weller*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 CIDER-FM，一种因果基础模型，通过干预感知表示和三轴层次注意力机制，融合观测数据与替代干预数据，比仅用观测数据更准确地预测目标条件干预分布（CID）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仅靠观测数据往往无法唯一确定因果模型，而直接针对目标变量的实验数据可能不可用。现有因果基础模型（CFM）主要在合成 SCM 先验上训练，难以有效结合有限的观测数据与替代干预数据（即对其他变量的干预），以提升对目标 CID 的预测。

Method: 提出 CIDER-FM：1) 形式化替代实验的理论收益；2) 设计干预感知表示，编码实验机制上下文；3) 引入分层三轴注意力，在变量、样本、实验机制三个维度交换信息；4) 在多样合成图/机制族、模拟及真实 Causal Chambers 数据上评估。

Result: CIDER-FM 在多种合成与真实基准上均显著优于仅用观测数据的基线及其他 CFM 变体，验证了引入替代干预上下文能显著提升 CID 预测精度。

Conclusion: 结合观测与替代干预数据的因果基础模型可有效缓解因果识别不确定性，CIDER-FM 的干预感知表示与三轴注意力为跨机制泛化提供了可扩展方案。

Abstract: Causal foundation models (CFMs) amortise causal inference over priors of synthetic structural causal models (SCMs), predicting the effect of an experiment on a specific variable. However, observational data alone may leave multiple causal models compatible with available evidence, while experimental data with interventions on exactly the variable of interest might be unavailable. This work studies CFMs as a method to combine finite observational and surrogate-interventional datasets in order to predict a target conditional interventional distribution (CID) more accurately than with observational data alone. We first formalise the conceptual benefits of surrogate experiments. Building on this analysis, we introduce \textsc{Foundation Models for Causal Inference from Diverse Experimental Regimes} (\emph{CIDER-FM}), a causal foundation model that uses an intervention-aware representation and hierarchical three-axis attention to exchange information across variables, samples, and experimental regimes. We evaluate CIDER-FM against a wide range of baselines across diverse synthetic graph and mechanism families, as well as on both simulated and real-world data from Causal Chambers. Our results demonstrate strong CID prediction performance and show that incorporating experimental context can improve predictions over observational data alone.

</details>


### [313] [Learning Reliable GUI Agents under Imperfect Priors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39547)
*Bo Han,Qianyi Wang,Shuai Liu,Xiong Zifan,Changqiao Wu,Yuanfa Li,Pengzhi Gao,Wei Liu,Jian Luan,Heng Qu,Yunpeng Song,Zhongmin Cai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对基于大语言/视觉语言模型的GUI智能体在未见应用和复杂多步任务上表现不佳的问题，指出检索增强执行面临知识获取难和先验漂移两大瓶颈，主张智能体应学会在不完美先验下正确行动，提出耦合知识获取与噪声鲁棒利用的框架：结构化探索构建UI状态转移图并合成任务-轨迹对；噪声感知训练注入五类真实漂移错误教智能体评估先验可靠性。实验表明该方法发现更多唯一屏幕、覆盖更多基准任务、更有效拒绝错误先验并利用正确先验，准确率提升可跨数据集迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
